11982.recap: In London she meets the American women delegates and learns how deeply the anti-slavery ranks are split over whether women may speak at all.

11982.label: Setting up house alone
11982.recap: Handed a check and told to prove herself, she repairs a neglected house and five acres single-handed while arguing constitutional law with a neighbour.

11982.label: Enter the schoolteacher
11982.recap: She introduces the Quaker teacher from Canajoharie who first laughed at the women's declaration and then gave her working life to it.

11982.label: Short skirt and trousers
11982.recap: A cousin arrives in a Turkish-style walking costume, and she adopts it herself for two years of unaccustomed physical freedom.

11982.label: Campaigning across Kansas
11982.recap: She crosses the state by mule carriage with a bushel of tracts, speaking in log cabins, depots, barns and a mill lit by a single candle.

11982.label: Sailing for Bordeaux
11982.recap: Worn out by two years of writing, she takes ship for France with her daughter and spends a sleepless first night rehearsing every worry she owns.

11982.label: An eightieth birthday
11982.recap: Her oldest friend quietly arranges a large public celebration of her eightieth birthday, staged by a council of twenty women's organisations.

11987.label: The wrong red sweater
11987.recap: A brick goes through a butcher's window, the wrong boy is arrested, and a very helpful lawyer is waiting for him at the station house.

11987.label: What is a shyster?
11987.recap: Over the firm's five o'clock tea the two partners and their clerk argue about what exactly makes a lawyer a shyster.

11987.label: A night of quiet visits
11987.recap: Mr. Tutt spends an evening calling on a butcher's neighbourhood and then on an elderly judge, and is still awake at dawn.

11987.label: A camel goes upstairs
11987.recap: In a Washington Street tenement four Syrians coax a camel up a jerry-built staircase and hide her in the attic.

11987.label: The office catapult
11987.recap: The office boy tests a homemade siege engine on a rooftop across the street, using a bottle of red ink for a shell.

11987.label: A servant sent away
11987.recap: A Fifth Avenue lady learns her waitress has been dismissed, unaware what the girl's disgrace has already set in motion.

11987.label: A cheerful bigamist
11987.recap: A placid traveling man walks into Tutt & Tutt, announces he has been indicted for bigamy, and refuses to be frightened about it.

11987.label: A father's letter
11987.recap: A fastidious young Harvard graduate comes to hear his late father's will read, and finds an envelope folded in with it.

11987.label: The neighbour who never called
11987.recap: A newly rich Fifth Avenue wife, cut dead by the woman next door, sends for her husband's lawyers and demands an arrest.

11987.label: The last horse doctor
11987.recap: An old Dublin-trained horseman, ruined by the coming of the motor car, scrapes a living tending sick animals on the West Side.

11987.label: A stranger with a sick horse
11987.recap: After a night nursing a roan mare, Danny takes on a stranger's broken-down horse and accepts a favour instead of a fee.

11987.label: Eleven to one
11987.recap: Deadlocked in the jury room, one juror believes he has found a way through the judge's ruling on a single piece of evidence.

12345.label: A call from the floor
12345.recap: A banker puts down a frantic telephone call from the Stock Exchange and realises that the man tearing the market apart is his oldest friend.

12345.label: Two friends, one street
12345.recap: He remembers how he and Bob Brownley came out of Harvard together into the family banking house, and how Bob once warned him about the gambling blood in his family.

12345.label: A visitor from Virginia
12345.recap: A young Virginian woman arrives unannounced at the office with a letter from her father and a desperate plan to recover a ruined fortune.

12345.label: Cornering Sugar
12345.recap: Bob throws the firm's buying power behind a rise in Sugar stock, and the paper profits pile up faster than anyone dares count.

12345.label: Barry Conant appears
12345.recap: A rival broker steps into the crowd and meets every bid with a flat refusal, and the narrator watches the day turn inside out.

12345.label: An overheard confession
12345.recap: Through a half-open office door the narrator becomes an unwilling witness as the two of them finally say aloud what they feel.

12345.label: Hoodoo day
12345.recap: On a raw, drizzling morning the Exchange gathers early for an expected killing in Sugar, and Bob quietly takes his place in the crowd.

12345.label: A walk through the city
12345.recap: The narrator shadows Bob through Wall Street, the Battery and the poorest quarters of New York as he argues with himself about what he has done.

12345.label: The house on Fifth Avenue
12345.recap: Bob builds a mansion whose upper floors reproduce, room for room and desk for desk, the offices where his life changed.

12345.label: Talking him down
12345.recap: With another panic running wild, the narrator resorts to a desperate bluff to stop his friend, and afterwards hears exactly what Bob intends to do next.

12345.label: Address to the Exchange
12345.recap: Trading is suspended so that Bob may speak from the president's platform to the whole floor about how the money game is really worked.

12345.label: The drive uptown
12345.recap: Word from home sends Bob hurtling through Manhattan traffic in a commandeered motor car, with the narrator clinging on behind.

12758.label: The Necklace
12758.recap: A clerk's wife, born for luxuries she will never have, borrows jewellery from a richer friend so that she can shine for one evening.

12758.label: An Uncomfortable Bed
12758.recap: A guest at a country chateau is certain his hosts are preparing a joke, and takes elaborate precautions before going to bed.

12758.label: Fear
12758.recap: On a moonlit deck a sunburned traveller argues that real fear has nothing to do with danger, and offers two occasions when he felt it.

12758.label: The Horla
12758.recap: A country gentleman begins a diary of fine spring days at his house by the river, and starts to record small things he cannot explain.

12758.label: The Torture by Hope
12758.recap: A Grand Inquisitor descends to a Segovia dungeon to visit a prisoner who has endured a year of torture without recanting.

12758.label: The Invisible Eye
12758.recap: A penniless young man rents a garret in Nuremberg with a magnificent view over the town, and finds his neighbours worth watching.

12758.label: Melmoth Reconciled
12758.recap: Balzac introduces the cashier as a species bred by city life, and follows one such man to his counting-house on a bad evening.

12758.label: The Conscript
12758.recap: In Revolutionary Carentan the town's leading people gather as usual at Madame de Dey's, though tonight everyone is watching her closely.

12758.label: Zadig the Babylonian
12758.recap: A rich, level-headed young Babylonian sets out to live reasonably, and finds that reason is not much protection against fortune.

12758.label: The Nail
12758.recap: A traveller boarding a stagecoach hopes for tolerable company and gets a fellow passenger he will not be able to forget.

12758.label: The Three Robbers
12758.recap: Walking home unsteadily from a feast, a Roman guest loses his torch to the wind and finds three large men attacking his door.

12758.label: Letter to Sura
12758.recap: Pliny writes to a friend asking whether ghosts truly exist, and sets out the stories that incline him to believe they do.

14140.label: Why Nikias
14140.recap: Plutarch explains why he pairs an Athenian general with a Roman, and how he means to handle a story Thucydides told first.

14140.label: The richest Roman
14140.recap: Crassus's frugal upbringing, his one governing vice, and the fires and proscriptions out of which he built a fortune.

14140.label: Seventy-eight gladiators
14140.recap: A break-out from a training school in Capua grows into a war that beats one Roman commander after another.

14140.label: Sertorius in Spain
14140.recap: A one-eyed Roman exile is introduced through a meditation on how history keeps repeating its own patterns.

14140.label: The secretary who fought
14140.recap: A waggoner's son is taken up by Philip of Macedon and rises to a cavalry command under Alexander, to other men's disgust.

14140.label: The lame king
14140.recap: A younger Spartan son goes through the ordinary hard schooling, which shapes him before the throne unexpectedly reaches him.

14140.label: A father hated, a son loved
14140.recap: Rome's early and lasting affection for Pompeius is set against its savage loathing for his father.

14140.label: Biography, not history
14140.recap: Plutarch states his method plainly: a jest or a small gesture shows character better than the bloodiest battle.

14140.label: The young Caesar
14140.recap: A young man refuses a dictator's order to divorce his wife, hides in the countryside, and is then taken by pirates.

14140.label: Phokion's bad times
14140.recap: An Athenian of genuine virtue is introduced in an age too far gone to give him the credit he earned.

14140.label: Stubborn from childhood
14140.recap: Cato appears as a slow, immovable child whose character was fixed long before anyone could teach him anything.

14140.label: Utica at the door
14140.recap: The people of a North African town gather and, with the conqueror's army approaching, insist on honouring their man.

14244.label: The teller begins
14244.recap: The storyteller promises a tale of love and death, then tells how a boy was born to a widowed queen and named for sorrow.

14244.label: The Irish tribute
14244.recap: A giant knight comes to Cornwall demanding a tribute of young men and maidens, and only one man in the hall answers his challenge.

14244.label: The dragon at the gate
14244.recap: Tristan rides out alone at daybreak against the beast that has been devouring the maidens of Ireland, and someone else claims the credit.

14244.label: The voyage to Cornwall
14244.recap: A queen entrusts her daughter's maid with a brewed potion meant for a wedding night, and on the calm sea it is opened by mistake.

14244.label: The orchard tryst
14244.recap: Twigs floated down a stream become a signal for meetings beneath a tall pine, until someone climbs into its branches to listen.

14244.label: Flour on the floor
14244.recap: A dwarf scatters flour across the king's bedchamber as a trap and springs it at midnight.

14244.label: The faggot of thorns
14244.recap: The king has a fire built for judgment, and the prisoner asks leave to say one last prayer in a chapel above the cliff.

14244.label: Life in the wild wood
14244.recap: The fugitives live rough among the trees, meet a hermit who urges them to repent, and walk away from him into the leaves.

14244.label: The sword between them
14244.recap: Guided by a woodman, King Mark rides alone to the forest hut and finds the sleepers there not at all as he expected.

14244.label: The ordeal by iron
14244.recap: Before two kings and their assembled hosts the queen swears an oath on holy relics and takes up the red-hot iron.

14244.label: The fool at court
14244.recap: A shaven madman is let into the hall for sport and tells the queen things that only three people alive could know.

14244.label: The white sail
14244.recap: Wounded past curing, Tristan sends his friend across the sea with a ring and an agreed signal for the returning ship.

14328.label: A visitor in the cell
14328.recap: A prisoner writing verses of complaint looks up to find a woman of shifting height standing over his bed, and she drives his muses out.

14328.label: Recognising his old nurse
14328.recap: His sight clears, he knows who his visitor is, and she explains why persecution has never surprised her.

14328.label: The prisoner's defence
14328.recap: He lays out his whole public career, the enemies it made him, his accusers, and the charge on which he was condemned unheard.

14328.label: The nature of Fortune
14328.recap: Philosophy begins with the gentler remedies, describing what Fortune is and what she never actually promised him.

14328.label: How small fame is
14328.recap: Pressed about his love of glory, he hears the whole earth measured against the heavens and reckoned no bigger than a point.

14328.label: Asking for stronger medicine
14328.recap: Steadied by the argument so far, he asks for the harsher remedies and is promised a road to true happiness.

14328.label: What everyone is chasing
14328.recap: She sets out how all people aim at one goal, and why wealth, office, power, fame and pleasure each fall short of it.

14328.label: Why do the wicked prosper?
14328.recap: He objects that evil flourishes unpunished while virtue is trampled, and asks how that can be under a good ruler.

14328.label: Providence and fate
14328.recap: She takes up the largest question of all, separating the single divine view of things from the unrolling order of events in time.

14328.label: Is there such a thing as chance?
14328.recap: He interrupts to ask whether chance exists at all, and hears it explained by way of a farmer and some buried gold.

14328.label: Eternity as one present
14328.recap: The argument closes by defining eternity as a whole life held at once, and reconciling divine foreknowledge with human freedom.

14471.label: Keys to the empty house
14471.recap: A young man visiting his aunt at the seaside learns she has borrowed the keys to a house the town says is haunted, and means to spend the night in it.

14471.label: Alone on the island
14471.recap: A law student is left by himself on a small island in a Canadian lake to catch up on his reading, and the emptiness soon begins to press on him.

14471.label: A room on the top floor
14471.recap: A young man who ruins everything he touches talks his way into a reporting job in an American city and takes a cheap room in a gaunt lodging house.

14471.label: A caller at eleven
14471.recap: An Edinburgh student cramming for an exam he cannot afford to fail is interrupted by the doorbell, and finds an old schoolfriend in a wretched state.

14471.label: A night in the barn
14471.recap: During a country house party a young guest is talked into sitting up all night in an old barn with a much travelled fellow guest who knows its story.

14471.label: The silent old countryman
14471.recap: A walker lunching at a wayside inn notices an old rustic by the window who never turns his head or speaks.

14471.label: The lodger upstairs
14471.recap: By a fireside a doctor tells his listeners about a fellow lodger from his student days who asked him for help with strange words.

14471.label: Three men, one room
14471.recap: A penniless writer in a New York boarding house, sharing a room and a spare mattress with two friends, has the place to himself for an evening.

14471.label: An unusual errand
14471.recap: A private secretary is asked by his employer whether he has personal courage, and told the errand ahead may involve violence.

14471.label: Last night in camp
14471.recap: A hunting party deep in the Quebec backwoods spends its final evening in camp, uneasy about the lake's name and about the habit of hunting in pairs.

14568.label: Christmas at Camelot
14568.recap: Arthur keeps his Christmas feast with the whole Round Table, fifteen days of dancing, tournaments and revel.

14568.label: The king waits for a marvel
14568.recap: Young and restless, Arthur refuses to eat until some wonder or adventure arrives to mark the New Year.

14568.label: A green rider enters
14568.recap: An enormous stranger, green from head to foot and carrying a holly branch and a huge axe, rides straight into the hall.

14568.label: The stroke is struck
14568.recap: The bargain is kept and the axe falls, and the court discovers what kind of guest it has welcomed.

14568.label: The year turns
14568.recap: The seasons roll from Christmas through Lent and summer to autumn, and the day of the promised meeting draws near.

14568.label: Alone in the winter woods
14568.recap: Riding through frozen wilderness on Christmas Eve, Gawayne prays for shelter and somewhere to hear mass.

14568.label: A castle in the trees
14568.recap: A shining moated castle appears among the oaks, and its lord welcomes the traveller with great warmth.

14568.label: The first hunt
14568.recap: The host rides out at daybreak with horns and hounds while his guest is left to sleep late in comfort.

14568.label: A visitor at the bedside
14568.recap: The lady of the castle finds Gawayne still in bed and keeps him there for a morning of dangerous courtesy.

14568.label: A green girdle offered
14568.recap: A gift is pressed on Gawayne with a remarkable promise attached, and he weighs what it might be worth to him.

14568.label: The place of the noise
14568.recap: At a grim, overgrown mound beside a brook, Gawayne hears a blade being whetted somewhere above him.

14568.label: The long road home
14568.recap: Gawayne rides back through many adventures to Arthur's court, wearing a belt and carrying a story he is ashamed to tell.

14818.label: The great man of Tinkletown
14818.recap: The town marshal enjoys his standing in a sleepy village that still lives on the memory of one old battle.

14818.label: A stranger in a hurry
14818.recap: A young man in a mud-spattered buggy pulls up, treats the marshal as a hitching post, and asks the road to Crow's Cliff.

14818.label: A bargain questioned
14818.recap: The marshal shows off his cheap new horse and buggy until the local reporter asks where the stranger really got them.

14818.label: The posse crosses the river
14818.recap: Armed townsmen follow a boy's account down to the water and put out after their quarry on a borrowed raft.

14818.label: Two fugitives in the brush
14818.recap: The hunted pair scramble through the woods, completely baffled about why a whole town is chasing them.

14818.label: A knock at midnight
14818.recap: In a blizzard the marshal and his wife are woken by footsteps on the porch and find a basket left at the door.

14818.label: Naming the child
14818.recap: The court makes the marshal guardian, and he explains at some length why the girl will not be called Crow.

14818.label: The village queen
14818.recap: Rosalie comes home from school in New York and every young man in town loses his appetite and his nerve.

14818.label: The tramp at the kitchen door
14818.recap: Disguised as a tramp, the marshal talks his way into a country house and finds a wedding party in full swing.

14818.label: Nothing but waiting
14818.recap: With no news at all, the marshal posts a reward and visibly ages while the county officials give up the search.

14818.label: Sounds from the swamp
14818.recap: Camped near an abandoned house, a young man hears moaning in the dark and goes out to find its source.

14818.label: The town board meets
14818.recap: The hall is packed because word has gone round that the marshal has an announcement to make.

14838.label: Four little rabbits
14838.recap: Four young rabbits are introduced, living with their mother under the root of a big fir-tree.

14838.label: Mother goes shopping
14838.recap: Mrs. Rabbit warns her children away from a certain garden and sets off to the baker's.

14838.label: Under the garden gate
14838.recap: While his sisters gather blackberries, Peter squeezes under the gate into the forbidden garden and eats his fill.

14838.label: A very bad meeting
14838.recap: Peter comes face to face with the gardener, who jumps up and gives chase.

14838.label: Hiding in the shed
14838.recap: Peter takes refuge in a watering-can in the tool-shed while the flower-pots are turned over one by one.

14838.label: Lost in the garden
14838.recap: Out of breath and thoroughly lost, Peter tries a locked door, asks a mouse for directions, and passes a very still white cat.

14838.label: The gate in sight
14838.recap: From the top of a wheelbarrow Peter spots the gardener's turned back and, beyond him, the gate.

14838.label: Camomile tea
14838.recap: Home again and worn out, Peter is put to bed with a dose of camomile tea while his sisters have supper.

15272.label: A knight sets out
15272.recap: A young champion rides out in borrowed, battle-marked armour on a quest given him by a distant queen.

15272.label: Lost in the wood
15272.recap: Sheltering from a storm, the travellers wander deep into a maze of paths and come upon a hollow cave.

15272.label: A vision at midnight
15272.recap: Their pious old host wakes the knight in the dark and leads him to see something meant to poison his trust.

15272.label: The lady alone
15272.recap: Separated from her champion, the lady wanders the wilderness and meets a beast that will not touch her.

15272.label: A palace on the highway
15272.recap: With a new companion the knight reaches a glittering house crowded with travellers who rarely come back out.

15272.label: In the wild forest
15272.recap: A lawless knight presses the lady first with flattery and then with force in a lonely wood.

15272.label: Rest by a fountain
15272.recap: Disarmed beside a shady spring, the knight is found again by the lady who calls herself Fidessa.

15272.label: Before the shut gate
15272.recap: A splendid stranger knight marches on a silent castle to answer a dwarf's report of a captive.

15272.label: A terrified rider
15272.recap: The knight halts a fleeing man with a rope around his neck and forces him to say what has frightened him.

15272.label: A house of healing
15272.recap: Seeing her knight worn out, the lady brings him to an ancient house famous for its care and its learning.

15272.label: The dragon wakes
15272.recap: At the border of her parents' ruined kingdom an enormous scaled beast stirs itself on a sunny slope.

15272.label: Gates opened at last
15272.recap: A watchman's news brings an old king out to fling wide brazen gates that had been shut for years.

15381.label: A window on the canal
15381.recap: An invalid explains the one room he can see from, and the girl whose reflection he has watched on a balcony opposite for years.

15381.label: A gondolier calls
15381.recap: A young boatman stops to talk with the girl on her balcony, and the watcher tries to work out what it means.

15381.label: Oxney Colne
15381.recap: A remote Devon parish is introduced along with its antiquarian parson and his sharp-tongued, strong-willed daughter.

15381.label: The walk to Helpholme
15381.recap: Refusing to wait at her window, Patience keeps to her errand across the moor and meets her suitor on the path back.

15381.label: Lessons she did not ask for
15381.recap: In the days after the engagement, Patience begins to notice something in her lover's manner that grates on her.

15381.label: Down from the fell
15381.recap: A Cumberland shepherd brings his flock off the fell at dusk and passes the vicarage on his way home.

15381.label: After the organ stops
15381.recap: The vicar's niece finishes practising the hymns alone in the church and is waylaid in the dark churchyard.

15381.label: On the hillside
15381.recap: Out walking on a Sunday afternoon, Anthony finds Rosa alone among the rocks and finally speaks his mind.

15381.label: Telling his mother
15381.recap: Anthony waits for the right moment by the fire to tell his mother what he has arranged for himself.

15381.label: A trout stream in Kent
15381.recap: A rich, woman-shy wanderer is kept in England by his lawyers and sent to a quiet inn beside a trout stream.

15381.label: A publisher's garden party
15381.recap: A young Oxford tutor and minor poet meets a celebrated beauty in a lantern-lit garden and hears her hint at an unhappy marriage.

15381.label: Six months later
15381.recap: The poet returns at the agreed time to hold the woman he loves to her promise.

15384.label: The girl at the back
15384.recap: A lecturer on the French Revolution notices that the one student he cannot ignore has written down nothing but his throwaway joke.

15384.label: Put off in the rain
15384.recap: A dispute over a nickel gets Rose put off a crowded streetcar into a downpour, and a stranger gets off with her.

15384.label: A sister's plan
15384.recap: Rodney and his sister Frederica argue about the sensible marriage she had quietly arranged for him in her head.

15384.label: A quiet wedding
15384.recap: Plans for a small June wedding bring Rodney's celebrated sister into the modest Stanton household, where she is a hit.

15384.label: The ideal house
15384.recap: The couple take a fashionable furnished house for a year while their friends debate whether Rose will take socially.

15384.label: Behind the dam
15384.recap: Rose holds back her mounting doubts about what her comfortable married life has cost her husband, and then his other sister arrives.

15384.label: A week of argument
15384.recap: For a week Rose and Rodney fight, night after night, over a decision she has made and he cannot bring himself to believe.

15384.label: A room of her own
15384.recap: Rose rents a shabby attic room from a suspicious landlady and locks the door behind her, purely for the pleasure of it.

15384.label: Ten days before opening
15384.recap: Tempers detonate all over a musical comedy company in the frantic last days before the curtain goes up.

15384.label: Taking the road
15384.recap: In a sudden loss of nerve Rose trades a comfortable Chicago run for the hardships of a second-rate touring company.

15384.label: Looking for work
15384.recap: Alone in a small town, Rose walks Main Street under hostile stares, determined to find any job at all before dark.

15384.label: Beginning again
15384.recap: The book closes with two much-changed people learning, awkwardly and then gladly, how to be together after everything.

15399.label: The valley of Essaka
15399.recap: The narrator describes the West African province where he was born and the customs of the people who raised him.

15399.label: Taken from the house
15399.recap: With the adults away in the fields, he and his sister are seized and carried into the woods.

15399.label: A night together
15399.recap: Passed from master to master through many countries, he is astonished to meet his sister again.

15399.label: The ship at anchor
15399.recap: Reaching the sea for the first time, he is taken aboard a waiting vessel and is certain he will be killed.

15399.label: Below the decks
15399.recap: He describes the crowded, airless hold during the Atlantic crossing and what he saw of it from the deck.

15399.label: The watch and the picture
15399.recap: Set to fan a sleeping planter in Virginia, he studies the unfamiliar objects in the room with alarm.

15399.label: Salt on the deck
15399.recap: Newly landed in England, he meets snow for the first time and asks the mate what it is.

15399.label: Down the river at Deptford
15399.recap: Expecting to be paid off, he is instead hurried into a boat and rowed towards the outward-bound ships.

15399.label: Asked for as a sailor
15399.recap: A sloop captain takes a liking to him and presses his owner to let him serve aboard ship.

15399.label: A breakfast in Montserrat
15399.recap: With money saved from small trading ventures, he goes to put an offer to his master over breakfast.

15399.label: A new course
15399.recap: Under a boastful new captain steering an unfamiliar route, the same dream troubles him three nights running.

15399.label: A petition presented
15399.recap: In later life he lays a plea before the Queen on behalf of enslaved Africans and draws his account to a close.

15474.label: A bard at the hermitage
15474.recap: A travelling reciter arrives among sages holding a long sacrifice in a forest, and they ask him to tell the great history he has heard.

15474.label: The bird and the bough
15474.recap: An enormous bird carries a broken tree limb through the sky, searching for somewhere to drop it without harming the tiny ascetics hanging from it.

15474.label: A house of lac
15474.recap: A prince takes a trusted servant aside and instructs him to build a beautiful mansion out of the most flammable materials he can find.

15474.label: The contest of the bow
15474.recap: After every assembled king fails to string a mighty bow, an unknown young man dressed as a Brahmana rises from the crowd to try.

15474.label: The game is proposed
15474.recap: In a crowded assembly hall a skilled gambler invites the eldest brother to play at dice, and the two argue over whether such a contest can be honest.

15474.label: The road to the forest
15474.recap: The brothers leave the capital for exile in the woods, followed by grieving citizens who beg to go with them.

15474.label: Alone on the mountain
15474.recap: One brother travels north by himself into a trackless Himalayan forest to win divine weapons through austerity.

15474.label: Grief in the woods
15474.recap: With one brother gone, the exiles sit together in sorrow while the strongest of them argues fiercely for abandoning the forest and fighting.

15474.label: An impossible guest
15474.recap: A famously demanding sage arrives with ten thousand disciples expecting a feast, at the one hour of the day when there is no food left.

15474.label: The tale of Savitri
15474.recap: A sage begins the story of a childless king whose long devotions win him the promise of a daughter of great energy.

15474.label: The stolen fire-sticks
15474.recap: A deer runs off with a hermit's fire-sticks, and the brothers chase it through the woods until it vanishes and leaves them exhausted.

15474.label: Setting out unrecognised
15474.recap: The exiles take leave of the ascetics who shared their forest years and prepare to spend one more year hidden and unknown.

16328.label: Prologue: The Spear-Danes
16328.recap: The poem opens with the glory of the Danish kings, from the founder Scyld Scefing onward.

16328.label: Grendel
16328.recap: Night after night the monster Grendel raids King Hrothgar's hall, devouring his warriors for twelve long years.

16328.label: Beowulf Sails
16328.recap: The mighty Geat Beowulf hears of the Danes' suffering and sails across the sea to help.

16328.label: At Heorot
16328.recap: Beowulf comes before King Hrothgar and vows to face Grendel with his bare hands.

16328.label: Unferth's Taunt
16328.recap: The jealous Unferth mocks Beowulf, who answers by recounting a great swimming feat of his youth.

16328.label: The Fight with Grendel
16328.recap: That night Grendel bursts into the hall and is seized in Beowulf's terrible grip.

16328.label: Victory
16328.recap: Grendel flees mortally wounded, and the Danes rejoice and heap honours on Beowulf.

16328.label: Grendel's Mother
16328.recap: In vengeance Grendel's monstrous mother strikes the hall in the dead of night.

16328.label: The Fight in the Mere
16328.recap: Beowulf dives into the haunted lake to battle Grendel's mother in her hall beneath the water.

16328.label: The Dragon
16328.recap: Fifty years on, a thief robs an ancient hoard and wakes a dragon that burns the land.

16328.label: Beowulf and the Dragon
16328.recap: Now an old king, Beowulf arms himself once more and goes out to face the fire-drake.

16328.label: Wiglaf's Loyalty
16328.recap: As the old king falters against the dragon, only the young Wiglaf stays true and springs to his side.

16328.label: The Funeral Pyre
16328.recap: The Geats mourn their fallen king and raise a great barrow above his ashes.

16389.label: An Advertisement
16389.recap: Drab, weather-worn Mrs Wilkins spies a newspaper notice offering a small Italian castle to let for the month of April.

16389.label: A Kindred Spirit
16389.recap: She persuades the equally downtrodden Mrs Arbuthnot to share the cost and the dream of escape.

16389.label: Finding Companions
16389.recap: To afford it the two women seek two more to share, drawing the aloof Lady Caroline and the formidable Mrs Fisher.

16389.label: The Journey South
16389.recap: The two friends set off across France and Italy toward the castle of San Salvatore.

16389.label: Arrival in the Rain
16389.recap: They arrive wet, weary and in the dark, unsure quite what they have come to.

16389.label: First Morning
16389.recap: Morning reveals the castle ablaze with flowers and sea light, and the weariness begins to fall away.

16389.label: Settling In
16389.recap: The four women begin, warily, to share the beauty of the place.

16389.label: Mrs Fisher's Domain
16389.recap: Prim Mrs Fisher stakes out the best room, clinging to her dignity among strangers.

16389.label: Softening
16389.recap: The garden's gentle spell begins to thaw the guarded hearts of its visitors.

16389.label: Letters Home
16389.recap: Transformed by the place, Mrs Wilkins writes to invite the husband she had grown apart from.

16389.label: An Unexpected Guest
16389.recap: Mr Wilkins arrives, and an awkward misunderstanding turns surprisingly sweet.

16389.label: Sending for Frederick
16389.recap: Warmed and softened, Mrs Arbuthnot writes at last to summon her own estranged husband.

16389.label: Full Bloom
16389.recap: Under a full moon the garden works its final magic on every heart gathered there.

16433.label: A young man arrives
16433.recap: A weary government office is brightened by a spirited young clerk who falls in love and leaves the service to write.

16433.label: The vanished swimmer
16433.recap: An older cousin opens her account of a Nantucket woman who walked down to the water one foggy morning and was not seen again.

16433.label: Among the white birches
16433.recap: A surgeon's wife, married to a man who believes only in flesh and bone, warms to his brilliant friend newly home from the war.

16433.label: The theatrical classmate
16433.recap: A college narrator describes a Southern friend who stages his poverty, his hospitality and his heartbreak alike.

16433.label: A candle for the tree
16433.recap: On a bitter Christmas Eve a ruined gentleman climbs to his tenement and promises a poor family a red candle for their branch of pine.

16433.label: The painter who studied law
16433.recap: An old teacher recalls walking the galleries with a friend who worshipped beauty, then watched him take up law and marry an ascetic young artist.

16433.label: Tea with the Admiral
16433.recap: A rich young woman tells her great-uncle about the man who withdrew the moment he learned who she really was.

16433.label: The ancestral bed
16433.recap: A small, fastidious man reaches the family house he has travelled far to see and notices the striking girl who waits at table.

16433.label: Fifteen dollars a week
16433.recap: In a booming California oil town a hatless young secretary cheerfully argues that nobody should earn more than fifteen dollars a week.

16433.label: The empty house
16433.recap: A brisk young couple keeping a Virginia store make Sunday picnics at a shuttered mansion, until one evening they hear a ship's clock striking inside it.

16433.label: Refusing to be grandmother
16433.recap: A widow who has only just come into leisure and pretty clothes tells her daughter she has no intention of settling down for a baby.

16433.label: Family pride, thin table
16433.recap: Three orphaned sisters go hungry to keep up appearances, and the youngest, who longs for warmth and plain good food, is courted; the collection closes on the choice she makes.

16921.label: Perfumed for trade
16921.recap: The crew of a Free Trader greases up with scented paste before facing the smell-sensitive natives of Sargol.

16921.label: Rivals at the ramp
16921.recap: Officers from a rival Company ship turn up at the foot of the ramp demanding an audience.

16921.label: Something in the garden
16921.recap: A young native darts aboard and heads straight for the ship's hydroponics garden, drawn by a scent.

16921.label: Hunting on the reef
16921.recap: The Terrans join a native hunt on a sea reef, standing by torchlight and watching the water.

16921.label: The funeral feast
16921.recap: A clan gathers in its great hall for a feast, an heir's elevation, and the entertainments that follow.

16921.label: Net against net
16921.recap: Two clansmen settle an insult in front of the whole feast with nets and claw knives.

16921.label: An hour after dawn
16921.recap: Two off-worlders face each other with borrowed weapons before the assembled clans.

16921.label: Headaches in Hyper
16921.recap: In deep space the ship settles into routine until a crewman collapses with a blinding headache.

16921.label: One by one
16921.recap: The illness spreads through the crew while the handful still standing hunt for a pattern.

16921.label: Walk to the bubble
16921.recap: Suited up, three of them cross an asteroid to talk their way into a rival company's supply station.

16921.label: Drawn out of hiding
16921.recap: The captain's caged pet scrapes out an eerie noise, and something creeps into the open to answer it.

16921.label: A landing nobody attempts
16921.recap: The Queen sets down where no ship is permitted, and her crew rolls out into an uproar.

16921.label: The reckoning
16921.recap: The crew sits down with the authorities to learn what all their choices are going to cost.

17157.label: A surgeon takes to sea
17157.recap: Gulliver describes his family, his training in medicine and navigation, and why he keeps returning to the sea.

17157.label: The ship strikes a rock
17157.recap: A storm drives the ship onto a rock and Gulliver swims until he finds ground under his feet.

17157.label: Pinned to the grass
17157.recap: Waking bound hand and foot, Gulliver finally sees who has been walking about on his chest.

17157.label: Diversions of the court
17157.recap: As the natives lose their fear of him, Gulliver is shown the entertainments by which court offices are won.

17157.label: A plan against the fleet
17157.recap: Hearing of an invasion, Gulliver measures the channel and puts a proposal to the emperor.

17157.label: A caller at night
17157.recap: A friend arrives secretly in a sedan chair to warn Gulliver of an intrigue two months in the making.

17157.label: A boat on the tide
17157.recap: Gulliver spots something floating offshore and asks for ships and men to help him bring it in.

17157.label: The Adventure sails
17157.recap: Two months after coming home Gulliver ships out again, and unusual winds carry the vessel far off course.

17157.label: The little nurse
17157.recap: A farmer's daughter makes him clothes, teaches him the language, and gives him a name of her own.

17157.label: Ridiculous accidents
17157.recap: Gulliver recounts the mishaps that his size brought on him in the palace gardens.

17157.label: Lifted into the air
17157.recap: Asleep in his travelling box, Gulliver wakes to find it rising fast and cannot see what has hold of it.

17157.label: Home again
17157.recap: Gulliver reaches his own door and finds his household strangely small and his own behaviour alarming to them.

17460.label: A yeoman begins his tale
17460.recap: John Ridd of Oare introduces himself as a plain unlettered farmer setting down what he saw, and describes his schooling at Tiverton.

17460.label: Called away from school
17460.recap: On his twelfth birthday a rider from home arrives at the school gate, and a quarrel among the boys has to be settled first.

17460.label: News from the moor
17460.recap: The reason for the summons is told at last: seven farmers riding back from market were stopped in the starlight.

17460.label: Up the Bagworthy water
17460.recap: Fishing alone far past the safe stretches, the boy comes to a black pool and a long pale slide of water above it.

17460.label: A boy and a girl
17460.recap: He wakes at the head of the fall to find a small girl tending his cut feet, and the two exchange names.

17460.label: The long walk home
17460.recap: After months away in London he walks the whole west country back, footsore and shoeless, and is taken in by a kinsman.

17460.label: Rumours in the west
17460.recap: Talk of arms landed by night and secret musters convinces John that something is stirring against the King.

17460.label: The King's messenger explains
17460.recap: Jeremy Stickles lays out the disaffection spreading through the counties and binds John to secrecy about it.

17460.label: The great thaw
17460.recap: After a killing frost that drives deer to the farmyard, a south-west gale brings rain and the buried rivers break out.

17460.label: A guest in the house
17460.recap: The outlaws' Counsellor stays the night at the farm and takes a curious interest in how the dairy is managed.

17460.label: A grave at Watchett
17460.recap: John finds a nameless grave in a seaside churchyard at sunrise and brings an old nurse back with him to Oare.

17460.label: After the last chase
17460.recap: Wounded and heavy-hearted, John rides home carrying a child and finds the house full of women waiting for him.

18151.label: Buying the pickers
18151.recap: Gold is counted out on a plantation veranda and a hundred field workers change hands, to the disgust of the new manager.

18151.label: A vacation, almost
18151.recap: Over lunch at a nobleman's house, a couple describe the gentle farming world where they mean to spend a quiet month.

18151.label: The chief's small favour
18151.recap: Behind a horseshoe desk, the head of the Paratime Police explains why one ordinary sale of slaves is not ordinary at all.

18151.label: Questioning the captives
18151.recap: In hidden rooms behind the plantation house, drugged captives describe what happened to them, and their accounts do not quite agree.

18151.label: A reporter gets curious
18151.recap: A news man strolls into a claims office, bullies a clerk into showing him a document, and puts it straight on the air.

18151.label: A councilman's instructions
18151.recap: Watching the uproar from his private office, a politician receives a visitor who tells him precisely what speech he is to give.

18151.label: Into the walled town
18151.recap: Two traders ride through the gates of a hill town with pack horses full of rifles and are welcomed as honoured guests.

18151.label: Counting the exits
18151.recap: Alone with brandy and a locked door, a man works out that every road left to him ends badly, and chooses one.

18151.label: On the landing stage
18151.recap: An arriving prisoner and his escort are not quite what they appear, and thirty seconds of shooting settles the matter.

18151.label: A number in the noise
18151.recap: A mathematician calls to report that the list of timeline designations forms a series, and the series points somewhere nobody had thought to look.

18151.label: The raid goes in
18151.recap: Conveyers loaded with troops, gas bombs and reporters materialise above a base on a dead and desert world.

18151.label: Drinks in a hideout
18151.recap: In a hidden apartment the three of them take stock of what was won, what was missed, and what work is still waiting.

18459.label: A sleepless lover
18459.recap: Alone in his chamber and sick with unreturned love, the narrator turns his griefs over until sleep finally takes him.

18459.label: Lost in the wood
18459.recap: His dream sets him down in a dark tangle of trees and thorns from which he can find no path out.

18459.label: A voice by the water
18459.recap: Free of the wood and desperate with thirst, he finds a spring, but a singing voice pulls him away from it.

18459.label: A valley and a wolf
18459.recap: He wakes into a second, sweeter dream country, glimpses a wolf, and sees an enormous ancient monument rising ahead of him.

18459.label: Measuring the monument
18459.recap: He gives himself over to the ruin entirely, describing its horses, colossi and carvings piece by carved piece.

18459.label: Something in the dark
18459.recap: A dragging, hissing noise at the porch drives him into the unlit passages beneath the great building.

18459.label: Five companions
18459.recap: Five nymphs take him in, name themselves to him, and lead him off to the baths, where they make sport of him.

18459.label: At the queen's table
18459.recap: Passed through the doorkeepers in his torn gown, he is received by a great queen and seated at a banquet of extraordinary ceremony.

18459.label: Three doors
18459.recap: Three gates cut into a rock each offer a different way of living, and his two guides take him through all of them in turn.

18459.label: The torch-bearer
18459.recap: A nymph carrying a lit torch leaves a distant company of young people and walks straight towards him.

18459.label: Four chariots
18459.recap: He watches four jewelled triumphal cars go by, stopping to read the figures and stories worked into each one.

18459.label: Holding himself back
18459.recap: Overcome by his guide's beauty, he argues himself out of acting on it, and this translation breaks off there.

18575.label: The bath and the postern
18575.recap: A prosperous townsman lays on a supper and a bath for his neighbour's wife, and the neighbour comes home a night early and knocks at the door.

18575.label: A very devout drunkard
18575.recap: A prior at his prayers is cornered by a hugely drunk man who will not be put off from making his confession.

18575.label: Three in a bed
18575.recap: A Paris goldsmith keeps his carter overnight after the city gates shut, and beds him down on the far side of his own wife.

18575.label: The man in the tree
18575.recap: A husband takes his wife into the woods and begins listing her charms aloud, not knowing that a man searching for a lost calf is sitting overhead.

18575.label: The child of the snow
18575.recap: A London merchant returns after ten years abroad to find one child more than he left behind, and hears a remarkable explanation for it.

18575.label: A lover put to the test
18575.recap: Two young people of a Brabant household are forced apart by gossip, and she sets out in disguise to discover how loyal her lover has stayed.

18575.label: Shirts at the Antwerp fair
18575.recap: A pleasant companion accepts three lords' hospitality at the fair and repays it by making their freshly washed linen vanish.

18575.label: A flight from the old knight
18575.recap: A girl promised to a rich elderly neighbour rides away with the young knight she loves, and they stop for food at a crowded village inn.

18575.label: The merchant's late marriage
18575.recap: A Genoese merchant of fifty grieves that he has no heir, marries a girl of fifteen, and within a year is pining for the sea again.

18591.label: Measuring a republic
18591.recap: Marshall sizes up the young United States before turning back to the first European voyages to its coast.

18591.label: The first small squadron
18591.recap: Three vessels sail from the Thames under sealed orders and their passengers choose a peninsula on a Virginia river for a fort.

18591.label: Captain Smith taken
18591.recap: While exploring a river Smith is captured and carried through the towns to the seat of the region's most powerful king.

18591.label: The Plymouth company
18591.recap: The northern company's early attempts at settlement fail one after another before a foothold is finally made.

18591.label: Trade laws from London
18591.recap: The restored monarchy tightens its commercial grip on the colonies, and distance makes the new rules hard to enforce.

18591.label: War with Philip
18591.recap: New England's quiet breaks as an Indian confederacy turns on the settlements.

18591.label: Carolina attacked
18591.recap: Southern Indians sweep the Carolina frontier and the governor proclaims martial law in a crowded Charleston.

18591.label: March to Fort Du Quesne
18591.recap: Braddock pushes a picked column through rough country toward the French fort on the Ohio, brushing aside local advice.

18591.label: The darkest campaign
18591.recap: After years of French success the British position in America looks close to lost on every frontier.

18591.label: Peace, then taxes
18591.recap: With France expelled from the continent, Parliament turns to raising a revenue in America and resistance begins.

18591.label: The nineteenth of April
18591.recap: A British column marches out to seize stores at Concord and finds militia waiting on the way.

18591.label: The hill above Charlestown
18591.recap: Raw provincial troops hold their fire behind hasty earthworks as British regulars climb toward them.

18592.label: A Virginia boyhood
18592.recap: A planter's son loses his father early, takes work as a frontier surveyor, and is sent as an envoy into unmapped country.

18592.label: The ditch at Fort Necessity
18592.recap: A hastily built stockade is attacked from ten in the morning until dark, and terms are signed in the night.

18592.label: March to the Monongahela
18592.recap: A young volunteer aide, ill with fever, urges speed on a general who halts to bridge every brook.

18592.label: Chosen to command
18592.recap: Years of quiet estate management end when a congress at Philadelphia looks for one man to lead its forces.

18592.label: Designs upon Canada
18592.recap: Congress gambles on seizing a lightly defended province before it can be used as a base against the colonies.

18592.label: Storm in a snowstorm
18592.recap: Four divisions move against a walled town under driving snow, along paths so narrow the columns stretch thin.

18592.label: A fleet off New York
18592.recap: Sails appear off Sandy Hook while politicians debate, and troops land unopposed on Staten Island.

18592.label: Manoeuvred out of position
18592.recap: Rather than storm a strong camp, the British work to turn its rear and cut the river above it.

18592.label: Crossing in the ice
18592.recap: A night crossing in snow, hail and floating ice is timed so three columns strike a river town at once.

18592.label: Late afternoon at Brandywine
18592.recap: A flanking column arrives after a seventeen-mile circuit, and the hastily reformed line begins to break from the right.

18592.label: A treaty at Saratoga
18592.recap: Boxed in with three days' provisions, a general calls a council of his officers and opens a negotiation.

18592.label: Winter without provisions
18592.recap: Meat unfit to eat gives way to no meat at all, and the commander is pushed toward seizing food from farmers.

18857.label: Uncle Hardwigg of Hamburg
18857.recap: A young man introduces the choleric, stammering professor he lives and studies with in an old Hamburg house.

18857.label: Cracking the parchment
18857.recap: Left alone with a scrap of runic writing, the nephew stumbles on the trick of reading it and is horrified by what it says.

18857.label: Riding across Iceland
18857.recap: With a silent Icelandic guide leading, the party sets off overland on small tough ponies toward the mountain.

18857.label: On the summit
18857.recap: From the peak the travellers survey the whole island and hear the guide pronounce the name they were looking for.

18857.label: Into the crater
18857.recap: The nephew forces himself to look into the shaft, and the descent by rope and ledge begins.

18857.label: Water behind granite
18857.recap: Failing from thirst, they hear a torrent running behind the tunnel wall and the guide sets to work on the rock.

18857.label: Alone in the dark
18857.recap: Walking ahead absorbed in the rock layers, the narrator turns and finds his companions gone.

18857.label: The central sea
18857.recap: They come out on the shore of a vast underground ocean lit by a strange constant glow instead of a sun.

18857.label: Battle of the elements
18857.recap: The air over the sea turns heavy and electric and a storm gathers around the little raft.

18857.label: A plain of bones
18857.recap: Beyond the shore they cross a field of fossil remains toward a colourless forest of ancient trees.

18857.label: Lighting the fuse
18857.recap: To open a blocked passage they lay a charge of gunpowder, and the nephew asks for the honour of firing it.

18857.label: Daylight at last
18857.recap: The travellers come to on a baking mountainside under a sun and a landscape none of them expected.

18875.label: A letter begun
18875.recap: Newly and suddenly married, she starts a long confiding letter to a friend six thousand miles away.

18875.label: The long wagon ride
18875.recap: Left at a prairie station by her husband, she rides for hours across empty country toward her new home.

18875.label: The well he dug
18875.recap: Touring the ranch, her husband explains why finding water on this land mattered so much to him.

18875.label: Coyote and quarrel
18875.recap: A ride home brings her face to face with a coyote, and the evening ends in the couple's first cross words.

18875.label: A red coat at the door
18875.recap: A Mounted Policeman arrives hunting a fugitive and asks her to keep watch while he searches the outbuildings.

18875.label: A secret birthday
18875.recap: She spends the last of her hidden savings on a hoard of presents smuggled out from town.

18875.label: Homesick before winter
18875.recap: Money worries press on her husband and she admits to a homesickness she cannot name.

18875.label: A book by the fire
18875.recap: A neighbour reads poetry aloud by the stove, and her husband walks in at exactly the wrong moment.

18875.label: A Norse goddess arrives
18875.recap: A huge, golden-haired Finnish girl arrives driving oxen, hired to work the fields and help in the house.

18875.label: Harvest begins
18875.recap: The binders go out into the wheat while she watches the thermometer and prays the frost holds off.

18875.label: Why she won't eat mushrooms
18875.recap: Over the breakfast dishes the hired girl tells a grim story from her own far northern country.

18875.label: Plans on the table
18875.recap: Over a bundle of house plans the couple imagine what comes next, and she finds herself mourning the shack.

19146.label: Two hat wearers
19146.recap: The town's two oddities are introduced, each known entirely by the hat he refuses to give up.

19146.label: The judge calls
19146.recap: Judge Custis strolls down to the money-lender's store to ask for a loan and gets a lesson in manners.

19146.label: A hired carriage
19146.recap: Milburn hires two horses and drives out through the pine barrens, astonishing everyone who sees him pass.

19146.label: The creditor's terms
19146.recap: Milburn climbs to the judge's bedroom, tells him what his furnace is really worth, and names his condition.

19146.label: Laughter at the window
19146.recap: Vesta and her mother watch the famous hat go by and amuse themselves thoroughly at its owner's expense.

19146.label: The morning after
19146.recap: The new bride wakes alone and goes to tell her mother what she has agreed to.

19146.label: The passenger wakes
19146.recap: A young boatman tries to rouse the stranger sleeping in his hold and hears him mutter in his sleep.

19146.label: An empty kitchen
19146.recap: The household wakes to find the kitchen people gone in the night and the watchdog dead on the lawn.

19146.label: Among the band
19146.recap: Levin wakes at the crossroads tavern knowing what he has witnessed and what is expected of him that night.

19146.label: Morning after the storm
19146.recap: In Dover the men piece together a violent night from those who were actually in it.

19146.label: Home again
19146.recap: The household reassembles at Princess Anne, and Vesta quietly settles the future of everyone in it.

19146.label: The last illness
19146.recap: Sickness reaches Teackle Hall and the family gathers around a bed for the final reckoning.

19412.label: The dragon is coming
19412.recap: Ellaline confides that the guardian she has never met is sailing home from Bengal, just as her secret engagement needs more time.

19412.label: An impossible favour
19412.recap: The plan is spelled out: Ellaline slips away to friends while Audrie takes her name and meets the guardian in her place.

19412.label: A rose at the station
19412.recap: Seeing Ellaline off, Audrie collides with a forward young Englishman who refuses to be shaken off before her appointment.

19412.label: The boat train arrives
19412.recap: The passengers from the East pour onto the platform and Audrie picks out the man she is certain must be the Dragon.

19412.label: Letters from the other side
19412.recap: Sir Lionel writes to an old friend in Bengal, glad to be back in England and content to leave old griefs where they lie.

19412.label: The tour sets off
19412.recap: The big yellow car is christened and the party rolls out of London, Audrie utterly captivated by motoring.

19412.label: Aboard the Thunderer
19412.recap: A visit to a warship at Portsmouth turns into an invitation to dine and dance, and the party grows by two.

19412.label: A birthday sunrise
19412.recap: Audrie spends her birthday morning out early with Sir Lionel and comes back to knowing looks over the breakfast table.

19412.label: A man admits something
19412.recap: Sir Lionel confesses to his friend a feeling he is determined nobody else will ever guess at, least of all the girl.

19412.label: Amber on the beach
19412.recap: A hunt for lucky amber on a Welsh shore produces a gift, an exchange and a sentence nobody gets to finish.

19412.label: A bargain honoured
19412.recap: At Newcastle Audrie goes through with something she dreads, and tells Sir Lionel only as much as she must.

19412.label: Everything explodes
19412.recap: At a Northumberland castle the whole arrangement finally comes apart, and Audrie writes her last letter about it.

19476.label: The First Cruise of the Astronef
19476.recap: Passengers on an Atlantic liner witness the maiden flight of the Astronef, the first ship able to sail through space.

19476.label: A Courtship Aloft
19476.recap: Lord Redgrave's courtship of the American heiress Zaidie unfolds under her watchful chaperone's eye.

19476.label: The Honeymoon Begins
19476.recap: Newly wed, Redgrave and Zaidie set off from Washington on a honeymoon voyage among the worlds.

19476.label: The Moon
19476.recap: Their first landfall is the dead, airless Moon, where they explore the ruins of a world that has been.

19476.label: Toward Venus
19476.recap: The Astronef crosses a hundred million miles of space toward the cloud-wrapped planet Venus.

19476.label: The Morning Star
19476.recap: On Venus the travellers find a paradise world and marvel at its gentle inhabitants.

19476.label: Across the Asteroids
19476.recap: Crossing the belt of asteroids, the voyagers press on toward the giant planet Jupiter.

19476.label: Ganymede
19476.recap: They spend a remarkable week on Ganymede, one of Jupiter's great moons.

19476.label: Beyond Saturn
19476.recap: Far past Saturn, a sudden failure of the instruments warns of unexpected danger.

19476.label: Homeward
19476.recap: Their perilous voyage among the planets draws to a close, and the wanderers turn at last for home.

19742.label: The garret door ajar
19742.recap: Barrie finds the forbidden stairway unlocked for once and takes her chance to climb it.

19742.label: The barricaded corner
19742.recap: She scrambles over a wall of junk to reach a set of furniture somebody meant nobody to see.

19742.label: Caught in the attic
19742.recap: The housekeeper stumbles on her and reacts strangely, and then a tapping stick is heard on the stairs.

19742.label: Grandmother's version
19742.recap: Alone with her granddaughter, Mrs. MacDonald finally tells her own account of the family's old scandal.

19742.label: Night train at Carlisle
19742.recap: A traveller steps off the late train and is stopped by a girl with something she wants to sell.

19742.label: An unexpected guest
19742.recap: Aline waits at the garden gate for the man she has been hoping for, and gets a surprise instead.

19742.label: An invitation offered
19742.recap: Somerled comes back from an errand and proposes what should be done with the girl nobody has a plan for.

19742.label: Gretna Green in costume
19742.recap: The travellers stop at the famous marriage village and find a film crew short of its two principals.

19742.label: The road north
19742.recap: The car runs on through Galloway while Barrie tries to coax her knight out of his ordinary manner.

19742.label: The Edinburgh hotel
19742.recap: A celebrated actress unveils at the hotel desk while the whole party watches from across the hall.

19742.label: A confession begun
19742.recap: Barrie takes up her notebook again to set down honestly what the last days of the heather moon were like.

19742.label: The island at last
19742.recap: The story closes on the ancestral castle and on what became of everybody in it.

19771.label: The House of Armine
19771.recap: We learn the history of the proud but debt-burdened Armine family and the sheltered upbringing of young Ferdinand.

19771.label: A Reverie at Ducie
19771.recap: Smitten Captain Ferdinand Armine longs to stay on at Ducie, under the same roof as the lovely Henrietta Temple.

19771.label: Parting
19771.recap: The secretly betrothed lovers must part, and Ferdinand feels the deep melancholy of separation.

19771.label: Henrietta's Letter
19771.recap: Uneasy and kept in the dark, Henrietta writes begging Ferdinand to be honest about why they stay apart.

19771.label: A Slow Recovery
19771.recap: Gravely ill after the crisis, Ferdinand slowly mends under his family's anxious care.

19771.label: Lord Montfort
19771.recap: The patient, generous Lord Montfort courts the heartsick Henrietta, trusting that time will win her.

19771.label: The Value of Money
19771.recap: Hounded by debt and a match he never wanted, Ferdinand begins to see how money threatens his love.

19771.label: Count Mirabel
19771.recap: The brilliant Count Mirabel takes up Ferdinand's cause amid the glitter of fashionable London.

19771.label: A Happy Ending
19771.recap: With every obstacle swept away, Ferdinand and Henrietta are united at last with all their friends' blessing.

20121.label: Summoned upstairs
20121.recap: A junior diplomat runs a gauntlet of gleeful colleagues on his way in to see the Secretary of State about an article he published anonymously.

20121.label: The assignment
20121.recap: He learns the previous ambassador to a cattle-ranching planet has been killed, and that three impossible tasks are being handed to him along with the post.

20121.label: The sealed orders
20121.recap: Once the ship jumps, he opens his sealed packet and reads the parting words left by every ambassador who held the job before him.

20121.label: The sealed trunk
20121.recap: The trunk shipped with his orders holds local costume, high-heeled boots, and a gunbelt he is ordered to wear at all times.

20121.label: Arrival on New Texas
20121.recap: He lands on the meat-exporting planet and is bundled away from the crowd, and from a girl he wanted to speak to, by his own frantic staff.

20121.label: Presenting credentials
20121.recap: He is formally accredited by a nervous local Secretary of State and led out into a plaza-sized barbecue to meet the President.

20121.label: Court of Political Justice
20121.recap: From a balcony he watches a New Texan court hear a case arising from the death of a senator, and begins to grasp how the planet handles its politicians.

20121.label: Council at the embassy
20121.recap: Back at the embassy he assembles his staff and admits how little briefing he was actually given.

20121.label: Out at the ranch
20121.recap: He spends a day flying over the range with a rancher's daughter while his men go looking for information in a rough village.

20121.label: The big trial opens
20121.recap: Crowds, tanks, and giant screens fill the plaza as the trial of his predecessor's killers begins.

20121.label: Nothing stipulated
20121.recap: The defense refuses to stipulate anything at all, which suits the ambassador's private plans far better than anyone in the room realizes.

20121.label: The reckoning
20121.recap: The ambassador walks out into the cleared floor of the courtroom to settle his predecessor's death himself.

20203.label: A Boston Boyhood
20203.recap: Franklin recalls his Boston childhood and his apprenticeship in his brother's printing house.

20203.label: Arrival in Philadelphia
20203.recap: Hungry and shabby, the runaway Franklin walks into Philadelphia munching a great puffy roll.

20203.label: Business and Public Service
20203.recap: His printing business thriving, Franklin takes his first steps into Philadelphia's public life.

20203.label: Thirteen Virtues
20203.recap: Franklin embarks on his famous project of moral perfection, charting his progress against thirteen virtues.

20203.label: Civic Projects
20203.recap: Settled and prosperous, Franklin throws himself into civic projects: an academy, a hospital, the defense of the province.

20203.label: The Frontier
20203.recap: At the governor's request Franklin takes charge of the frontier, raising troops and building forts against attack.

20439.label: A question in the mill
20439.recap: An eleven-year-old asks her father why the ablest weaver in his cotton mill cannot be made overseer, and is not satisfied by his reply.

20439.label: To listen and to learn
20439.recap: At a temperance convention a woman delegate is publicly told she may not speak, so she walks out and holds a meeting of her own that night.

20439.label: The bloomer year
20439.recap: Petitioning door to door in a much-mocked short dress, she endures a year of jeering and privately decides she has had enough of dress reform.

20439.label: News from Kansas
20439.recap: With a brother settled near Osawatomie, the family waits on newspaper reports of the bloody fighting over slavery out west.

20439.label: Mobbed city to city
20439.recap: An antislavery speaking tour meets hissing crowds, torn banners and meetings broken up in every city on the route.

20439.label: Hiding a runaway wife
20439.recap: She takes a mother and daughter to New York in disguise and spends a long night hunting for anyone willing to shelter them.

20439.label: A war she cannot cheer
20439.recap: When war comes and her fellow reformers rally to it, her Quaker convictions leave her isolated among her closest allies.

20439.label: Told to wait her turn
20439.recap: An influential editor tells her to drop the demand for women and wait, and she decides she will not wait.

20439.label: Registering at the barber shop
20439.recap: Reading a newspaper call to register, she puts on her bonnet, collects her sisters and walks into the ward's polling place to claim a ballot.

20439.label: On trial in Canandaigua
20439.recap: She studies the judge and the all-male jury who will decide whether her vote was a crime, and listens to her counsel argue the law.

20439.label: Campaigning in the West
20439.recap: With state after state voting suffrage down, she keeps lecturing across the young western states where she believes the ground is better.

20439.label: The last weeks
20439.recap: At home she asks a promise of the woman she has chosen to follow her, and looks past her own lifetime to the work still ahead.

20546.label: Tea on the terrace
20546.recap: A party of London guests take tea in the gardens of an old moated house while their hostess plans the evening's drive to a neighbour's dance.

20546.label: Dinner and the ruby
20546.recap: At dinner the guests press a famous traveller to explain the great ruby he wears, and he gives way with visible reluctance.

20546.label: A scream upstairs
20546.recap: His story is cut short by a woman's shriek from overhead, followed by the report of a firearm, and the men leave the table at a run.

20546.label: The lighted bedroom
20546.recap: The first man upstairs finds the door gaping and the room undisturbed except for the figure on the bed, and there is no weapon anywhere.

20546.label: Scotland Yard arrives
20546.recap: The next morning a celebrated superintendent, the chief constable and the local police gather in the library to hear what is known.

20546.label: A day of fruitless search
20546.recap: A whole day spent searching house, moat, woods and village turns up nothing, and the superintendent broods over a crime with no motive and no clue.

20546.label: The missing brooch
20546.recap: A young detective returns to the library convinced that a missing brooch is the starting point, while his chief prepares to take the hunt to London.

20546.label: Building the case
20546.recap: With an arrest made, the superintendent sets about proving a motive, and finds the servants' testimony stubbornly unhelpful.

20546.label: The private detective
20546.recap: A famous private investigator is introduced in his lonely rooms above Ludgate Circus, and receives a late visitor with a request.

20546.label: A call at Scotland Yard
20546.recap: At the end of a maddening day the superintendent receives the private detective, who wants to talk about the Heredith case.

20546.label: Hatton Garden inquiry
20546.recap: The trail leads to the back office of a jewel dealer in Hatton Garden, and a conversation about stones and the people who sell them.

20546.label: The last dinner
20546.recap: Over an uncomfortable dinner the detective at last sets out everything he has learned, and the long evening brings the case to its end.

20628.label: A plan for Marion
20628.recap: Vee decides that a neighbour trapped between poverty and an unwanted suitor needs rescuing, and drafts Torchy into it.

20628.label: Called a bomb-proofer
20628.recap: A visiting major sneers at Torchy for sitting out the war at a desk, and Torchy goes straight to his boss about it.

20628.label: A quiet man from Washington
20628.recap: Old Hickory introduces a mild, sleepy-eyed government man who has heard that Torchy knows the town.

20628.label: Outside the Maison Noir
20628.recap: Waiting for Vee outside a dress shop, Torchy falls into talk with a lonely lumberman from Seattle.

20628.label: The gentleman farmer
20628.recap: Auntie's sniff at the vegetable garden pushes Torchy into an ambitious food-production scheme he barely understands.

20628.label: The assistant auditor
20628.recap: Ernie Sudders, the most correct man in the Corrugated offices, is introduced just before something unlikely happens to him.

20628.label: A winter cruise
20628.recap: Babe Cutler tries to talk Mr. Robert into chartering a yacht for a lazy winter in the West Indies.

20628.label: Talk in the bond room
20628.recap: Spring gets into the bond-room clerks, who hold forth confidently on love and everything else.

20628.label: A visitor from Atlanta
20628.recap: Vee's old school friend, bored by a deaf aunt on Madison Avenue, is swept out to Harbor Hills.

20628.label: Standing in for the boss
20628.recap: Torchy contrasts his own taste for surprises with Piddie's dread of them, just before a dizzying turn of his own.

20628.label: A missing playwright
20628.recap: Word arrives that a Broadway lyricist has disappeared, and Torchy is entirely unmoved by the news.

20628.label: Suspicions about Vincent
20628.recap: The gloomy office manager decides the fair-haired office boy needs watching, and Torchy is not convinced.

21027.label: The bill is found
21027.recap: A grand jury returns a true bill accusing eight men of conspiring to spread false news of Napoleon's death in order to move the public funds.

21027.label: The prosecution opens
21027.recap: Counsel asks the jury to put aside everything they have heard and explains why circulating false news is treated as a crime.

21027.label: Why the moment mattered
21027.recap: The court is reminded how anxiously England waited on news from France in the winter of 1814.

21027.label: The officer at Dover
21027.recap: A man in scarlet and gold knocks at a Dover inn after midnight with glorious news he wants sent on to the port admiral.

21027.label: Cockades and laurel
21027.recap: A second carriage parades through the City scattering handbills, and the funds climb again before doubts set in.

21027.label: The defence answers
21027.recap: Counsel for three of the accused accepts the gravity of the charge and turns to what the evidence really shows about his clients.

21027.label: Following the banknotes
21027.recap: The defence works through the paper trail of notes passing between the defendants, arguing it proves only ordinary lending.

21027.label: The judge sums up
21027.recap: The Lord Chief Justice explains what conspiracy means in law and begins going through the evidence witness by witness.

21027.label: The jury withdraws
21027.recap: The jury is told to decide whether the parties acted on one common plan, and retires to consider.

21027.label: Moving for judgment
21027.recap: Prosecuting counsel presses the court for punishment, dwelling on the public trust the defendants held.

21027.label: Sentence pronounced
21027.recap: The court declines to measure justice differently for different men and delivers its fines and imprisonments.

21091.label: A Liverpool birth
21091.recap: The subject's own fragment of memoir opens the book, with his birth, his godparents, and the border and merchant stock he came from.

21091.label: Eton
21091.recap: Six years at a school of daily fistfights, wholesale flogging, no science and almost no religion, which he loved for the rest of his life.

21091.label: Christ Church
21091.recap: He goes up to Oxford, takes rooms in a fashionable staircase, and settles into a college of rowdyism, laconic dons, and rising academic ambition.

21091.label: A speech at the Union
21091.recap: A three-night Union debate on the Reform bill, in which his own long speech astonishes everyone who hears it.

21091.label: Italy and the Church
21091.recap: Six months of travel abroad, and in Rome and Naples a shift in his idea of the Church that colours everything that follows.

21091.label: First speech
21091.recap: An attack in the House on his father's Demerara estates forces the young member to his feet for fifty minutes, and the House takes to him.

21091.label: Under Peel
21091.recap: Peel forms his great conservative government, and the junior minister finds himself among men of mark and buried in trade returns.

21091.label: Maynooth
21091.recap: Peel's plan to endow the Irish catholic seminary raises a storm of bigotry and sets Gladstone's conscience against his own office.

21091.label: Naples
21091.recap: A family journey to southern Italy turns into an inspection of courts and dungeons that quietly rearranges his politics.

21091.label: Downing Street
21091.recap: He moves into the chancellor's house, wrangles politely with his predecessor over the furniture and the robe, and sets to work on the finances.

21091.label: A government falls
21091.recap: Mismanagement of the war destroys the coalition, and a long ministerial crisis breaks up the group he belonged to.

21091.label: Crossing over
21091.recap: Back from abroad into a confused parliament of rival leaders, he takes the step with which this volume closes.

21092.label: Homeward on the monorail
21092.recap: Three exhausted cadets board a monorail back to Space Academy after leave and run straight into two hostile passengers.

21092.label: New orders
21092.recap: Their instructor tells them their next assignment is to fly their ship to a huge solar fair and show visitors through her.

21092.label: The time capsule
21092.recap: Before a crowd of a hundred thousand, a capsule packed with everything mankind knows is lowered into a concrete pit.

21092.label: Two men in a hurry
21092.recap: Two roughnecks scramble aboard an old freighter, congratulate each other on something they have taken, and refit her for speed.

21092.label: Up from the shaft
21092.recap: The cadets haul an unconscious friend hand over hand out of a deep shaft hidden beneath a fairground shack.

21092.label: The search comes up empty
21092.recap: Weeks of patrol sweeps turn up nothing, and the commander proposes hunting the foxes by dressing as foxes.

21092.label: Spaceman's Row
21092.recap: Disguised as merchant spacemen, the captain and his cadet work a scar-faced stranger in a dockside dive for a lead.

21092.label: An old spaceman's kitchen
21092.recap: On Venus the team calls on a retired spaceman who refuses to talk business until everyone has been fed.

21092.label: Attack on the prison rock
21092.recap: A raider slips through the radar screen and pounds a penal asteroid's defences while the cadets take cover in the open fields.

21092.label: Baiting the trap
21092.recap: A payroll run is set up as a lure, with the captain volunteering to fly the decoy freighter entirely alone.

21092.label: Bound for Ganymede
21092.recap: Locked in a ship's brig as it accelerates toward a small colony, the cadets work out exactly what will be demanded of them.

21092.label: Full emergency thrust
21092.recap: Tracking a faint hidden beacon, the captain drives a cruiser toward Jupiter's moon under orders to engage at all costs.

21339.label: Sorting fact from legend
21339.recap: The editor opens a long memoir by clearing away the tall tales that had gathered around Behn's life.

21339.label: Sent to Antwerp
21339.recap: Behn is despatched abroad as an agent, tasked with cultivating a contact and sending back intelligence.

21339.label: Petitions and debt
21339.recap: Unpaid for her service, she writes pleading letters and faces imprisonment for debt.

21339.label: Two sisters at carnival
21339.recap: In Naples, one sister refuses the husband her father has chosen and the other refuses the convent.

21339.label: The price on the portrait
21339.recap: A famous courtesan summons the man who tore down her advertised picture and expects an apology.

21339.label: A very obliging lady
21339.recap: A rich English squire is welcomed into a strange house by a woman who says she wants nothing but his love.

21339.label: The captain in Madrid
21339.recap: The rover turns up in Spain, broke as ever, and asks at once after the woman who unsettles him.

21339.label: A sleeping fortune
21339.recap: A fortune-hunter, alone with his intended bride and her jewels, talks himself in and out of theft.

21339.label: Two friends after a storm
21339.recap: Old comrades meet by chance in Spain and compare the marriages and mistresses waiting for them.

21339.label: Soldiers in the street
21339.recap: With the old regime collapsing, soldiers and tradesmen brawl over which faction they are shouting for.

21339.label: A good night's work
21339.recap: The turncoats are rounded up, mocked and carried off, and the company toasts the restored order.

21348.label: A Boston boyhood
21348.recap: The family's arrival in Boston, and a restless boy taken out of school and bound apprentice to his brother.

21348.label: A stranger in Philadelphia
21348.recap: Arriving with almost nothing, he finds work as a printer and attracts the notice of the province's governor.

21348.label: The subscription library
21348.recap: He starts the long run of civic schemes that make him one of the town's foremost citizens.

21348.label: Sent to London
21348.recap: The Assembly sends him across the Atlantic to argue a long-running quarrel over who should pay taxes.

21348.label: Home at fifty-six
21348.recap: Back in Philadelphia he hopes for a quiet life of science and public affairs will not let him have it.

21348.label: Back across the ocean
21348.recap: He sails for England again on a narrow errand that a new tax law quickly swallows whole.

21348.label: Questioned by Parliament
21348.recap: Summoned to the bar of the Commons, he is examined for days by friendly and hostile members alike.

21348.label: The Hutchinson letters
21348.recap: Private letters he forwards to Boston are printed against his pledge, and the blame swings back toward him.

21348.label: The scene at the Cockpit
21348.recap: He stands through a hearing arranged as entertainment, listening to a solicitor-general abuse him.

21348.label: War at home
