21348.recap: He lands to find fighting already begun and is at once loaded with more work than ever before.

21348.label: Minister in Paris
21348.recap: Fêted in France, he works toward an alliance while bad news and quarrelsome colleagues press on him.

21348.label: Feeling out a peace
21348.recap: Quiet approaches from England begin arriving, nearly all of them addressed to him personally.

21348.label: Last years at home
21348.recap: He returns to Philadelphia at seventy-nine, is immediately put back to work, and lives out his final years.

21500.label: A daughter, not a son
21500.recap: A princess is born at Greenwich into a contested marriage, to a king and country who had been hoping for a boy.

21500.label: A boy king, a bold uncle
21500.recap: Her father's death changes her position entirely and places the teenage Elizabeth in a household with dangerous ambitions around her.

21500.label: A sister's short kindness
21500.recap: Her sister's accession brings a show of affection that quickly cools, and a newly released young earl makes matters worse.

21500.label: The people's queen
21500.recap: Her own accession is greeted with extraordinary public joy, and she begins choosing the councillors who will serve her.

21500.label: Suitors and a scandal
21500.recap: A successful campaign in Scotland runs alongside a crowd of suitors, and her master of horse loses his wife in circumstances nobody can explain.

21500.label: Who comes after
21500.recap: The question of the succession splits her council, and a secret marriage among her cousins is punished with unexpected severity.

21500.label: A rival across the border
21500.recap: Disaster in Scotland drives the rival queen out of her own kingdom and into English hands, and Elizabeth must decide what to do with her.

21500.label: Suspicion at court
21500.recap: Holding the Scottish queen prisoner brings years of fear and jealousy, until even her most faithful servants fall under suspicion.

21500.label: Plots traced home
21500.recap: Her temper hardens against dissenters and Catholics alike, conspiracies are traced to their source, and the long question of her captive kinswoman comes to a head.

21500.label: The Armada summer
21500.recap: With Spain preparing to invade, she appoints her commanders and rides out to the camp at Tilbury to address the army herself.

21500.label: Ireland and a favourite
21500.recap: With Ireland in revolt, she gives the command to the young favourite who had argued loudest about how it ought to be handled.

21500.label: A confession and a ring
21500.recap: A dying countess asks to see the queen and makes a confession that seems to explain the melancholy of her final weeks.

21638.label: The President falls
21638.recap: A news-gatherer in a future New York watches the President shot dead in front of a crowd of a hundred and fifty thousand.

21638.label: The doctor's secret
21638.recap: Shut inside a shielded room, Dr. Brende explains what his life's research has finally produced and why he believes someone means to take it.

21638.label: The spy in the house
21638.recap: The household's trusted maid is caught at the instruments, and the family finds their way off the island suddenly narrowed.

21638.label: Taken at the laboratory
21638.recap: The northward flight ends badly: the travellers are overpowered, and a courteous, shifty officer named Argo carries them off by air.

21638.label: Meeting the conqueror
21638.recap: The prisoners are brought before Tarrano himself, a small, soft-spoken man whose presence makes grown men feel like children.

21638.label: An offer and a refusal
21638.recap: Tarrano lays out his terms in a tower room, and Elza discovers the one small power she holds over him.

21638.label: A break for the balcony
21638.recap: Georg gambles on a moment when the barrier is down, and the whole city wakes to alarm lights and sirens behind him.

21638.label: Arrival at Venus
21638.recap: Carried across space, Jac watches Venus swell from a silver crescent into a green, luxuriant world and lands in its Great City.

21638.label: The Water Festival
21638.recap: Amid music, diving girls and colour bombs, Jac slowly works out that something deliberate is moving underneath the merry-making.

21638.label: The palace besieged
21638.recap: A mob presses at the palace steps and Georg turns a weapon on them that he can barely control.

21638.label: Night in the City of Ice
21638.recap: Far north in Tarrano's ice palace, Elza is woken in the small hours by a confession he says he would make to no one else.

21638.label: The last assault
21638.recap: Flying men, towers and rays are thrown against Tarrano's ice city, and the long contest between three worlds and one man is settled.

21700.label: The poet picks a hero
21700.recap: The narrator complains that the age produces no hero worth the name and settles instead on an old friend from the pantomime.

21700.label: Restless in the woods
21700.recap: Sixteen and lovesick, Juan wanders alone among the cork trees turning philosophical and losing track of the hours.

21700.label: A search by candlelight
21700.recap: A jealous husband bursts into his wife's bedroom at midnight with lackeys, swords and an attorney, and ransacks the room.

21700.label: The ship goes down
21700.recap: The pumps fail in a gale far from any shore, and the crew scramble for the boats with what little food can be saved.

21700.label: Found on the shore
21700.recap: A young island heiress walking at sunset finds a half-drowned stranger and hides him in a sea-cave with her maid.

21700.label: An island idyll
21700.recap: The poet returns to the sleeping pair and digresses at length on love, marriage and the fate of first passions.

21700.label: A change of clothes
21700.recap: In a palace by the Bosphorus an old servant orders Juan into women's dress and flatly refuses to explain why.

21700.label: The army moves
21700.recap: The poet weighs the true price of glory as an army marches out under cover of night and thick mist.

21700.label: Favour at court
21700.recap: Juan is found prospering at a northern court, and the poet pointedly declines to follow him past the drawing-room.

21700.label: Welcome to England
21700.recap: In the middle of praising English safety aloud, Juan is stopped on the road outside London by men with a knife.

21700.label: Society at the Abbey
21700.recap: A high-born English hostess is introduced, and a house party of titled guests assembles in the country.

21700.label: Morning after
21700.recap: The poet refuses to say what happened by moonlight, and the household comes down pale and shaken to breakfast.

21765.label: Chaos into order
21765.recap: A god pulls the elements apart out of a formless mass and gives the world its shape.

21765.label: The waters let loose
21765.recap: Angered by human wickedness, Jupiter chooses water rather than fire and the rivers are opened.

21765.label: The chase in the woods
21765.recap: Struck by a small god's arrow, Apollo pursues a nymph who wants nothing at all to do with love.

21765.label: A boy asks for the chariot
21765.recap: A young man climbs to his father's blazing palace and asks for the one gift his father dreads to grant.

21765.label: The hidden valley
21765.recap: A hunter calls off his day's sport and wanders by accident into a grotto sacred to a goddess.

21765.label: The face in the water
21765.recap: A youth who has scorned every admirer stops to drink at an untouched spring and sees something there.

21765.label: Whispers through the wall
21765.recap: Two young neighbours forbidden to marry find a crack between their houses and plan to meet outside the city.

21765.label: The chained princess
21765.recap: A winged traveller flying over Ethiopia sees a girl bound to a rock and stops to ask why.

21765.label: The weaving contest
21765.recap: A famous mortal weaver refuses to admit she owes her skill to the goddess of the craft, and issues a challenge.

21765.label: An ill-omened wedding
21765.recap: A Thracian king marries an Athenian princess under omens that promise nothing good.

21765.label: A princess argues with herself
21765.recap: As foreign heroes demand the golden fleece, the king's daughter debates whether to betray her father for a stranger.

21765.label: A word misheard
21765.recap: A hunter's habit of calling out to the cooling breeze is carried home to his wife as gossip.

21767.label: Matchmaking over tea
21767.recap: Two married friends spend an afternoon trying to find a husband for a young heiress who only laughs at them.

21767.label: Nothing at all to do
21767.recap: Bored and friendless, Agatha walks out to visit Emma and is drawn into an outing to see the bears.

21767.label: A first love-letter
21767.recap: She lies awake half the night composing answers to a letter that asked for none.

21767.label: A little business
21767.recap: Agatha sends for her trustee and, with great calm, settles a matter on which her whole life turns.

21767.label: An odd request
21767.recap: On the wedding morning the bridegroom asks, quite improperly, to speak with the bride before the ceremony.

21767.label: A week at Brighton
21767.recap: One week married, Agatha sits at a seaside window and finds the honeymoon nothing like the word.

21767.label: Across the moors
21767.recap: The couple arrive in bleak wintry Dorsetshire to be presented to his family.

21767.label: Alone in Anne's room
21767.recap: Shut away for hours, Agatha faces a suspicion about why she was married at all.

21767.label: Not at home
21767.recap: After weeks of refusing every caller, she is given no choice about one visitor.

21767.label: The house in uproar
21767.recap: A sudden collapse throws the household into panic, and the youngest woman there takes charge of it.

21767.label: Down to Southampton
21767.recap: Word of a disaster at sea sends the family hurrying to the coast for news.

21767.label: Christmas morning
21767.recap: One household stays away from church, and a long-guarded feeling is finally spoken aloud.

21986.label: Two babies in Agra
21986.recap: A sergeant's clever wife sits watching two month-old infants asleep side by side, her own and her captain's.

21986.label: An impossible question
21986.recap: The nurse admits she can no longer tell the two babies apart, and the household must decide what to do about it.

21986.label: Sixteen and inseparable
21986.recap: Years later two schoolboys set off for term while their parents privately admit how little their arrangement has settled.

21986.label: A stranger at the football
21986.recap: A woman in new black clothes watches the boys' matches day after day and quietly asks which of them is which.

21986.label: Alone in London
21986.recap: A boy takes the night train to the capital, pawns his watch and chain, and hunts for cheap lodgings.

21986.label: Trumpeter Smith
21986.recap: A young recruit's cricket and obvious schooling make him a subject of curiosity throughout his cavalry regiment.

21986.label: Landing on the Red Sea
21986.recap: British troops disembark near the coast and wait among the sand-hills for the advance inland to begin.

21986.label: Hunting for the wells
21986.recap: The desert column halts on stony ground and searches for the water it has been promised.

21986.label: Lost from the column
21986.recap: After a punishing night march, exhausted stragglers are scattered across the scrub still short of the river.

21986.label: A captive's fate debated
21986.recap: Held in a river town, a prisoner listens through a wall while his captors argue furiously over what to do with him.

21986.label: Riding out disguised
21986.recap: Rupert leaves the army camp with hired guides and a string of camels, dressed and stained as a native traveller.

21986.label: The long way home
21986.recap: Debts to the desert guides are settled, a telegram arrives, and the travellers turn at last toward England.

21990.label: A warning to the colonies
21990.recap: Congress warns the governors that the coming season will probably settle the fate of America.

21990.label: The city in 1776
21990.recap: A walk through the small arrow-shaped town at the tip of Manhattan and the works thrown up to defend it.

21990.label: The two armies
21990.recap: An account of who the American soldiers were, where they came from, and what was being gathered against them.

21990.label: The landing
21990.recap: Fifteen thousand troops are rowed ashore on Long Island in a single morning, watched only by pickets and farmers.

21990.label: Word reaches camp
21990.recap: News that a column has come through the unguarded pass arrives at the same moment as the enemy themselves.

21990.label: Holding the road
21990.recap: Cut off on the right, one brigadier covers his men's escape across a marsh with a handful of Marylanders.

21990.label: Crossing the East River
21990.recap: In rain, wind and darkness the whole army is ferried off Long Island in every boat that could be found.

21990.label: Kip's Bay
21990.recap: Warships open fire on the East River shore and the troops there break before the landing boats even touch land.

21990.label: Digging in at Harlem
21990.recap: The army fortifies the high ground above the Harlem River with three lines of works and a great fort.

21990.label: On the Delaware
21990.recap: The year's losses are counted up while the remnant of the army camps on a river bank and waits for an opening.

21990.label: The campaign closes
21990.recap: The last manoeuvres of the year upset the British plans and change how the war is discussed on both sides of the Atlantic.

22066.label: The county gathers
22066.recap: A Virginia county town crowds around its courthouse in December 1860 to hear resolutions read aloud about the state of the Union.

22066.label: Home at Three Oaks
22066.recap: Richard Cleave rides home to his mother's fireside and admits he believes the woman he loves prefers a wealthier suitor.

22066.label: Mail at Greenwood
22066.recap: At the Cary family house the mail bag brings newspapers full of Fort Sumter, and the household weighs what Virginia will do.

22066.label: Camp in the Valley
22066.recap: The 65th Virginia settles into a July camp under a stiff, lemon-sucking brigadier whom the men have not yet learned to admire.

22066.label: Guns above the turnpike
22066.recap: Confederate batteries open on the Federal position while the infantry lies waiting under shellfire on a hot hilltop.

22066.label: Winter in Winchester
22066.recap: The war's first winter fills a valley town with drilling soldiers and warehouse wards of sick recruits, while the women keep up their courage.

22066.label: Down at the dam
22066.recap: Cleave rides back from special service as troops move quietly against a canal dam on the Potomac.

22066.label: On the road from town
22066.recap: Judith Cary leaves a hospital full of fever cases and is overtaken on the spring road home by a rider she did not expect.

22066.label: The reluctant private
22066.recap: A sore and grumbling soldier drags himself through another forced march with the army the Valley has learned to call foot cavalry.

22066.label: The covered bridge
22066.recap: A strangely quiet Saturday ends with the army posted at a river village while two Federal columns close on it from both sides of the mountain.

22066.label: A crowded ward
22066.recap: Wounded after the summer's long fighting, Allan Gold lies in an overflowing Richmond ward waiting for the mountain girl who nurses him.

22066.label: Autumn at Greenwood
22066.recap: The Cary sisters gather chrysanthemums in a fading garden and talk of prisoners, shortages and the hush that has settled over the house.

22066.label: Dusk in the Wilderness
22066.recap: At six o'clock the grey lines go forward through the tangled Wilderness while the enemy's drums beat the long roll ahead of them.

22088.label: A boy's imaginings
22088.recap: He recalls childhood fancies of angels in disguise, crossing himself in the dark, and a cross drawn in an old verse book.

22088.label: Drifting at Oxford
22088.recap: Rising fast among clever men, he admits he was starting to prize brilliance over goodness until illness and a death shook him.

22088.label: Southward for his health
22088.recap: Worn out by writing, he agrees to travel to the Mediterranean with a friend and that friend's father.

22088.label: A movement begun
22088.recap: Back in England he finds friends already organising against what they see as a threat to the national church, and joins them.

22088.label: The hardest chapter
22088.recap: He steels himself to describe the change of mind that cost him his home, warning how difficult honest recollection is.

22088.label: A phrase that would not leave
22088.recap: A friend points out one Latin sentence in a review article, and it goes on sounding in his head after the friend has gone.

22088.label: The tract and the storm
22088.recap: A pamphlet on the Thirty-nine Articles sets off an enormous public row, and he prints letters showing how he felt through it.

22088.label: Watched at Littlemore
22088.recap: Retired to a country cottage, he finds sightseers in his rooms and newspapers speculating about what he is building there.

22088.label: A priest passing through
22088.recap: A travelling Passionist is asked to break his journey at Littlemore, and Newman writes a short letter to his friends that night.

22088.label: Leaving Oxford
22088.recap: He spends two last days alone in his cottage, takes leave of old friends and tutors, and remembers the snapdragon on a college wall.

22088.label: Position of my mind
22088.recap: With the story finished, he turns to explaining the settled state of his beliefs and answering the charge of dishonesty against his church.

22088.label: To his brothers
22088.recap: He signs off on a feast day and dedicates the book to the priests he lives with, naming each of them.

22094.label: The idea takes hold
22094.recap: A pamphlet read by chance in a library gives the author the notion of reaching a far desert oasis, and everyone he meets tells him he will die trying.

22094.label: Setting out by sea
22094.recap: A small coaster carries him toward Tripoli through gales fierce enough to drive the ship back to port.

22094.label: A word with the commandant
22094.recap: In the mountains he complains to a Turkish officer that soldiers have been taking the caravan's water, and gets the practice stopped.

22094.label: Arrival at the oasis
22094.recap: Worn out by the crossing, he rides into Ghadames through crowds who have been waiting two months to look at a Christian.

22094.label: The fast begins
22094.recap: The first morning of Ramadan leaves the whole city shut up and silent, and his cup of coffee scandalises the governor's servants.

22094.label: Cold weather and a feast
22094.recap: With the cold come easier nights, a beloved wandering dervish, and a slow ceremonial dance performed by the town's slaves.

22094.label: Out of the sand hills
22094.recap: Days of camels floundering in dunes end when open desert finally shows through a gap in the heaps.

22094.label: Trouble at a well
22094.recap: At a desert well a local chief takes violent exception to the traveller's presence and the caravan must bargain on his behalf.

22094.label: First sight of Ghat
22094.recap: The palms of Ghat come into view at last, but he arrives shaken and half minded to turn back.

22094.label: The Sultan comes in
22094.recap: The Touarick sultan arrives from the country, setting off a round of visits and small jealousies among the chiefs.

22094.label: With the slave caravan
22094.recap: Travelling north among a slave caravan, he hands out water and lets frightened children shelter behind his back.

22094.label: Journey's end
22094.recap: Back within sight of Tripoli after eight and a half months, he lies under a palm and adds up what the journey cost.

22163.label: Lost on Chase Mountain
22163.recap: Two brothers realise they have left the path and that their older brother is no longer answering their calls.

22163.label: A tin box in a tree
22163.recap: A curious object hanging from a branch draws one boy off the trail, and the mountainside proves to be full of hidden pits.

22163.label: Voices in the cave
22163.recap: Deep inside the mountain the brothers find stolen freight and overhear three strangers discussing a plan involving their own uncle.

22163.label: The runaway team
22163.recap: Racing to reach town before the swindlers do, the boys lose control of their horses on a storm-ruined road.

22163.label: A telephone call to the city
22163.recap: Their uncle slowly understands what has been done to him, and a long-distance call confirms the worst.

22163.label: A stray afternoon in Ithaca
22163.recap: Stranded between trains, the brothers wander into a wild west show and spot a face they recognise in the crowd.

22163.label: Down the fire escape
22163.recap: A rooftop chase through a tenement district ends with strangers, a policeman and no thief.

22163.label: Trouble at Putnam Hall
22163.recap: Back at school, a brawl on the stairs brings a teacher down on the boys and hardens an old enemy against them.

22163.label: The midnight spread
22163.recap: A secret dormitory feast is interrupted by a knock at the door and an anonymous parcel left on the floor.

22163.label: The party at the cottage
22163.recap: The cadets drive over for an evening of games and refreshments with the girls, and the night does not stay peaceful.

22163.label: Bobsleds on the hill
22163.recap: A downhill sled race against a rival crowd is won by a hair, and the loser refuses a rematch.

22163.label: The last chase
22163.recap: The brothers follow two fugitives through the brush, and an accident along the trail turns the pursuit their way.

22210.label: Arrival in India
22210.recap: The traveller lands at Bombay during a plague outbreak and works north by rail and pony to a Himalayan hill station.

22210.label: Packing for the journey
22210.recap: Rifles, cameras, plates and surveying instruments are weighed and divided into fifty-pound loads for hired porters.

22210.label: A slip on the ice
22210.recap: Cutting steps across a frozen snowfield high above a torrent, he hits hidden ice and loses his footing.

22210.label: At the frontier fort
22210.recap: A gong sounds and matchlock men turn out as the party comes in sight of a small tower-like Tibetan fort.

22210.label: Leaving Devil's Camp
22210.recap: In a blizzard at nearly seventeen thousand feet he picks out a handful of willing men and slips away past the watchers.

22210.label: Passing the brigand camp
22210.recap: Unsure whether the herders below are honest traders or robbers, he creeps down after dark to listen at their tents.

22210.label: The river crossing
22210.recap: His two yaks bolt into a swollen river and he swims after them, with heavy consequences for the baggage.

22210.label: Buying ponies
22210.recap: Villagers arrive with food and horses for sale, and he walks unarmed away from his tent to inspect one of them.

22210.label: Before the crowd
22210.recap: Dragged from a saddle in great pain, he is bound to a log while the crowd parades what has been prepared for him.

22210.label: The march back
22210.recap: An order comes down about his fate, and the prisoners are driven at speed toward the Indian frontier.

22210.label: Among friends again
22210.recap: Across a wooden bridge the prisoners gallop ahead of their guard and reach a trading camp of their own countrymen.

22210.label: Home again
22210.recap: Fed, shaved and clothed, he takes stock of his injuries, gives an official account, and begins the journey back to Europe.

22304.label: A gift in the family
22304.recap: A wood-cutter and his wife realise their boy has inherited an ancestor's gift for telling tales, and that it will take him from them.

22304.label: Firelight on the moor
22304.recap: Among shepherds camped on the northern moor, Nicanor holds the whole circle with a story until one listener objects to it.

22304.label: Learning the ivory trade
22304.recap: Apprenticed to a master ivory carver on Thorney, he learns tusk from bone and saw from burin while itching for the noise outside.

22304.label: A sale at the ford
22304.recap: At the river crossing he watches a chained girl appraised aloud and sold to an agent acting for a distant lord.

22304.label: The door in the wall
22304.recap: A long-locked door in a great villa's garden wall proves to have been quietly oiled, and an old slave notices the vines stir.

22304.label: In the lord's library
22304.recap: The villa's cold master listens to an old friend argue that Rome, sinking, needs his gold and his name.

22304.label: A match arranged
22304.recap: Stranded in Britain by delays, a Roman tribune is quietly courted by his host with hunting, luxury and rent-rolls.

22304.label: Listening at the door
22304.recap: Nicanor waits in a lamplit passage outside a closed door, savagely glad of the sounds coming through it.

22304.label: Riders at dawn
22304.recap: Refugees reach the villa with news that a coastal city has been overrun by barbarians and insurgents together.

22304.label: Across the moonlit roofs
22304.recap: While a feast fills the house, he slips through empty courts, climbs a ladder and comes out on the villa roofs.

22304.label: A rider turns aside
22304.recap: Sent on an errand to the mine, a Saxon slave keeps riding past his turning and falls in with a red-bearded stranger.

22304.label: Fighting on the sands
22304.recap: On the beach at Thorney a running fight breaks out among Saxons and soldiers, and Nicanor throws himself into it.

22342.label: A baffled FBI director
22342.recap: An agent is summoned to hear his chief complain that the whole country seems to be turning inefficient at once.

22342.label: The machines disagree
22342.recap: A technician reports that the government computers all test perfectly yet no longer agree with one another.

22342.label: Sweating in Washington
22342.recap: While colleagues grill two technicians under hot lights, Malone walks the streets to think.

22342.label: Crackpot books
22342.recap: Cut off from his usual expert, Malone decides the discredited books might be worth reading and goes looking for them.

22342.label: Three arrested spies
22342.recap: His partner cheerfully reports picking up three long-watched foreign agents, which Malone thinks was a mistake.

22342.label: Midnight stocktaking
22342.recap: Buried in paperwork at midnight, the three investigators try to line up everything they actually know.

22342.label: Vodka and caviar
22342.recap: In a Moscow restaurant a genial officer sets out to drink his American guest under the table.

22342.label: Backs to the door
22342.recap: With a crowd hammering at the door, Malone has to get two companions out of the building.

22342.label: Waking on the plane
22342.recap: Aboard the homeward flight, the young woman wakes and pieces together how she got there.

22342.label: The road south
22342.recap: Malone drives out of Washington into Virginia, thinking hard the whole way about what he has worked out.

22342.label: Four in armchairs
22342.recap: Sitting among people who have been waiting for him, Malone begins explaining the clues that led him there.

22342.label: Bourbon and self-pity
22342.recap: Alone with a drink, Malone nurses his wounded feelings until he gets company.

22400.label: Where the story begins
22400.recap: The compiler sets out his argument that the church's history is largely a history of suffering, and traces its start to the earliest deaths in Jerusalem.

22400.label: Nero and the burning city
22400.recap: Rome burns for nine days and the emperor fixes the blame on the Christians, opening the first of ten imperial persecutions.

22400.label: The Waldenses of France
22400.recap: Preachers in France begin teaching against Rome, gather a large following, and draw the first commissions of inquisitors against them.

22400.label: Inside the Inquisition
22400.recap: The roving inquisitors give way to fixed courts, and the book lays out their officers, their secrecy, and what a prisoner could expect.

22400.label: Trouble in Italy
22400.recap: An orator from Brixia preaches against corruption in Rome itself, is banished, and the Italian persecutions follow.

22400.label: John Huss of Prague
22400.recap: A Bohemian pastor and university rector takes up Wycliffe's doctrines, refuses to be silenced, and is summoned to answer at Rome.

22400.label: A disputed English crown
22400.recap: Edward VI dies, a contested succession puts Mary on the throne, and the English bishops are turned out one after another.

22400.label: The Invincible Armada
22400.recap: Philip of Spain spends three years fitting out an enormous fleet against England while Elizabeth quietly assembles her own commanders.

22400.label: The rise of the Friends
22400.recap: A shepherd's boy leaves the national church, walks the northern counties with only a Bible, and gathers the first Quaker meetings.

22400.label: A scholar on Mount Lebanon
22400.recap: A young Syrian scholar is dismissed from the patriarch's service over an intercepted letter and takes work teaching Syriac to an American missionary.

22400.label: Prisoners at Ava
22400.recap: War breaks out between Britain and Burma, the American missionaries at the capital are arrested, and one of them writes down what followed.

22400.label: Terror in Paris
22400.recap: The book closes on revolutionary France, arguing that the massacres and the guillotine were persecution wearing a new coat.

22536.label: Clothiers of Kent
22536.recap: The family line is traced through Kentish clothiers, including a widow who cleared her husband's debts and got her children schooled.

22536.label: The Hampshire rectory
22536.recap: The village, garden terrace and hedgerows where Jane grew up are described, with hints of how that landscape reappears in her novels.

22536.label: An aunt in India
22536.recap: An aunt's voyage to Bengal and the family's long friendship with Warren Hastings bring India and France into rectory conversation.

22536.label: Brothers and prospects
22536.recap: Jane's brothers are introduced, among them a scholarly eldest and one adopted by wealthy cousins into a very different life.

22536.label: Country neighbours
22536.recap: The Hampshire society of squires, peers and clerical families is sketched, along with the two households of friends the sisters cared most about.

22536.label: Talk of romance
22536.recap: A hostile secondhand description of Jane is weighed against her own letters about a flirtation and a suitor who quietly drifted away.

22536.label: First manuscripts
22536.recap: Her earliest sustained novels are dated and discussed, alongside the beginning of the surviving letters to her sister.

22536.label: The Bath relations
22536.recap: A comfortable childless uncle and aunt are introduced, with their gout, their Bath visits and their unusual devotion to each other.

22536.label: Settling at Chawton
22536.recap: The family moves to the Hampshire cottage where she would spend her remaining years and do most of her published work.

22536.label: A book that sells
22536.recap: Her first published novel sells out and earns real money, quietly changing what she can afford to attempt next.

22536.label: A London winter
22536.recap: A London visit that marks the height of her small fame coincides with the first signs of failing health and family money trouble.

22536.label: The road to Winchester
22536.recap: She agrees to move to Winchester for better medical advice, leaving Chawton in rain with her sister beside her.

22541.label: Breaking in on the boss
22541.recap: Slippery Jim diGriz picks his way into his chief's bedroom at night to wave a photograph under his nose.

22541.label: The plans don't add up
22541.recap: He explains how an ordinary freighter's blueprints match a thousand-year-old battleship to six decimal places.

22541.label: Arrival of a grand duke
22541.recap: He lands on Cittanuvo in showy disguise and tips his way straight through customs.

22541.label: Ambush in the study
22541.recap: He waits in the dark for the planet's president and confronts him with his own papers.

22541.label: The robot reports
22541.recap: The lie detector that has been holding the president by the wrist gives its verdict.

22541.label: Waking the shipyard
22541.recap: A convoy of uniforms and guns descends on the spaceyard manager in the middle of the night.

22541.label: Race to the ways
22541.recap: They tear through the dark to the shipyard to see the vessel for themselves.

22541.label: Following the paperwork
22541.recap: Seventy-two sleepless hours in the files untangle who bent an entire construction programme.

22541.label: News in the night
22541.recap: A messenger wakes him with word of a freighter found holed and emptied in deep space.

22541.label: Baiting a trap
22541.recap: He floods the newspapers of a whole sphere of worlds with a story written for exactly one reader.

22541.label: Grappled in space
22541.recap: His gilded yacht is seized and drawn against something enormous, and everything now depends on timing.

22541.label: The last laugh
22541.recap: In the captured control room the man behind the plot stops pretending and starts laughing.

22749.label: Setting out
22749.recap: The painter explains why he is going east rather than south again, and leaves Edinburgh by the night train.

22749.label: Grey seas off Portugal
22749.recap: In wet weather he daydreams about how he would paint Orpheus and the Sirens, and talks his way round the engine room.

22749.label: A blue day off Spain
22749.recap: Sun at last, Spanish grammar on deck, and drills that turn the whole ship's company out.

22749.label: Through the Canal
22749.recap: The ship threads the Suez Canal while he argues with himself about the beauty and the ugliness of Egypt.

22749.label: A night at Government House
22749.recap: Bombay turns out in uniforms and jewels for a reception, and hundreds of carriages jam the moonlit road.

22749.label: Inland to Dharwar
22749.recap: The train sets him down upcountry, where a brother meets him on the platform and the household takes them in.

22749.label: Down the Adyar River
22749.recap: An afternoon of pictures and boating outside Madras ends at the sand bar with the surf on the far side.

22749.label: Rangoon gymkhana
22749.recap: A dance in Burmah, with English hats and blue serge whirling round under a very foreign sky.

22749.label: Waiting on the river
22749.recap: The steamer holds at a river town while villagers gather to watch the royal boat come down from Mandalay.

22749.label: Outfitting at Bhamo
22749.recap: Ponies, tinned butter and live ducks in baskets are bought for a mule trek over the border.

22749.label: A fish on the frontier
22749.recap: He rests by a river between China and Upper Burmah after a morning's ride, with a good fish in the pot.

22749.label: Three white scenes
22749.recap: The journal closes by naming the three sights he holds above every other in the world.

22903.label: Ordered to the Straits
22903.recap: A frigate is sent to the Malacca Straits to protect trade and suppress piracy, and her captain meets a curious passenger.

22903.label: Who Mr. Brooke is
22903.recap: A friend's portrait explains the private gentleman who sailed east in his own yacht with a plan for the archipelago.

22903.label: One house, four hundred people
22903.recap: A river town is described where the whole population lives under a single roof hung with skulls.

22903.label: An unknown coast
22903.recap: The captain explains why the great island had kept Europeans out, and how little the charts could be trusted.

22903.label: Three prahus cornered
22903.recap: Suspected pirate boats are pinned in a bay and make an unexpected break for the open sea.

22903.label: A letter under a canopy
22903.recap: A rajah's request for help against the coast pirates is delivered in state and read aloud to a mixed audience.

22903.label: Into the river forts
22903.recap: The boats push through a barrier of stakes under fire from forts placed on the hills above.

22903.label: Guns after dark
22903.recap: Supper is broken off by carronade fire and war-yells sounding from every quarter upriver.

22903.label: Up the Undop
22903.recap: The force presses inland after a chief who keeps felling trees across the stream behind him.

22903.label: Voices in the jungle
22903.recap: Two officers step into the trees for a look and find a mass of boats hidden in an inlet.

22903.label: What piracy really is
22903.recap: Brooke sets out in his own words how eastern piracy works and what it would take to end it.

22903.label: The island explained
22903.recap: A survey of Borneo's coasts, its peoples and its history is offered to make the rest intelligible.

22903.label: A warning carried by hand
22903.recap: A man boards a warship at Bruni with urgent news and a dying friend's last request.

23172.label: A cabin inquest at night
23172.recap: Nine men are gathered in a small lamplit cabin in the wilderness, one of them dead on the table, while an official reads silently from a worn account book.

23172.label: The witness arrives
23172.recap: A young man rides in dusty from travel, is met without greeting, and trades sharp words with the coroner over an account he has already posted to his newspaper.

23172.label: Sworn and questioned
23172.recap: After being sworn and asked his name, age and reason for being present, the witness produces a written statement and begins reading it to the room.

23172.label: Out after quail
23172.recap: The statement opens with two men crossing a ridge at sunrise and hearing something thrashing in the bushes ahead of them.

23172.label: Something in the wild oats
23172.recap: The tall grass flattens in a line that moves steadily toward the two men, with nothing visible to account for it.

23172.label: Knocked off his feet
23172.recap: Thrown down in the smoke of a gunshot, the narrator scrambles up to see his companion struggling with something he cannot properly make out.

23172.label: The sheet drawn back
23172.recap: The coroner uncovers the body and holds up the torn, stiffened clothing for the jury, who have plainly seen it all before.

23172.label: The jury's verdict
23172.recap: With the witness dismissed, the foreman sits by the candle and writes out the verdict the jurors have agreed among themselves.

23172.label: Pages from a diary
23172.recap: The dead man's journal is quoted, starting with a dog behaving strangely and stars going out one by one along a ridge.

23172.label: A theory about the senses
23172.recap: The final entries build an argument from birds, whales and the spectrum about signals that fall outside the range of human perception.

23184.label: Monte-Cristo in Rome
23184.recap: The Count takes a Roman palace so his daughter can finish school, and is intrigued by a famous singer who flatly refuses to receive him.

23184.label: The convent garden
23184.recap: Zuleika argues with herself over whether to meet her young Italian admirer secretly during the evening walk.

23184.label: A crowded piazza
23184.recap: Two young friends stroll through a festive Roman square where a flower-girl catches the Viscount's eye.

23184.label: After the brigands
23184.recap: Released on the road, the two friends make for shelter, one of them faint and badly hurt in the arm.

23184.label: A scandal in the papers
23184.recap: Roman newspapers print an unnamed account of an abducted peasant girl, and the city fills with rumour.

23184.label: A year later in Paris
23184.recap: The Count's household has moved to Paris, where he has become a popular and wealthy figure in public life.

23184.label: A message at midnight
23184.recap: Waiting alone by his telegraph for a coded dispatch on a hot, still night, the Count is interrupted.

23184.label: An arrest in the street
23184.recap: The Count's carriage is halted by a crowd watching two Italians being marched off by the police.

23184.label: In the arena
23184.recap: The Morrels cross the Colosseum floor toward a wild-eyed man who stands motionless, pouring out curses.

23184.label: Into the Ghetto
23184.recap: The Count leads Morrel through the gates of Rome's Jewish quarter in search of a physician with an extraordinary reputation.

23184.label: Flight through the grove
23184.recap: Exhausted after a violent encounter, the Viscount drags himself back toward Rome, watching the trees for pursuit.

23184.label: The last chapter
23184.recap: Word of the trial's outcome runs through Rome, and the story is brought to its close.

23500.label: A forbidden homeland
23500.recap: The narrator, son of a banished Carlist general, insists on motoring to Biarritz despite his friend's warnings about the Spanish police.

23500.label: The stalled royal car
23500.recap: He stops to help a broken-down motor party on the road and cannot take his eyes off one of the young passengers.

23500.label: A masked ball
23500.recap: Uninvited and in costume, he slips into a Biarritz ball to claim a dance and speak to the girl alone.

23500.label: Warned in the garden
23500.recap: In the dark garden a rival duke tells him plainly and coldly to keep out of Spain.

23500.label: Crossing the frontier
23500.recap: The travellers race over the international bridge and try to clear the Spanish customs house before a telegram can catch them.

23500.label: Burgos cathedral
23500.recap: Wearing a borrowed officer's uniform, he is formally introduced to the girl and her guardians inside the cathedral.

23500.label: Arrival in Madrid
23500.recap: The chase reaches the capital, where he spots the rival's party waiting outside the Ministry of War.

23500.label: A rescue at dusk
23500.recap: They find the rival's car crippled by the roadside at nightfall and tow it, with a seating plan of their own choosing.

23500.label: Hired as a guitarist
23500.recap: To get inside a garden entertainment at the Alcazar, he arranges to appear among a dancing master's musicians.

23500.label: Darkness in the cathedral
23500.recap: In the crowded Holy Week gloom of Seville he separates the girl from her party for a few urgent words.

23500.label: A locked Moorish room
23500.recap: He wakes weak and drugged behind barred windows, testing the room for any way out.

23500.label: The royal bull-ring
23500.recap: Burnt and dust-covered after a long drive, he reaches the Madrid bull-ring for one last chance to be seen and heard.

23599.label: A telepathic poker game
23599.recap: Four mind-readers play a high-stakes hand of poker, each blocking and bluffing, until an unexpected visitor walks in.

23599.label: Barcelona's messenger
23599.recap: A striking woman with a cheap cigar delivers a boss's demand that three hopeless horses finish one, two, three at the Derby.

23599.label: A policeman drops by
23599.recap: A genial detective settles into the narrator's favourite chair and hints that he already knows what is being planned.

23599.label: Squeezed from both sides
23599.recap: Left alone, the narrator works out that he is trapped between a criminal's wish and a policeman's warning.

23599.label: A shabby caller
23599.recap: A muddled small-time pickpocket turns up begging for a sure thing, and the narrator sees a use for him.

23599.label: An uninvited houseguest
23599.recap: The messenger installs herself in the apartment to watch the narrator work, and asks to be called by her real name.

23599.label: How the boss stays free
23599.recap: The narrator explains why telepathy never abolished crime, and how one man keeps his thoughts behind a wall of hired noise.

23599.label: A duel of minds
23599.recap: The narrator breaks through the mental racket for a needling conversation with the man who set the trap.

23599.label: Derby Day dawns
23599.recap: The lieutenant arrives at breakfast with an absurd old statute and an invitation to watch the race from his box.

23599.label: In the box at the track
23599.recap: Everyone gathers at Churchill Downs as the odds board goes up and the crowd surges toward the betting windows.

23599.label: The board turns
23599.recap: The odds on the three hopeless horses collapse, and the narrator explains exactly what he has done and what it will cost.

23637.label: Cotton everywhere
23637.recap: An autumn in the Tennessee Valley finds the crop so heavy that the gin houses cannot swallow it.

23637.label: The master of The Gaffs
23637.recap: The owner of a fine old estate is introduced as a man of every kind of strength except the moral kind.

23637.label: An uninvited visitor
23637.recap: The mill's employment agent lets himself and his brutish dog into the house without waiting to be asked.

23637.label: Recruiting for the mill
23637.recap: The agent rides into the hills to talk families into signing their children over to the factory.

23637.label: Waiting at the rock
23637.recap: A romantic girl from a ruined house waits under a wild grape arbour for a young man to ride up.

23637.label: The drive to Westmoreland
23637.recap: A fast pair of trotters carries a visitor to a neighbouring house that is beautiful even in its decay.

23637.label: The singer's sorrow
23637.recap: A woman famous for her voice is shown to have learned it from a grief she never speaks about.

23637.label: Cottontown described
23637.recap: A New England company plants its factory in the South, and a village of identical cottages grows around it.

23637.label: The woman nobody sits by
23637.recap: A quiet mother and her proud young son leave the chapel under the whole village's disapproval.

23637.label: The great race
23637.recap: Three rich men's trotters are matched for an enormous purse before the whole valley.

23637.label: First day at the mill
23637.recap: A proud family wakes to the morning when the elder daughter must go to work among the hands.

23637.label: Waiting on the porch
23637.recap: A father sits up with a small child in his lap, uneasy because someone has not come home.

23637.label: A mill run differently
23637.recap: The old preacher preaches his plan before laying the first brick of a mill built on his own terms.

23700.label: Florence in the plague
23700.recap: The narrator describes the pestilence that empties Florence and undoes every ordinary decency of burial and neighbourliness.

23700.label: Seven ladies meet
23700.recap: Seven young women fall into conversation in a near-empty church, and the eldest argues that they should not stay in the city.

23700.label: A queen for a day
23700.recap: Settled in a country house, the company crowns a ruler for the day and parcels out the household duties among the servants.

23700.label: The first tale
23700.recap: The first storyteller opens the ten days of tale-telling with the case of a spectacularly wicked man and his deathbed confession.

23700.label: Fortune's rough handling
23700.recap: The second day turns to people knocked about by fortune, beginning with three jesters who arrive at a new saint's shrine.

23700.label: Getting what you want
23700.recap: The third day is given to people who obtain what they desire by cunning, opening with a labourer who pretends he cannot speak.

23700.label: Loves that end badly
23700.recap: The fourth day is reserved for unhappy loves, among them a prince who takes his galleys against a ship carrying the woman he has never met.

23700.label: Love after hardship
23700.recap: The fifth day tells of lovers who come through misfortune, including a gentleman who has spent everything but one prized falcon.

23700.label: The art of the retort
23700.recap: The sixth day gathers brief tales of people rescued or repaid by one well-chosen phrase, starting with a lady and a badly told story.

23700.label: Calandrino is gulled
23700.recap: The eighth day's practical jokers go to work on a simple-minded painter who is told of a stone that makes its finder invisible.

23700.label: The patient wife
23700.recap: The last tale concerns a marquess who marries a peasant's daughter and then sets about testing how much she will bear.

23700.label: The author answers back
23700.recap: The author closes the book by answering, at length and with relish, the objections he expects his readers to make.

23731.label: Back aboard the Ares
23731.recap: Four men of the first Mars expedition crowd their cabin and demand that the chemist finally explain where he has been for ten days.

23731.label: A very long walk
23731.recap: With his auxiliary rocket dead in the desert, Jarvis straps on water and rations and sets out to cover eight hundred miles on foot.

23731.label: A noise in the dark
23731.recap: Investigating an unearthly commotion at nightfall, he finds a tall beaked creature struggling in the grip of something with black ropy arms.

23731.label: Names by firelight
23731.recap: Man and Martian sit at a fire and try to trade names, with words that refuse to stay attached to anything.

23731.label: Diagram in the sand
23731.recap: Jarvis sketches the planets to explain where he comes from, and his companion answers in a way that is either brilliant or nonsense.

23731.label: The line of pyramids
23731.recap: The pair pick up a trail of tiny brick pyramids marching across the desert, growing steadily larger as they follow it north.

23731.label: Something comes out
23731.recap: At the end of the trail the last pyramid breaks open and its occupant hauls itself into the daylight while the two travellers watch, weapons drawn.

23731.label: A face from home
23731.recap: Footsore and homesick as they near a canal, Jarvis sees someone standing among the plants who cannot possibly be there.

23731.label: Into the mound city
23731.recap: Curiosity draws the two of them down a sloping tunnel into the burrow of the barrel-shaped, cart-pushing natives.

23731.label: Lost underground
23731.recap: The entrance vanishes and the pair wander a lightless maze of corridors while the busy inhabitants ignore every appeal for help.

23731.label: Cornered at sunset
23731.recap: Driven out into the failing daylight, the two are pinned between two mounds by a gathering crowd of the barrel-creatures.

23731.label: After the telling
23731.recap: The story finished, the crew sit quietly with it before the questions start again.

23745.label: Escaping the convention
23745.recap: A young delegate bored by his own party's convention slips into an art gallery and finds himself listening to two strangers.

23745.label: Supper at Auriccio's
23745.recap: He follows the pair to a late supper and ends up the only witness to what happens behind the palms.

23745.label: A letter from Jim
23745.recap: Years on, with his political career gone stale, he receives a letter urging him West to an obscure town full of promise.

23745.label: Inside the cave
23745.recap: He is shown his new partner's office and introduced to the old settlers and characters who made the town.

23745.label: Dedicating the park
23745.recap: Between deals the partners plan a lavish open-air party to launch a new park, lake and streetcar line.

23745.label: Two figures in the moonlight
23745.recap: Lying unseen in a hammock after the dancing, the narrator overhears a conversation that reaches back years.

23745.label: Matchmaking for profit
23745.recap: A lazy Sunday in the park turns into a plan to nudge two reluctant people toward each other, for business reasons.

23745.label: The estate in the papers
23745.recap: The local paper reports on a large estate changing hands and on a partner's abrupt departure for New York.

23745.label: Playing two railroad kings
23745.recap: He goes East to sell a railway, hoping to set two rival magnates bidding against one another before money tightens.

23745.label: A run through the storm
23745.recap: With floodwater rising and sleet driving hard, they order an engine crew to reach a junction ahead of another train at any risk.

23745.label: The reckoning
23745.recap: The newspapers tell the story of that night, and then the business failures begin arriving one on top of another.

23745.label: At the bedside
23745.recap: A quiet visitor comes upstairs to sit with the injured man and says at last what she has waited years to say.

23761.label: The grocer and Greek
23761.recap: A quiet Indianapolis grocer turns his fortune to studying Greek and ends by digging where Homer said Troy stood.

23761.label: A queen shut out
23761.recap: Egypt's young joint heir is introduced as brilliant and ambitious, and finds herself banished from Alexandria.

23761.label: A boy by the Po
23761.recap: A delicate Italian boy is shaped by a spendthrift father and by long reading walks with his grandfather.

23761.label: The urge to withdraw
23761.recap: The book pauses to trace the old human impulse to leave the world for a cell, and where that impulse leads.

23761.label: A Dublin boyhood
23761.recap: Burke's plain parents, his Quaker schoolmaster and a lasting school friendship are sketched before Trinity College.

23761.label: Great men, great sons
23761.recap: A digression on inherited talent leads into the two Pitts and the son's astonishing first speech in the Commons.

23761.label: Where the fire started
23761.recap: The Revolution's debt to Voltaire and Rousseau is argued before four famous names emerge from its dust and din.

23761.label: A house full of whispers
23761.recap: A restless three-year-old in a snowbound farmhouse finds the parlour crowded with visitors in Sunday clothes.

23761.label: The widow of Hanover County
23761.recap: A lively Virginia widow weighs a porch full of suitors, among them a young red-headed Scottish schoolmaster.

23761.label: Boston Sundays
23761.recap: The author remembers the Boston preachers worth crossing town for, and what separates a thrilling sermon from a lullaby.

23761.label: What makes an orator
23761.recap: Beecher's colouring of the American mind opens an argument that an orator's faults are part of his power.

23761.label: A winter night in Illinois
23761.recap: The author recalls riding ten miles through a storm as a boy and hearing a famous speaker simply talk.

23784.label: Brockhurst
23784.recap: At the great country house of Brockhurst, the chaplain Julius March records a serene and sunlit summer.

23784.label: A Spring Outing
23784.recap: On a bright spring day a happy party sets out from the park at Brockhurst.

23784.label: Persons of Quality
23784.recap: Against his guard, Richard is drawn into the company of a glittering and dangerous set.

23784.label: A Betrayal
23784.recap: A well-meant intervention curdles into betrayal, and Honoria can no longer meet Lady Calmady's eyes.

23784.label: An Unwelcome Letter
23784.recap: A cynical letter from the worldly M. de Vallorbes brings an unwelcome reminder of debts and entanglements.

23784.label: Midsummer Dusk
23784.recap: As midsummer dusk settles over Brockhurst, Richard Calmady's long history draws toward its close.

23789.label: Bride and groom at the inn
23789.recap: A newly married couple reach a Norfolk hotel, where the bride confesses a strange dread that has settled on her spirits.

23789.label: The briefless young lawyer
23789.recap: A gifted but penniless lawyer returns to his native county to build a career, hopelessly in love with the richest heiress there.

23789.label: The heiress of Black Hall
23789.recap: Sybil is introduced as a fiery, self-willed girl of eighteen who refuses every suitor and cannot say what she wants.

23789.label: A widow's second marriage
23789.recap: The history of a beautiful young Scottish widow who married a charming stranger and handed him control of everything she had.

23789.label: Coming home to Black Hall
23789.recap: Sybil is welcomed home by servants and old friends, and plays the gracious hostess to the guest she has brought with her.

23789.label: Court term and callers
23789.recap: Court business keeps the husband busy for a season, and the household settles into an uneasy calm that cannot last.

23789.label: Alone behind a bolted door
23789.recap: Locked in a spare room, Sybil swings from grief to fury and resolves to hide everything she feels behind a smile.

23789.label: Dressing for the masquerade
23789.recap: Upstairs the maskers finish their costumes, and Sybil dresses in secret for the fancy ball she is giving.

23789.label: The first angry word
23789.recap: Husband and wife quarrel for the first time, and he keeps to the far side of the supper room while guests begin to whisper.

23789.label: Shrieks in the night
23789.recap: Long after the lights are out, screams bring the whole house running to the guest wing.

23789.label: Ride to the ruined chapel
23789.recap: In mist and darkness the pair ford the black river and cross the mountain toward a hiding place nobody visits.

23789.label: Farmer and daughter
23789.recap: Disguised as a plain old farmer and his shy girl, the two take rooms at a wharfside tavern and play their parts for the landlord.

23789.label: Watched on the road
23789.recap: An officer keeps his charge in sight through forty-five miles of travelling, and locks the bedroom door himself at night.

23789.label: Lost near home
23789.recap: Riding blind through the night on tired horses, the fugitives realise from a distant roar exactly where they have ended up.

23790.label: Loafing past Pluto
23790.recap: A bored six-man patrol cruiser drifting near Pluto picks up a badly keyed distress call from a lone miner.

23790.label: The stranger appears
23790.recap: An enormous ship materialises beside the little cruiser and answers its fire without seeming to feel it.

23790.label: Nobody believes them
23790.recap: A rescuing captain files the encounter as ordinary piracy, so the two survivors resign to force an interview with headquarters.

23790.label: The scout goes home
23790.recap: The expedition's commander carries word back to his freezing twin worlds that a steady, crowded little sun has been found.

23790.label: A bank on the Moon
23790.recap: Kendall and the commander enjoy the fiction of a heavily armoured lunar bank staffed almost entirely by retired officers.

23790.label: An accidental discovery
23790.recap: A failed experiment turns out to have stored an enormous quantity of power, and Kendall starts guessing why.

23790.label: The violet beam
23790.recap: A new weapon of concentrated ultra-violet fire is tested on an armour plate across the laboratory yard.

23790.label: The fleet sets out
23790.recap: One hundred and fifty loaded interstellar ships leave the twin worlds together and vanish into superspeed.

23790.label: Siege of an outpost
23790.recap: A defence station is caught in a spinning magnetic vortex while its stored power drains minute by minute.

23790.label: The wounded commander
23790.recap: Burned and full of doubt about his own cause, the alien leader begins hunting a new weapon from a wheelchair.

23790.label: Throwing the switch
23790.recap: Kendall powers up a machine his own mathematics insists can only produce uncertainty.

23790.label: After it all
23790.recap: A liner lands on the far world with passengers of both kinds, and news arrives of another star.

24149.label: Gifts with the milk
24149.recap: A detective keeps finding expensive presents on his doorstep and keeps giving them away, while colleagues around him quietly soften.

24149.label: The cleaning plant
24149.recap: He calls at a modest dry cleaner's to investigate an odd accident and meets its entirely unruffled owner.

24149.label: An unwelcome caller
24149.recap: A phone call interrupts the interview, and the owner calmly recites the morning's mishaps to whoever is on the other end.

24149.label: A good luck charm
24149.recap: The owner takes a slip of plastic from a strange little machine and presses it on the detective with one odd instruction.

24149.label: A twitch outside the hospital
24149.recap: Leaving four hostile patients upstairs, the detective's eyelid begins to flutter and he stops walking to rub it.

24149.label: Smashed beer cases
24149.recap: At a restaurant he counts eighteen cases of broken bottles and gets no answers from a proprietor who plainly knows who did it.

24149.label: Two men in good hats
24149.recap: Returning to the plant, he follows two well dressed strangers through the door and hears screaming from the back.

24149.label: Chaos in the workroom
24149.recap: One thrown box sets off a widening chain of collisions, spills and slides across the oiled floor.

24149.label: The explanation
24149.recap: Sitting down at last, the owner begins telling the shaken detective what has really been protecting his shop.

24149.label: A call is paid
24149.recap: With the wounded carted off, a phone call is made and the two men set out to visit the man behind all of it.

24375.label: Above the town
24375.recap: A cheerful traveller stops on a hilltop and looks down at the town he means to enter, pleased by the danger waiting there.

24375.label: Asking at the window
24375.recap: He buys directions from a suspicious old woman, who names a family with a room to spare.

24375.label: A grieving household
24375.recap: His new host takes the rent money but warns that the family is cursed and closely watched.

24375.label: A voice from far off
24375.recap: Lying awake, Jonas is reached by a distant director who reminds him how much a mistake would cost.

24375.label: Waiting and odd rituals
24375.recap: Dull days pass while he is told to be patient, and he lets the household see him doing strange things.

24375.label: Reported to the town
24375.recap: The frightened wife fetches two large men, and Jonas walks off with them without protest.

24375.label: The cell and the rats
24375.recap: Locked in a damp basement, he passes the time hunting rats and rapidly loses patience.

24375.label: Before the Inquisitor
24375.recap: Brought upstairs at last, Jonas argues that what he can do is natural rather than devilish.

24375.label: Called to ratify
24375.recap: Guards come at dawn to take him to the room where confessions are confirmed.

24375.label: A prayer in the smoke
24375.recap: With everything at stake, Jonas asks the Inquisitor to pray and to keep his mind open.

24793.label: Moonlight on the bridge
24793.recap: The young captain of a millionaire's yacht loses his self-command with the owner's daughter and expects to be ruined for it.

24793.label: Cross-signals in the fog
24793.recap: A big line steamer refuses to give way near a reef, and the captain has to throw his engines full astern to avoid being run down.

24793.label: Called to account
24793.recap: Anchored in a dungeon fog, the yacht's owner hauls his skipper over the coals for the way the encounter was handled.

24793.label: Hooked off the water
24793.recap: Snagged by the rigging of an ancient lumber schooner slipping out of harbour, Mayo climbs aboard and demands to be put ashore.

24793.label: Taking in sail
24793.recap: With a nor'easter rising, the stranded yachtsman shoulders the old schooner's crew aside, shortens sail, and then hands the wheel back to her master.

24793.label: Bugs under a thimble
24793.recap: Trapped in the air pocket of a capsized hull, Mayo hunts for tools in the flooded lazaret while the others give themselves up for lost.

24793.label: A sail on the horizon
24793.recap: Sun-parched survivors watch two distant craft close on them and argue about whether either will bother to look twice.

24793.label: The island crew's first fare
24793.recap: A despised island community, given a schooner and honest treatment at the fish docks, throws itself into the work with startling results.

24793.label: Down the East River
24793.recap: A big passenger steamer feels her way out through fog and river traffic, every whistle in the harbour talking at once.

24793.label: A coal schooner in the blow
24793.recap: Aboard an overloaded five-master riding out a summer easterly, the mates trade uneasy talk about how badly the old hull is racked.

24793.label: Freeing the long-boat
24793.recap: Mayo throws himself against the boat to work it out of its chocks, gets a sea-anchor over, and drives two frightened men to bail.

24793.label: A question on the road
24793.recap: A discovery in a village store sends Mayo running after someone he has been slow to understand, with one plain question to ask.

24869.label: A question to the sage
24869.recap: A hermit asks the wandering sage who in all the world is truly virtuous, and is given a name.

24869.label: Into the haunted wood
24869.recap: At a hermit's bidding the young prince takes up his bow against the monster that terrorises the forest.

24869.label: The bow no man can bend
24869.recap: A king has an ancient bow carried in that nobody has ever managed to lift, and invites the visiting princes to try.

24869.label: News on the terrace
24869.recap: A handmaid looks out over a city decked for festival, learns the reason, and carries her anger straight to her mistress.

24869.label: The mourner's cell
24869.recap: The king goes to his favourite queen with glad news and finds her lying on the floor of the mourning chamber.

24869.label: Leaving the city
24869.recap: Rama takes leave of his parents and sets out for the wilderness with his wife and his brother.

24869.label: Brothers in the forest
24869.recap: Sages praise the meeting of the two brothers, and Bharat begs Rama to come back and take the throne.

24869.label: A stranger at the hut
24869.recap: As the exiles sit talking under the boughs, a giantess wanders by and is struck by the sight of Rama.

24869.label: The golden deer
24869.recap: Sita calls the brothers to see a jewelled deer and begs to have it caught for her, despite a warning.

24869.label: The disguise dropped
24869.recap: The demon king throws off his borrowed shape, shows his true size, and presses his suit on Sita.

24869.label: A challenge answered
24869.recap: A monkey king brushes aside his wife's warning and strides out of the city to meet his brother's challenge.

24869.label: The leap over the sea
24869.recap: The Vanar chief prays to the wind and the sun, then springs from the mountain out across the ocean.

24869.label: The kingdom restored
24869.recap: Bharat hands back the realm he has been holding in trust and asks that the long-delayed rite be performed at last.

24950.label: Hunted in England
24950.recap: The northern congregation is watched, imprisoned and driven from its houses, and resolves to try for the Low Countries.

24950.label: Getting out of England
24950.recap: Two attempts to take ship end in betrayal and arrest, and one boatload of men is carried off without their families.

24950.label: Leaving Leyden
24950.recap: After a day of fasting the company sails from Delfshaven, parting from friends on the quay with prayers and tears.

24950.label: The Atlantic crossing
24950.recap: The ship meets fierce storms, a main beam cracks, and the passengers argue with the mariners about turning back.

24950.label: Searching the cape
24950.recap: A small party takes the shallop along the winter coast, camps behind a barricade of logs, and hunts for a place to settle.

24950.label: An agreement and a hard winter
24950.recap: Before landing the company signs a covenant of government; within two or three months sickness carries off half of them.

24950.label: Samoset and Massasoit
24950.recap: An Indian walks in speaking English, brings back stolen tools, and opens the way to a treaty with the great sachem.

24950.label: Corn for every family
24950.recap: With no relief ship and constant hunger, the governor assigns each family its own ground to plant, and the harvest improves.

24950.label: Merrymount
24950.recap: A crafty newcomer turns out his lieutenant, sets up a maypole, and makes his plantation a byword for riot.

24950.label: The Pequot war
24950.recap: Attacks on the Connecticut settlements draw the colonies and their native allies into a short and savage campaign.

24950.label: The church grows old
24950.recap: So many members have moved away for better land that the church debates removing altogether, and is left thinned and elderly.

24950.label: Warships in the harbour
24950.recap: Three privateers put in with eighty unruly men aboard, and the record breaks off not long after.

25001.label: A letter after breakfast
25001.recap: A settled country gentleman reads that a dead friend's daughter has been left alone in the world, and walks up and down deciding what to do about her.

25001.label: The shape of a life
25001.recap: The narrator sketches the quiet disappointments that made the master of Croker's Hall the man he now is.

25001.label: Describing Mary Lawrie
25001.recap: A portrait of the reserved, watchful young woman who has come to live under his roof.

25001.label: A question on the lawn
25001.recap: Over coffee after dinner, Mr Whittlestaff asks Mary whether she could bring herself to become his wife.

25001.label: Telling the housekeeper
25001.recap: Mary carries her news downstairs, and the housekeeper receives it with tears, scolding and threats to pack her bags.

25001.label: Back from the diamond fields
25001.recap: A young man who went to Kimberley to make himself rich enough to marry returns to England and arrives at the door.

25001.label: Alone in the parlour
25001.recap: Left by themselves, Mary refuses the visitor even a single kind word and holds to the promise she has given.

25001.label: A scene in the road
25001.recap: A drunken one-legged sergeant makes a spectacle of himself outside the house, and afterwards two men are left to speak plainly.

25001.label: Walking it out alone
25001.recap: Alone on his gravel walk, Mr Whittlestaff turns over his housekeeper's troubles and his own until neither will lie still.

25001.label: Driving out to dinner
25001.recap: On the way to a neighbour's dinner party, Mary weighs whether she still has any right to change her mind.

25001.label: A call in London
25001.recap: Mr Whittlestaff goes up to town to say face to face something he could not put into a letter.

25001.label: Last arrangements
25001.recap: With a week's visit to the parsonage at hand, Mr Whittlestaff quietly makes plans of his own and the household's future is settled.

25049.label: The war clouds gather
25049.recap: The author traces the slide toward war back to a failed raid and the quarrel between two stubborn men.

25049.label: First shot at Elandslaagte
25049.recap: Scouts return with news that the enemy is coming, and amateur soldiers hear the opening guns of their first battle.

25049.label: Pursued by the lancers
25049.recap: Beaten and separated from his men, he rides through the dark with cavalry close behind and a river ahead.

25049.label: Ordered to Colenso
25049.recap: Sent to the Tugela, his commando is shuffled about by contradictory orders while a large battle goes on around them.

25049.label: Pretoria abandoned
25049.recap: With the capital about to fall and no clear orders from anyone, officers argue bitterly over whether to defend it.

25049.label: A government in retreat
25049.recap: The fleeing government moves down the railway line, trailed by officials and contractors he regards with contempt.

25049.label: Commandeering horses
25049.recap: In a town still flying its own flag, he spends days coaxing, paying, and bullying civilians out of their horses.

25049.label: Planning the night attack
25049.recap: He divides his commandos, sets a password, and fixes an hour for a simultaneous rush on a chain of hill forts.

25049.label: Columns closing in
25049.recap: After months of idleness, huge enemy columns begin converging from six directions to sweep up the whole commando.

25049.label: Rain, mist and wire
25049.recap: Blockhouses and swollen rivers make movement dangerous, and a summons from the acting president draws him south.

25049.label: Broadbottom Camp
25049.recap: He climbs a cliff of cut steps on St Helena and looks down on a wired enclosure of tents that will be home.

25049.label: The fighting Boer
25049.recap: Closing chapters step back from events to explain how Boer commandos chose and obeyed their officers.

25087.label: A restless farm boy
25087.recap: The narrator sets out his Ohio boyhood, his indulgent step-father, and his early loathing of farm work.

25087.label: Ears for a deaf drover
25087.recap: At sixteen he quits school and hires on as the hearing man for a profane, very deaf livestock dealer.

25087.label: Sheep pelts and a restaurant
25087.recap: He borrows a small stake, turns his first honest profit buying pelts, then sinks it into a village restaurant.

25087.label: The toilet soap firm
25087.recap: A travelling acquaintance persuades him to put his cash into a soap factory in Toledo and take the road as salesman.

25087.label: Peddling jewelry alone
25087.recap: Working country roads by himself, he sells spectacles and jewelry door to door and starts trading toward a rig of his own.

25087.label: Patent rights and a deacon
25087.recap: A new patent-right agency sends him bargaining with a churchgoing deacon over a handsome pair of horses.

25087.label: Stranded with the family
25087.recap: He arrives in a hotel town penniless with his wife and small son, and scrapes up a single sale to hold off the landlord.

25087.label: Running the hotel
25087.recap: Out of money and out of ideas, he talks his way into managing the run-down hotel where he has been boarding.

25087.label: An auctioneering partner
25087.recap: He teams up with a free-spending old friend to tour the western states selling goods at auction.

25087.label: A talking machine
25087.recap: Another partnership in the auction trade leaves him exhibiting a talking machine that refuses to talk.

25087.label: The trunk that vanished
25087.recap: A trunk holding nearly all his new stock disappears off a Minnesota depot platform in the middle of the night.

25087.label: Tandem team and a verdict
25087.recap: Travelling by team through Michigan he makes one last snap horse trade, then sums up what twenty years of hustling taught him.

25112.label: A prince is born
25112.recap: The birth of Victoria and Albert's eldest son, the titles conferred on him within weeks, and a christening of extraordinary expense.

25112.label: Tour of North America
25112.recap: At eighteen he is sent through the British provinces and then, thinly disguised as Lord Renfrew, into the United States.

25112.label: A portrait and a match
25112.recap: A chance sight of a photograph leads to a meeting abroad, a betrothal, and a crowded wedding at Windsor.

25112.label: Fever at Sandringham
25112.recap: Typhoid strikes the Prince and the whole country begins waiting on the medical bulletins.

25112.label: Six months in India
25112.recap: A vast and costly state tour of India is argued over, arranged, and then carried through city by city.

25112.label: Gossip and character
25112.recap: The author weighs the anecdotes and scandals attached to the Prince's name, including one divorce case that reached the courts.

25112.label: The Queen dies
25112.recap: Victoria's death is announced across the Empire and her son drives through silent London to meet the Privy Council.

25112.label: Struck down before the crown
25112.recap: London is packed for the coronation when a single bulletin posted at the Mansion House stops the city.

25112.label: The coronation
25112.recap: A new date is fixed, the honours list is published, and the long-delayed ceremony is prepared.

25112.label: The last illness
25112.recap: Reports about the King's health are dismissed as sensational until an announcement comes from the palace.

25112.label: Lying in state
25112.recap: The coffin is carried from Buckingham Palace to Westminster Hall between soldiers and bare-headed, silent crowds.

25112.label: The next king
25112.recap: A closing sketch of the new sovereign, his training, his first address to the Privy Council, and the work ahead of him.

25132.label: The dark horse nominated
25132.recap: A correspondent slips out of a roaring convention hall so that he can be the first to tell a young lawyer he has been nominated.

25132.label: An argument at the door
25132.recap: Invited to dinner at the candidate's house, Harley is kept on the step by a maid who wants proof he is not a photographer.

25132.label: The special train pulls out
25132.recap: The campaign train leaves at daybreak, and Harley finds a veiled passenger already installed outside the candidate's drawing-room.

25132.label: The "King" arrives
25132.recap: A huge, joyous mountain millionaire bursts in on the party, greets Sylvia as his little girl, and promises the Northwest to Grayson.

25132.label: Twenty-four speeches
25132.recap: During a record-breaking day of whistle stops Harley befriends a devoted little farmer who is quietly running away from home.

25132.label: The committeeman from the East
25132.recap: An Oxford-polished national committeeman is sent west to add dignity to the tour, and the party braces itself for him.

25132.label: A letter posted in secret
25132.recap: Churchill writes a long private report on the candidate's failings, and Sylvia notices how carefully he hides the envelope.

25132.label: The road to Crow's Wing
25132.recap: A plea from a mountain town nobody ever visits sends the candidate on a hard journey with a very small party.

25132.label: A resolution kept
25132.recap: Away from the train, Sylvia settles in her own mind what she means to do about her promise, and comes back changed.

25132.label: A letter reaches the mountains
25132.recap: A forwarded letter finds "King" Plummer at a high mining camp, and he reads it several times before he begins to swear.

25132.label: The night at Philipsburg
25132.recap: A dry quarrel about the tariff builds across the plains and comes to a head in the upstairs room of a hamlet hotel.

25132.label: Election night
25132.recap: The train reaches the candidate's home town for the last time, and the party settles in to wait for the returns.

25344.label: The market-place crowd
25344.recap: On a summer morning a crowd gathers outside the Boston jail, waiting for a young woman to be brought out and shown to the town.

25344.label: A stranger in the crowd
25344.recap: Standing on the pillory, Hester picks out a small, oddly dressed stranger at the edge of the crowd, and is then questioned before the whole town.

25344.label: The physician's visit
25344.recap: Back in her cell, half frantic, Hester is attended by a physician who asks the jailer to leave him alone with her.

25344.label: Free and marked
25344.recap: Released from jail, Hester settles in a small cottage at the edge of town and keeps herself and her child by her needle.

25344.label: Errand to the mansion
25344.recap: Hester carries a pair of embroidered gloves to the Governor's house, having heard that some townsfolk mean to take her daughter away from her.

25344.label: The physician settles in
25344.recap: The town's learned new physician takes his place among the people and becomes the constant companion of its ailing young minister.

25344.label: Midnight on the scaffold
25344.recap: Sleepless and half dreaming, the minister walks out at midnight and climbs the weather-stained platform where Hester once stood.

25344.label: Talk by the shore
25344.recap: While Pearl plays at the water's edge, Hester at last speaks alone with the physician about what he has made of himself.

25344.label: Meeting in the forest
25344.recap: Waiting on a shadowed forest path, Hester calls the minister by name, and the two speak openly for the first time in years.

25344.label: Election day holiday
