28780.recap: A man shadows him aboard a new ship and shows him a knife rather than say very much.

28780.label: A rose of cameo
28780.recap: In fine spirits after a turn on deck, he finds something in his cabin that has no business being there.

28780.label: Back on the river
28780.recap: Restless on a spring morning aboard another liner, he is approached quietly by a deck boy.

28780.label: Lamplight and questions
28780.recap: By lamplight in his own cabin he takes the measure of the two strangers he has just come to the aid of.

28780.label: Through the tunnels
28780.recap: Walking the mine workings he sees what the place does to the people in it, and reaches a great black door.

28780.label: Sunrise over the valley
28780.recap: He wakes to sunlight and a familiar voice, and hears what changed while he was unconscious.

29391.label: A producer's bad morning
29391.recap: A Broadway producer opens a violet-tinted letter from his leading lady and finds his whole season's plan coming apart.

29391.label: The office reads the play
29391.recap: With his chief gone for the day, the office manager shuts the door, puts his feet up and reads the manuscript that arrived that morning.

29391.label: News at Rosemeade
29391.recap: In a Kentucky garden a young writer and her cousin plan how to spend her play money and steel themselves to tell her grandfather.

29391.label: The friend with the money
29391.recap: The producer's oldest friend, rich and stubbornly idealistic, asks why anyone would want the theatre and then buys half of a show.

29391.label: Casting the company
29391.recap: Actors file through the office one at a time while the producer hires, haggles and dismisses them at bewildering speed.

29391.label: Author meets star
29391.recap: The young author is introduced to the famous leading lady over an impromptu luncheon and asks for a dish whose name she does not know.

29391.label: Getting rid of the author
29391.recap: The producer invents an errand to send his author safely home to Kentucky, and it goes wrong in a way he never anticipated.

29391.label: A night on Broadway
29391.recap: He collects his author from the Y.W.C.A. for her first evening out under the white lights and is far more nervous than she is.

29391.label: The first reading
29391.recap: The company gathers on a bare stage for the first read-through, where the new stage director sets his terms with the star.

29391.label: Rehearsal weeks
29391.recap: Author and producer spend every waking hour side by side working the machinery of the play, while he quietly pays a price she knows nothing about.

29391.label: After the dress rehearsal
29391.recap: In a rose-lit dressing room after the tryout the star makes her move, and a note left behind for a friend sends everyone out into the night.

29391.label: Opening night
29391.recap: The play opens a brand-new Broadway theatre before a brilliant house.

30254.label: Three in a bedroom
30254.recap: The narrator introduces himself and his two younger sisters in a household where the adults notice nothing.

30254.label: An ignorant boy
30254.recap: He admits how little he understands of what is happening to him, which sets up everything the adults around him will exploit.

30254.label: A first parting
30254.recap: The older woman who has taken charge of his education leaves the house, and he has to hide his distress among the general regret.

30254.label: The governess
30254.recap: A governess who has been growing steadily warmer towards him becomes his next entanglement, and a marriage is arranged around her.

30254.label: After the wedding
30254.recap: With the wedding over and the household unsettled, the narrator's secret arrangements at home have to be rebuilt from scratch.

30254.label: The uncle's terms
30254.recap: Walking in the garden, his clerical uncle explains plainly what has really been going on and what discretion will be required of him.

30254.label: A friend's confidence
30254.recap: A school friend passes on a conversation with his own family, and a weekend visit is engineered on a pretext of good behaviour.

30254.label: Lodgings in the Strand
30254.recap: Now a London student, the narrator takes rooms with a widowed landlady and her two nieces, and describes the household he has landed in.

30254.label: A very fine sermon
30254.recap: The whole party goes decorously to church, where a sermon on chastity wins the preacher an entry into the best county society.

30254.label: A letter, unfinished
30254.recap: The book breaks off inside a long letter setting out an hour-by-hour programme for a private assignation.

30340.label: A letter to a son
30340.recap: A man in middle age decides to write his whole life down for the boy who will one day want to know it.

30340.label: Boyhood in the park
30340.recap: He remembers roaming a great English park as a boy, and the children up at the big house he sometimes joined.

30340.label: A watched lunch party
30340.recap: At a crowded luncheon he is pinned beside a gossiping old woman with a lorgnette while trying to watch one particular guest.

30340.label: A garden at midnight
30340.recap: Summoned by a pencilled note, he waits among the rose bushes for a meeting that lasts until nearly dawn.

30340.label: News in the paper
30340.recap: He learns of an engagement from the newspaper, writes and destroys a dozen furious letters, and asks for a meeting.

30340.label: Landing in South Africa
30340.recap: He sails for the war, attaches himself to a volunteer corps and rides north through a country he has never seen.

30340.label: Meeting again in London
30340.recap: Years later, hardened by the war, he finds himself in the same brilliant drawing-room as her.

30340.label: In the blue parlour
30340.recap: He walks in on her writing a note, and a thunderstorm breaks while the three of them are left facing one another.

30340.label: Blinds drawn
30340.recap: He returns to the house the next morning and the door is answered by a collarless butler with very little to say.

30340.label: One man against everybody
30340.recap: With no allies and no proof, he tries lawyers and private enquiry agents to find where she has been taken.

30340.label: Years of wandering
30340.recap: Sent away from the whole affair, he travels the world and starts assembling ideas about how people might live better together.

30340.label: An unannounced visitor
30340.recap: She arrives at his house one morning, sleepless and drawn, saying she has something he will be glad to hear.

30434.label: A problem with no name
30434.recap: The Director of the FBI tells Malone that something is quietly going wrong across the whole government, and admits he has no idea what it is.

30434.label: The machine man
30434.recap: Malone interrupts an absorbed technician to ask him to run a check on the government's calculating machines.

30434.label: Consulting the scientist
30434.recap: Malone calls a chilly government scientist at Yucca Flats and then goes to put his questions in person.

30434.label: The Psychical Research Society
30434.recap: Malone visits a genial society president to ask what a century of case files might say about the powers of the mind.

30434.label: Three cooperative spies
30434.recap: In the middle of questioning a captured agent, Malone gets a strange warning about what is happening inside the man's head.

30434.label: Telepathic projection
30434.recap: Malone and his colleagues argue over a book claiming that thoughts can be pushed into other people's minds.

30434.label: Sent on vacation
30434.recap: Pulled off the case, Malone packs slowly and begins weighing whether his own decisions can be trusted.

30434.label: An unreadable mind
30434.recap: Malone learns that no telepath can reach him at all, and wonders what else the shield may be keeping out.

30434.label: Undercover in Nevada
30434.recap: Working a casino town in disguise, Malone listens to men complain that their whole business is coming apart.

30434.label: Everyone on vacation
30434.recap: Malone telephones an office in a hurry and is told that every one of its officers has gone away.

30434.label: Reading the files
30434.recap: Back on duty, Malone works through dossiers hunting the one detail he knows he has been missing.

30434.label: An evening off
30434.recap: Malone dresses for a night out and fends off his friend's questions about the woman he is not seeing.

30849.label: Prisoner on the rock
30849.recap: A French soldier taken by the English describes life among the yellow-coated prisoners in Edinburgh Castle, where visitors come to gawk and to buy their handmade toys.

30849.label: The girl in the courtyard
30849.recap: Among the sightseers he notices a tall Scottish girl with sunlit hair, and sets himself to catch her attention.

30849.label: A duel in the dark
30849.recap: After an insult he cannot let pass, he meets a giant of a fellow prisoner in the blackness of their sleeping shed, both armed with half a pair of scissors.

30849.label: A lawyer from London
30849.recap: A plainly dressed stranger with a mulberry face arrives at the prison market claiming to know the young soldier's true name and family.

30849.label: The Devil's Elbow
30849.recap: The prisoners argue over the length of their rope and the height of the precipice, and must choose who will climb down first.

30849.label: Hidden at the cottage
30849.recap: Sheltered in a garden outbuilding, he is smuggled indoors at midnight for clean clothes and a late supper with the girl and her brother.

30849.label: South with the drovers
30849.recap: He sets off for England in the company of two taciturn Scottish cattle drovers and their dogs.

30849.label: The great-uncle's bedside
30849.recap: He is brought at last to the sickroom of the old emigre count, who receives him with faint, courteous, unsettling slyness.

30849.label: An unwelcome cousin
30849.recap: A flashily dressed young man who resembles him more than he cares to admit walks into the house and greets him with an arid smile.

30849.label: A runaway match
30849.recap: Travelling north again, he comes upon a smashed chaise, two quarrelling lovers and two grinning postillions, and cannot resist meddling.

30849.label: The incomplete aeronauts
30849.recap: A balloon ascent goes wrong at once when a man is carried up dangling from a rope beneath the car.

30849.label: The regiment marches out
30849.recap: A crowd gathers at the foot of the Castle Hill to watch the regiment leave for the Low Countries, band playing and handkerchiefs waving.

31257.label: An invitation and a grudge
31257.recap: Two poor cousins are delighted by an invitation to a rich aunt's country house, and furious that a third cousin was invited too.

31257.label: The journey north
31257.recap: Dainty travels out of the city in the company of the young heir of Ellsworth and finds the day the pleasantest of her life.

31257.label: The cough next door
31257.recap: Dressing for her first dinner at the great house, Dainty hears a dreadful cough from a room the maid insists is empty.

31257.label: In the rose garden
31257.recap: Love steers Dainty away from the others among the flowers, and something crossing the gravel path frightens her badly.

31257.label: A secret kept badly
31257.recap: Through weeks of picnics, dances and moonlight rides the engaged pair try to hide their happiness, and fool absolutely nobody.

31257.label: A jilted lover
31257.recap: Ela is seized in the dark by the man she threw over the moment a richer prize came into view.

31257.label: Cries in the night
31257.recap: Wailing cries wake the whole house, and everyone comes running to find Dainty senseless on the floor with her old nurse beside her.

31257.label: The night before
31257.recap: On the eve of his wedding Love sits at his window counting his good fortune and prays that he may deserve it.

31257.label: A key in the lock
31257.recap: Shut in a dark cell and close to despair, Dainty hears a key turn and the heavy door begin to swing open.

31257.label: Back to the great house
31257.recap: After two long months away, Dainty struggles up to the mansion, searching the windows for a single familiar face.

31257.label: A door in the snow
31257.recap: Penniless in a December storm, Dainty knocks at a basement door where a room full of girls is working sewing machines.

31257.label: The reckoning
31257.recap: While the schemers sit planning a summer in Paris, an unexpected party walks straight into the parlour.

31469.label: The house Poe walked past
31469.recap: The narrator points out a dingy old house on a Providence street that a famous writer of terrors passed for years without ever noticing.

31469.label: The cellar as a boy
31469.recap: He remembers daring the empty house as a child, and the pale fungi and shifting whitish stain on the cellar floor.

31469.label: The uncle's notebooks
31469.recap: His antiquarian uncle, a sober old physician, finally hands over the papers he has spent years collecting about the place.

31469.label: A family's record
31469.recap: The record of the merchant who built the house in 1763, and of the deaths that began almost as soon as he moved in.

31469.label: Shouting in French
31469.recap: A widow shut up in the upper rooms screams for hours in a language she was never taught.

31469.label: A servant's theory
31469.recap: A servant from the backwoods insists something is buried under the cellar and ought to be dug up, and is dismissed for saying so.

31469.label: A name in the deeds
31469.recap: Searching old town records, he turns up a seventeenth-century lease that supplies the French connection he had been hunting for.

31469.label: Torchlight at midnight
31469.recap: He visits the cellar alone on a stormy night and watches something faint rise from the mold by the fireplace.

31469.label: Setting up the vigil
31469.recap: Uncle and nephew carry camp chairs, a cot and some very expensive machinery down into the cellar and plan to watch in shifts.

31469.label: Watching a sleeper
31469.recap: Taking the first watch, he notices his uncle's breathing change and his sleeping face begin to work strangely.

31469.label: Woken by a scream
31469.recap: He wakes in a strange yellow light, to a stench and a shout, and turns to see the rest of the room.

31469.label: Digging in daylight
31469.recap: Alone, with a spade, a gas-mask and six carboys of acid standing ready, he starts opening up the cellar floor.

31472.label: Derby Day in London
31472.recap: A young viscount sets off for the races and finds his day's plans undone before he leaves Mayfair.

31472.label: A stranded driver
31472.recap: Stopping for a broken-down car, he recognizes its desperate owner and offers to take over the man's booking.

31472.label: Collecting the ladies
31472.recap: At the Savoy he presents himself as the hired chauffeur, gives a name on the spur of the moment, and the tour begins.

31472.label: An evening at Brighton
31472.recap: Settling in for the night, he sends his father a carefully vague telegram and goes down to the garage.

31472.label: A chaperon's misgivings
31472.recap: Over dinner the paid chaperon frets about her charge's easy manners toward the hired driver.

31472.label: Through the gorge
31472.recap: He drives hard through a limestone ravine and out onto a bleak upland, hunting for a car that has gone ahead.

31472.label: Stranded on the moor
31472.recap: Cynthia's ride in the rival car ends with an empty petrol tank on a lonely road.

31472.label: The Count's move
31472.recap: Outside the Bristol hotel a smiling Frenchman greets the chauffeur with a pointed and unfriendly civility.

31472.label: An intercepted call
31472.recap: Mrs. Devar takes a telephone call meant for the chauffeur and hears rather more than she expected.

31472.label: Back from the river
31472.recap: Cynthia returns very late to a country hotel after a boating mishap and calms the alarmed household.

31472.label: Father and son at breakfast
31472.recap: The Earl steers carefully around the storm brewing between him and his son until the meal is over.

31472.label: The night boat to France
31472.recap: Rain sweeps England as Medenham leaves Charing Cross on a grim errand across the Channel.

31472.label: A room in Calais
31472.recap: Cynthia reaches a sickroom where a French nurse guards a man who barely knows she is there.

31635.label: A London hotel foyer
31635.recap: An American collects his post at an expensive London hotel and looks for a quiet corner in which to read it.

31635.label: An overheard wish
31635.recap: He realises he has been listening to two young women talk about money, work and a longed-for Alpine holiday.

31635.label: A letter from the sky
31635.recap: Helen reads and rereads an astonishing commission that would send her to the Engadine at someone else's expense.

31635.label: Departure at the station
31635.recap: Watching her train leave, Spencer notices someone else on the platform and abruptly changes his own plans.

31635.label: First morning in the Alps
31635.recap: Helen wakes to a dazzling Engadine morning and sets out alone along a footpath toward the glacier valley.

31635.label: Setting out before dawn
31635.recap: Before sunrise Helen and her companion start for the high snow, sparring lightly about the weather.

31635.label: Shelter in the storm
31635.recap: A sudden mountain storm drives the climbing party into a bare stone refuge above the moraine.

31635.label: Down the frozen rocks
31635.recap: The descent turns dangerous as sleet glazes the rocks and the roped party edges back toward the ice.

31635.label: An unexpected friend
31635.recap: Helen returns to the hotel to find her old London friend arrived, greeting her with a smile that has no warmth in it.

31635.label: Two men on the meadow
31635.recap: A wealthy Englishman walks out beyond the hotel with an old lame guide who insists on speaking to him alone.

31635.label: Waking in the hut
31635.recap: Helen wakes in the dark of a mountain hut, steadies herself, and gets up to face a long day.

31635.label: Across the glacier
31635.recap: Plans change, and the guides propose a different route over the ice toward a fine summit view.

32398.label: Waking in Vienna
32398.recap: A wounded pilot surfaces from five days of unconsciousness and pieces his memory back together from fragments.

32398.label: Stolen ship, wrong hands
32398.recap: He comes to a second time aboard his own vessel, bound at the wrists, with a terrified stranger at the controls.

32398.label: Three in a locked room
32398.recap: Prisoners in a bare compartment trade jokes to keep their spirits up while the ship accelerates away from Earth.

32398.label: Counting the hours back
32398.recap: With hands still shaking, the pilot works out how long deceleration and return will take, and who is listening.

32398.label: Finding the valley again
32398.recap: From fifty thousand feet they hunt for a remembered coastline, then wait for night to show them a glow of fires.

32398.label: Earth becomes a moon
32398.recap: The people in the control room absorb what a single act has cost them, and one of them quietly takes charge.

32398.label: Terms for an enemy
32398.recap: Rather than shoot the men who abducted him, the leader gives them a valley of their own and one hard condition.

32398.label: Bows out of spear-wood
32398.recap: They scavenge abandoned shafts and sinew to make weapons, while one of them turns over his own decision endlessly.

32398.label: Through the crimson buds
32398.recap: The party fights uphill through vegetation with grasping tendrils, and finds a gateway of monoliths they need not enter.

32398.label: Behind the stake wall
32398.recap: A knoll is fortified with sharpened stakes, and the defenders count their weapons against a taunting voice outside.

32398.label: Down the spiral stair
32398.recap: One man takes a long look at the world, then goes alone into a stinking blackness and feels his way downward.

32398.label: Clean clothes and a course
32398.recap: Ragged wanderers become travellers again, stand a while in silence, and set a heading.

32474.label: Leaving Castile
32474.recap: An ordinary soldier sails for the Indies, waits three years for a reward that never comes, and joins a venture to look for new land.

32474.label: First sight of Yucatan
32474.recap: The ships raise an unknown coast, are welcomed aboard by a friendly chief, and are led inland into an ambush.

32474.label: Word of lost Spaniards
32474.recap: Cortes learns that castaway Spaniards are living inland as slaves, and sends letters and ransom beads to fetch them out.

32474.label: The interpreter's story
32474.recap: The narrator breaks off to tell the history of the noblewoman whose two languages made the whole enterprise possible.

32474.label: Electing a captain-general
32474.recap: A midnight visit to his hut draws the narrator into the scheme to found a colony and make Cortes its commander.

32474.label: Into Tlascalla
32474.recap: The little army marches toward a country already arming against it and meets its own messengers newly escaped from prison.

32474.label: Reckoning at Cholulla
32474.recap: Cortes lays out to the assembled chiefs every sign of a planned ambush, and the meeting ends in slaughter.

32474.label: Entering the great city
32474.recap: A few hundred men walk a causeway into a city built on water and are met on the road by its monarch.

32474.label: A host becomes a hostage
32474.recap: Armed and courteous as always, Cortes walks into the palace and asks the monarch to come and live in the Spanish quarters.

32474.label: A rival army from Cuba
32474.recap: Cortes halts by a meadow brook to arrange his march against a Spanish force sent to arrest him, and makes his men a speech.

32474.label: Retreat in the rain
32474.recap: Short of powder, water and bridges, the Spaniards resolve to leave the city at midnight and carry off what treasure they can.

32474.label: Timber for a fleet
32474.recap: Regrouped among their allies, the survivors begin felling wood for brigantines, and the volume closes with the return to the lake still ahead.

32562.label: A letter to the chief
32562.recap: Homer Nicholas begins a written explanation to the city's chief of police, promising to account for a very strange twenty-four hours.

32562.label: Knocking on the lab door
32562.recap: After three days of pounding on a steel basement door, Homer and his fiancee finally get in to announce their wedding.

32562.label: The closet opens
32562.recap: A noise from a nearby closet introduces Uncle Peter's laboratory assistant and thoroughly embarrasses him.

32562.label: Bag Ears arrives
32562.recap: Homer rescues his battered ex-boxer friend from a disapproving butler and presents him to the bride.

32562.label: An uninvited crowd
32562.recap: The couple return indoors to find the reception full of strangers whom Bag Ears recognises immediately.

32562.label: A voice from the doorway
32562.recap: A masked man with a submachine gun tells the room to sort itself out and not move a finger.

32562.label: Something goes pop
32562.recap: Uncle Peter's long-promised experiment makes itself felt among the guests while he calmly keeps score in a notebook.

32562.label: Into the Cadillac
32562.recap: Joy fetches the car and the three of them set off after a blue roadster heading west across town.

32562.label: Chasing the blue roadster
32562.recap: Joy drives hard through evening traffic and finally forces the other car to the curb in a quiet street.

32562.label: Answers in the back seat
32562.recap: Joy takes charge of questioning their new passenger while Homer keeps his eyes firmly on the road.

32562.label: Joe's Tavern on Clark Street
32562.recap: The pursuit ends at a neon-lit bar, where Homer walks in just as a drink is being raised.

32562.label: Back at the laboratory
32562.recap: Everyone returns to the basement lab, where Uncle Peter begins packing a suitcase and finally explains what he has been doing.

32759.label: Alone in the forest
32759.recap: A lone woman rider halts at a forest pool and climbs a crag to work out where her flight has taken her.

32759.label: An unwelcome follower
32759.recap: A man she knows from the border camp appears behind her on the rock, and the two trade insults and threats.

32759.label: Something is eating the horses
32759.recap: Screams from the trees send the pair down the rock to see what has killed their mounts.

32759.label: Across the moonlit plain
32759.recap: They break clear of the trees and cross the open plain toward the silent city, camping short of its gates.

32759.label: Gates that never open
32759.recap: Daylight shows rusted hinges, dry irrigation ditches and no sign at all of anyone living inside the walls.

32759.label: A man in the hall
32759.recap: Left alone among the jeweled upper rooms, Valeria hears movement below and creeps to a gallery to watch.

32759.label: The Burning Skull
32759.recap: A glowing apparition advances on a man too frightened to move, and the watcher above decides to act.

32759.label: Behind the bronze door
32759.recap: Their frantic guide hammers on a barred door and brings the strangers before the people who live behind it.

32759.label: The tally of red nails
32759.recap: The newcomers hear how this city was taken, how it split, and what the scarlet nails in the black pillar count.

32759.label: A visitor in the night
32759.recap: Alone behind bolted doors, Valeria wakes from a scented dream to find someone bending over her.

32759.label: Piping at the door
32759.recap: Two guards talk about the coming attack, and then something begins to play music on the other side of the bronze door.

32759.label: A secret way in
32759.recap: Conan follows a man he does not trust toward a hidden entrance that has been kept secret for fifty years.

32759.label: The last of the feud
32759.recap: In a chamber strewn with the fallen, a silent, circling duel is fought against a weapon nobody understands.

33118.label: The manicure parlor
33118.recap: In the manicure room of a grand hotel a popular young manicurist trades barbs with a jealous colleague and receives two very different regular customers.

33118.label: Above the shoe store
33118.recap: A shoe dealer shuts his store early in the heat and climbs upstairs to a mother who reads illness into every early homecoming.

33118.label: The typist's evening
33118.recap: A stenographer who types other people's melodramas finishes her day dreaming of half a yard of pink tulle and a young man named Harry Trimp.

33118.label: Petticoat money
33118.recap: A petticoat fortune has moved the Katzensteins into a bigger apartment, where the mother scolds her daughter awake on the morning of a card party.

33118.label: The night express
33118.recap: A railway village keeps time by the express that tears through it, and on one such night two women crouch together behind drawn shades in a house where a man lies dead.

33118.label: The Newton store
33118.recap: A suburb swallowed by the city is squeezing a small-town storekeeper, and his worry shows plainly at his own supper table.

33118.label: Waiting up at night
33118.recap: A mother lies awake in a third-floor rear apartment, counting phantom sheep until at last her son's key scratches at the lock.

33118.label: Answering the advertisement
33118.recap: Two shopgirls close out a rainy afternoon while one of them nerves herself for a drugstore meeting with a stranger she has only written to.

33118.label: Supper in a hot flat
33118.recap: A young wife fries chops in a stifling kitchen while her old friend urges her to leave married life and take her job back at the store.

33118.label: Coming home late
33118.recap: Late at night a wife hurries home in dread, lets herself quietly into the dark apartment, and finds her husband standing at the kitchen window.

33644.label: A dim day in the Andes

33644.label: Something falls from the sky

33644.label: The black tower
33644.recap: Father and son cross a shimmering valley and reach a windowless building with two huge discs raised toward the sun.

33644.label: A place on the crew
33644.recap: In a briefing room full of officers, Burl realises what has just been asked of him and accepts the burden.

33644.label: One last day at home
33644.recap: Home for a single day, Burl looks at his ordinary street as though seeing it for the last time.

33644.label: Too near the sun
33644.recap: With the ship in serious trouble close to the Sun, the crew works the calculators for a way out instead of panicking.

33644.label: Beneath the cloud deck
33644.recap: Hovering over a still, scum-covered ocean, the crew takes soundings of a world nobody has ever seen.

33644.label: A jeep on Mars
33644.recap: Suspecting a trap, the commander sets the ship down in the desert and sends two scouts ahead by vehicle.

33644.label: Outside the hull
33644.recap: Hanging from a cord on the ship's exterior, Burl has to climb back before the acceleration increases.

33644.label: The farthest planet
33644.recap: A rocket plane skims a frozen continent and three men step out onto the surface of the outermost world.

33644.label: Under a glass dome
33644.recap: Burl comes round dizzy and alone beneath a shining barrier, with a pale blue disc filling the sky above him.

33644.label: Introductions all round
33644.recap: Standing among strange shapes and stranger hands, Burl offers a greeting and thinks about the voyages still to come.

33823.label: The rent is due
33823.recap: A charming, briefless young man with sixpence-halfpenny in his pocket is given until tomorrow by his landlady to find her money.

33823.label: A runaway brougham
33823.recap: While idly daydreaming about rescuing an heiress, Lionel sees a bolting carriage come tearing down the street toward him.

33823.label: There is room for two
33823.recap: The lady invites her rescuer into her cab, and the drive round the park does not go quite the way he imagined it would.

33823.label: Waiting in a dressing-room
33823.recap: Alone between the acts, Lionel argues with himself about whether the extraordinary story he is being told can possibly be true.

33823.label: The history of Henry Brown
33823.recap: A new thread opens with a bachelor of forty whose many hopeful courtships have all stalled at exactly the same point.

33823.label: The annual holiday
33823.recap: A retired cashier ends up holding wool, having failed to persuade his decisive wife that they might holiday anywhere but Cromer.

33823.label: Two calm prisoners
33823.recap: The householder finds his intruders unexpectedly well dressed, unruffled, and quite willing to sit down and discuss the situation.

33823.label: Enter Tony Wild
33823.recap: A rich young man who has tried every sensation except work goes out onto the street looking for a fresh one.

33823.label: A town in ruins
33823.recap: Two travellers walk into a strike-battered town and find street after street smashed, silent, and completely deserted.

33823.label: The inn at Shereling
33823.recap: A village landlord idly wonders about the elderly foreign guest who divides his days between the golf links and his bedroom.

33823.label: A locked-door interview
33823.recap: Lionel bundles a struggling woman into his room, turns the key, and sits down for what he intends to be a long conversation.

33823.label: The company scatters
33823.recap: With the business finished and the visitors making for their trains, Lionel is at last left alone with the person he wants to talk to.

34206.label: Two royal brothers
34206.recap: Two brothers rule neighbouring kingdoms justly for twenty years, until the elder sends for the younger to visit him.

34206.label: The wezeer's daughter offers
34206.recap: A vizier's well-read elder daughter asks to be given in marriage to the king, over her father's horrified objections.

34206.label: The ass and the bull
34206.recap: To frighten his daughter out of her plan, the vizier tells a fable of a bull who took a clever ass's advice.

34206.label: A date stone thrown aside
34206.recap: A merchant eats a date under a tree and is confronted by a towering jinnee with a drawn sword.

34206.label: Four casts of the net
34206.recap: A poor old fisherman who casts his net only four times a day hauls up a brass bottle stopped with lead.

34206.label: The porter and the ladies
34206.recap: A Baghdad porter is hired by a veiled lady, follows her through every shop in the market, and is welcomed into a strange house.

34206.label: A chest from the Tigris
34206.recap: Walking his city by night, the caliph pays a fisherman for one cast, and the net brings up a locked chest.

34206.label: Supper with the humpback
34206.recap: A merry tailor and his wife bring a humpbacked stranger home for a carousal, and the evening goes badly wrong.

34206.label: Two rival wezeers
34206.recap: A just king of El-Basrah is served by one much loved minister and one much hated, and sends for a slave girl beyond price.

34206.label: A merchant's son in Baghdad
34206.recap: A young Damascene arrives in Baghdad with his late father's goods and prospers quietly for a year.

34206.label: A king without an heir
34206.recap: A generous king who has neither wife nor child asks his vizier what he ought to do about it.

34206.label: Journeys home
34206.recap: The volume's last tale closes with contracts written, gifts loaded, and travellers riding back to their own cities.

34856.label: A child at the bazaar
34856.recap: She recalls a Manchester childhood among reformers, and a fundraising bazaar she helped at aged five.

34856.label: A lesson in obstruction
34856.recap: Her husband loses an election, and she learns from his explanation how a small party can wear a government down.

34856.label: A meeting in Nelson Street
34856.recap: She gathers women at her house and they found a union limited to women, with deeds rather than words as its motto.

34856.label: One question, twice asked
34856.recap: Two young women put a plain question to a cabinet minister at a public meeting and refuse to sit down.

34856.label: Rise up, women
34856.recap: A women's parliament sends a deputation toward Westminster and meets a wall of foot and mounted police.

34856.label: Breaking the silence rule
34856.recap: Inside Holloway she negotiates with the governor over how political prisoners may be treated, then defies the rule against speaking.

34856.label: What Black Friday cost
34856.recap: Home from a lecture tour, she records the illnesses and deaths that followed a violent day in Parliament Square.

34856.label: A bolt from the blue
34856.recap: The government announces a suffrage bill for men only, and the women read it as a deliberate betrayal.

34856.label: Eighty on hunger strike
34856.recap: Prisoners across several gaols refuse food together, and the authorities answer with force.

34856.label: Conducting her own case
34856.recap: She stands trial at the Old Bailey before a packed court and argues her own defence.

34856.label: Released to be retaken
34856.recap: A new law lets the government free starving prisoners and rearrest them once they recover.

34856.label: Arms grounded, for now
34856.recap: With war declared she calls a complete truce, and sets out what she expects to follow it.

35548.label: Debit and credit
35548.recap: Two sisters in a small house tot up on a slate what living beside a great house costs them and what it is worth.

35548.label: The guests arrive
35548.recap: The drawing-room fills with local worthies and smart visitors, and the last guest to appear makes a very unusual entrance.

35548.label: Hunting for a runaway
35548.recap: The whole household turns out to search the outbuildings for a lost pet, and one visitor slips off to try the tool-house alone.

35548.label: A quarrel between sisters
35548.recap: Prue turns on Peggy over a cancelled invitation and insists on reading every word of Freddy's in the kindest possible light.

35548.label: Searching in Oxford
35548.recap: Peggy hurries to Christ Church on an urgent errand and hunts the college walks for someone who is not where she was told he would be.

35548.label: A winter errand
35548.recap: Talbot travels through a bitter frost before dawn on a summons he is already bitterly regretting having obeyed.

35548.label: May morning on the tower
35548.recap: Before five in the morning Talbot climbs Magdalen Tower to hear the choir greet the sunrise, and finds his thoughts running only one way.

35548.label: A confidence at dusk
35548.recap: Coming in from the garden at nightfall, Peggy discovers she cannot keep her own news from her sister for a moment.

35548.label: Decking the church
35548.recap: Peggy dresses the church for Trinity Sunday, listens to Mrs. Evans's parish gossip, and assures herself the worst is behind her.

35548.label: Amateur theatricals
35548.recap: The whole county turns out for a rich new family's first entertainment, and Peggy dreads meeting one guest in particular.

35548.label: The sickroom
35548.recap: A bereavement is pushed to the back of Peggy's mind as her sister's long decline suddenly quickens.

35548.label: Night vigil
35548.recap: After a strange late caller Peggy keeps watch through the small hours, and the house is not left alone until morning.

36034.label: A dreamer's empty city

36034.label: A meeting by the canal
36034.recap: He comes on a girl crying at the embankment, drives off a drunk who chases her, and walks her home talking helplessly about himself.

36034.label: The fourth night
36034.recap: He comes to the railing with nothing to give her, and she weeps against the rail.

36034.label: A letter in the morning
36034.recap: Feverish in a grey room, the dreamer is handed a letter and breaks the seal.

36034.label: The spiteful clerk
36034.recap: A retired official describes, with relish and then with self-disgust, the pleasure he took in tormenting people at his desk.

36034.label: Twenty-four and alone
36034.recap: He remembers his younger self at the office, loathing his own face and unable to meet anyone's eye.

36034.label: Sledge through wet snow
36034.recap: Humiliated at a dinner, he tears across the city in a hired sledge rehearsing the revenge he means to take.

36034.label: News on New Year's Eve
36034.recap: A young clerk comes home in his best clothes with something he can hardly bring himself to tell his friend.

36034.label: The children's party
36034.recap: An outsider at a New Year's party watches the guests fawn over one very important personage.

36034.label: The voluntary buffoon
36034.recap: The narrator studies a twitching little man who earns his living by letting a roomful of people laugh at him.

36034.label: A boy among grown-ups
36034.recap: An eleven-year-old spends a crowded country summer among flirting adults and feels something new and shameful stirring in him.

36034.label: The quiet lodger
36034.recap: A humble elderly clerk keeps to the darkest corner of a noisy lodging house full of livelier boarders.

36223.label: A Saturday at Hendon
36223.recap: Three office friends spend a bright May afternoon at the flying-ground, where one of them watches a machine leave the earth for the first time.

36223.label: Back at the Club
36223.recap: Gwenna returns to her ladies' residential club and collects her tall, cheerfully untidy best friend for the evening's dinner party.

36223.label: A face in the glass
36223.recap: At the party Gwenna catches a stranger's blue eyes reflected over her shoulder, and finds that he is the one to take her in to dinner.

36223.label: A day at Brooklands
36223.recap: Another brief note arrives and Gwenna sets off for a day in the country, still waiting for her promised turn in the air.

36223.label: The riverside dance
36223.recap: Gwenna dresses for a costume dance held in marquees on a lawn strung with lanterns and fairy-lights above the river.

36223.label: The flying dream
36223.recap: On Midsummer night Gwenna has the most vivid dream of her twenty-two years.

36223.label: The Aircraft Works
36223.recap: A long dull train journey brings Gwenna out to a small aeroplane factory, where a freckled young man in greasy overalls meets her at the station.

36223.label: The aviation dinner
36223.recap: Gwenna is driven to a club in Pall Mall for a dinner of airmen and feels very small among the black opera hats.

36223.label: The last week-end
36223.recap: While the country weighs what part it will play, Paul is summoned away and leaves behind a message telling Gwenna to wait for him.

36223.label: Wedding morning
36223.recap: Gwenna's wedding day falls on the same morning the papers carry the official declaration of war.

36223.label: In the passenger seat
36223.recap: Hardly knowing how she managed it, Gwenna finds herself bundled into rough brown clothes and strapped into the passenger seat of the new biplane.

36223.label: A foggy December
36223.recap: Months later a tall girl in borrowed furs picks her way across a dim London square to a home for wounded officers.

36462.label: Merlin Foretells Arthur's Birth

36462.label: Driving Out the Saxons
36462.recap: The young king puts down the rival kings and Saxon invaders who challenge his crown.

36462.label: The King's Adventures
36462.recap: With Britain at peace, Arthur and his knights ride out in search of adventure.

36462.label: Balin and Balan
36462.recap: The brave but ill-fated Sir Balin is drawn into a tragic quarrel that ends between brothers.

36462.label: The Round Table
36462.recap: Arthur weds the fair Guinevere and gathers his finest knights at the fellowship of the Round Table.

36462.label: Arthur and Accolon
36462.recap: Treachery lures Arthur into a deadly duel against the knight Accolon of Gaul.

36462.label: Emperor at Rome
36462.recap: Arthur defies the Roman emperor Lucius's demand for tribute and marches in triumph against him.

36462.label: Sir Gawain
36462.recap: Sir Gawain rides out on adventure and learns hard lessons of courtesy and mercy.

36462.label: Sir Lancelot
36462.recap: The peerless Sir Lancelot wins fame across the land through his many bold adventures.

36462.label: Sir Gareth
36462.recap: A mocked kitchen-boy proves himself the noble knight Sir Gareth, brother to Gawain.

36462.label: Sir Tristram
36462.recap: The story turns to the gallant Sir Tristram and his ill-starred love for the fair Iseult.

36462.label: The Quest of the Grail
36462.recap: Merlin is lost to enchantment, and the knights set out on the long and holy quest for the Grail.

36725.label: Climbing to the valley

36725.label: A peasant lodging

36725.label: Walking by moonlight

36725.label: After the performance
36725.recap: The audience leaves the theatre in stunned silence, and the countess begs to be excused from travelling home with her party.

36725.label: Early in the garden
36725.recap: Woken by a phrase from the Play, she slips out at dawn into the autumn garden and discovers she is not alone there.

36725.label: Into the woods
36725.recap: She coaxes Freyer away from his haymaking for a day of climbing, and the two talk about books, longing, and their separate educations.

36725.label: Night in the church
36725.recap: A sacristan interrupts the pair in the darkened church, and a trick of candlelight on a carved Christ badly unsettles the countess.

36725.label: The hidden castle
36725.recap: A forgotten Wildenau hunting seat in the mountains is described as the secret place where the countess has kept a private life for years.

36725.label: A small coffin
36725.recap: Freyer and Josepha keep vigil in the castle over a loss, while the countess sends only a letter, a cheque and instructions.

36725.label: A promise given
36725.recap: The duke presses his long suit at last and begins planning, briskly and practically, how her existing tie might be dissolved.

36725.label: At the bedside
36725.recap: The closing chapter follows a long vigil of nursing, reconciliation with old friends, and the giving up of a fortune.

36965.label: Huguenot stock in Norwich
36965.recap: The book opens with the Huguenot flight from France to Norwich and places Harriet as the sixth of eight children in a manufacturer's household.

36965.label: Milton at seven
36965.recap: A child thought dull by her family finds Paradise Lost lying open on a table and begins a long private education of her own.

36965.label: Hearing slips away
36965.recap: Her deafness comes on by slow degrees through her teens, closing off music and making ordinary company an effort.

36965.label: A masculine pen name
36965.recap: At twenty she posts an essay to a magazine under a masculine signature, and the editor writes back asking for more from him.

36965.label: Poverty and a proposal
36965.recap: The family's financial collapse gives a young divinity student the courage to declare himself, and a short engagement follows.

36965.label: Tramping to publishers
36965.recap: She spends three December weeks walking through London mud and sleet, calling on publisher after publisher with a scheme none of them wants.

36965.label: The series takes off
36965.recap: The first number sells out at once, a second printing is ordered, and her mail arrives in such quantity that a barrow is needed.

36965.label: Speaking out in America
36965.recap: Touring the United States, she is asked in company what she thinks of slavery and answers without hedging, knowing what it will cost her.

36965.label: Five years in a sickroom
36965.recap: Confined between bed and couch above the harbour at Tynemouth, she keeps working through daily pain and daily opiates.

36965.label: Building the Knoll
36965.recap: At forty-two she buys two acres near Ambleside, borrows on mortgage and watches a small gabled house go up to her own plans.

36965.label: A doctor's verdict
36965.recap: London physicians tell her plainly that her heart is failing, and she goes home to make a will and write her own life.

36965.label: Last weeks at Ambleside
36965.recap: Her final weeks pass quietly among her household, her knitting and her letters.

37106.label: Playing Pilgrims
37106.recap: The four March sisters, poor while their father is away at war, resolve to bear their lot cheerfully one Christmas.

37106.label: A Merry Christmas
37106.recap: The girls give their Christmas breakfast to a starving family, and are rewarded by their rich neighbor Mr Laurence.

37106.label: The Laurence Boy
37106.recap: At a New Year's dance Jo strikes up a warm friendship with the Laurences' shy grandson, Laurie.

37106.label: Jo Meets Apollyon
37106.recap: Jo's hot temper flares when Amy burns her manuscript, and a near-drowning on the ice teaches Jo to forgive.

37106.label: A Telegram
37106.recap: A telegram brings word that Mr March is gravely ill, and Marmee hurries away to nurse him at the front.

37106.label: Little Faithful
37106.recap: While Marmee is away, gentle Beth catches scarlet fever from the poor family she has been visiting.

37106.label: Dark Days
37106.recap: Beth's fever worsens and the anxious sisters keep vigil until the crisis at last breaks.

37106.label: Pleasant Meadows
37106.recap: Mr March comes safely home for Christmas, and the recovered family is joyfully reunited.

37106.label: The First Wedding
37106.recap: Eldest sister Meg marries the steady John Brooke in a simple wedding at home.

37106.label: Literary Lessons
37106.recap: Jo sells her first stories and tastes the thrill and the pitfalls of being a published writer.

37106.label: Tender Troubles
37106.recap: Fearful for the fading Beth and dodging Laurie's deepening love, Jo decides to go away to New York.

37106.label: Heartache
37106.recap: Laurie pours out his love to Jo, who gently refuses him, and he leaves heartbroken for Europe.

37106.label: The Valley of the Shadow
37106.recap: Surrounded by love, gentle Beth slips quietly away, and the family learns to live with the loss.

37106.label: Surprises
37106.recap: Professor Bhaer comes calling in the rain, and Jo finds the love she did not expect.

37499.label: Seven in the morning
37499.recap: Before dawn in Paris, a young general writes to the woman whose portrait he keeps beside him.

37499.label: Leaving for the army
37499.recap: Days after the wedding he is already on the road south, measuring the distance in post-houses.

37499.label: Come to Italy
37499.recap: Between victories he sends an aide to fetch her, fussing over the roads, the journey and her health.

37499.label: Nights before Mantua
37499.recap: From the siege lines he mixes artillery reports with requests for a snuff-box and messages for her children.

37499.label: Silence from Bologna
37499.recap: Her letters stop arriving, so he sends a doctor after her while terms of peace are being drafted.

37499.label: Over the mountains
37499.recap: Now First Consul, he crosses the Alps with his army and promises to be back in Paris within two months.

37499.label: The Grand Army moves
37499.recap: As Emperor he sends short daily bulletins from Germany while the armies close on one another.

37499.label: Three in the morning
37499.recap: After a costly winter battle he writes two exhausted lines in his own hand.

37499.label: A lecture on glory
37499.recap: He answers a sad letter from Paris with an argument about duty, and tells her to cheer up.

37499.label: Letters to Malmaison
37499.recap: Writing to her new household, he urges her to keep her courage, go for drives and sleep well.

37499.label: A letter from Navarre
37499.recap: For once her own voice appears, asking only to keep a small place in his memory.

37499.label: The last of them
37499.recap: On the road east he sends a few practical lines about her travels and his own good health.

38177.label: Valentine morning
38177.recap: A spa town wakes to its first fine February day, and we look in on the beau who rules it, a calculating lodger, and a girl on a balcony.

38177.label: Taking the waters
38177.recap: The whole company climbs the hill to drink at the Pump Room under the beau's exact timekeeping.

38177.label: The poet's errand
38177.recap: The young poet delivers a valentine for a stranger and walks out to the meadows turning over verses of his own.

38177.label: A meeting in the maze
38177.recap: Phyllida keeps her secret appointment in the hedge maze, and the two of them talk of what London life would be like.

38177.label: Rain after church
38177.recap: A downpour strands half the congregation without chairs, and an anonymous voice proposes defying the beau's standing rule.

38177.label: The Chinese masquerade
38177.recap: The town's grandest costumed evening fills the rooms with yellow masks, pagodas and ceremonial tea.

38177.label: A call at Blackhart Farm
38177.recap: A dreary lane leads to a lonely farm and its heavy, unpleasant mistress, where lodgings in London are quietly arranged.

38177.label: A farewell supper
38177.recap: A long night of burgundy and cards is laid on for the young gentlemen of the Blue Boar.

38177.label: News in the high street
38177.recap: A footman brings word that Phyllida has gone, and a red-coated major thunders through the town while everybody gapes.

38177.label: Rumour over the teacups
38177.recap: With the beau away, the town invents one confident explanation after another for the day's events.

38177.label: A carriage in the dark
38177.recap: Two travellers rattle on through the night toward London, and one of them begins to feel something unexpected.

38177.label: What became of them
38177.recap: The closing chapter follows the survivors into later life and settles their fortunes.

38311.label: Fifth Avenue at flood-tide
38311.recap: A young army officer newly home from the Philippines watches the traffic from a motor-bus and becomes fixed on one woman whose enormous hat hides her face.

38311.label: The dance goes late
38311.recap: At a late-night dancing place the party grows wilder as the sober guests leave, and Forbes quietly stops asking Persis to dance.

38311.label: Mrs. Neff arrives
38311.recap: A sharp-tongued older widow descends on the tea-table, teases the whole circle about money and matchmaking, and carries Forbes off to dance.

38311.label: Off to the country
38311.recap: Three cars carry the party out of the city to Willie Enslee's country place, with Forbes assigned, to his private dismay, to Mrs. Neff's automobile.

38311.label: A walk before breakfast
38311.recap: Walking early with Forbes, Persis tells him about her upbringing and admits she can never stop calculating how her actions will look to other people.

38311.label: The senator's cigars
38311.recap: On a golf course Forbes meets an old family friend, a wealthy senator, who talks about his serious-minded daughter and hatches a scheme against a matchmaking mother.

38311.label: Dinner without servants
38311.recap: Left with no staff, the house party cooks and serves its own banquet and entertains itself by impersonating the gossip of its own servants.

38311.label: Welcomed to the family
38311.recap: Willie's mother pays a formal call on Persis, and the two women, each wary of the other, begin the enormous business of announcing an engagement.

38311.label: The honeymoon cut short
38311.recap: Persis talks her husband into bringing the wedding voyage home early, then hides with him in town rather than be seen and laughed at.

38311.label: Meeting again in Paris
38311.recap: At a Paris tea dance Persis comes face to face with Forbes, now in uniform, and teases him mercilessly to cover what she is feeling.

38311.label: The callers know
38311.recap: Two visitors leave in cold fury, and Persis understands that the thing she has guarded most carefully is no longer hers to guard.

38311.label: Across the dinner table
38311.recap: Willie comes at his wife across the dinner table with a knife in his hand, and she refuses, to the last, to let the servants hear a scene.

38477.label: A summons to Maryland
38477.recap: A young Philadelphia lawyer opens a letter telling him a cousin he barely knew has died and left him something.

38477.label: The funeral
38477.recap: At a small country church the narrator joins the mourners and is introduced to the dead man's household.

38477.label: Reading of the will
38477.recap: The family and servants gather while the lawyer reads out the testament, and one listener does not take it well.

38477.label: The doctor's doubt
38477.recap: Over cigars after dinner the local physician tells the narrator he does not believe the death was natural.

38477.label: The iron box
38477.recap: The doctor produces an object he thinks explains the injury, and someone in the room has been listening.

38477.label: An inquest called
38477.recap: The doctor withdraws his certificate at breakfast and a coroner's jury is summoned to the house.

38477.label: Searching the library
38477.recap: A methodical guest spends a morning sounding the walls and testing sightlines in the room where the death occurred.

38477.label: An arrest in the county
38477.recap: Word of an arrest spreads through the estate before breakfast, and a magistrate's hearing is set for the afternoon.

38477.label: A voice from the past
38477.recap: A manuscript sets out the family's history and names those who died in one particular room.

38477.label: A long cold season
38477.recap: Months pass with the narrator alone at the estate, exchanging careful letters that say nothing that matters.

38477.label: An unexpected caller
38477.recap: Sunk in jealousy and business, the narrator looks up to find an old adversary standing in his doorway.

38477.label: The whole explanation
38477.recap: The three of them sit together at last while the puzzle of the library is laid out from beginning to end.

38983.label: Nobody at the station
38983.recap: Katherine arrives two days before Christmas to find nobody meeting her, and discovers she has mislaid both her friend's name and her address.

38983.label: The singer in the dark
38983.recap: Following the voice through the dark house, Katherine finds the singer and is welcomed as though she were visiting nobility.

38983.label: Christmas dinner talk
38983.recap: Over the last of the turkey the house party asks their hostess whether the old house hides a secret passage, and then goes hunting for it.

38983.label: Behind the iron shutter
38983.recap: The men unscrew a rusted shutter from a study window and uncover a stained glass panel nobody can explain.

38983.label: What the window frames
38983.recap: Crowding to the cleaned window, they work out exactly which distant house sits framed inside its painted archway.

38983.label: Reading the old diary
38983.recap: The party listens to a boy's misspelled diary from 1870 and reaches the page that has been torn out.

38983.label: Footprints on the stairs
38983.recap: Three dark red prints on the white stair canvas send the household hunting for whoever left them, and for a cut foot nobody has.

38983.label: The landing moves
38983.recap: With half the house away, a good-natured wrestling match on the stairs sets something clicking that nobody meant to touch.

38983.label: Hercules confesses
38983.recap: Believing he is dying, the old servant finally admits what he has known about the passage and who came through it.

38983.label: Alone in the city
38983.recap: Katherine leaves a concert into rain and a badly lit side street, unwell and further from her train than she thinks.

38983.label: A story told at last
38983.recap: Well enough to sit up, Sylvia is told the story of her own parentage, and then asks to be dressed for a visitor.

38983.label: One more toast
38983.recap: The house party stands round the table on New Year's night and drinks to the adventure and to the shortcoming that started it.

40058.label: After the loss of a friend
40058.recap: Grieving her closest ally, Miss Nightingale shuts herself away in lodgings, bars her shutters, and turns her energy toward a new field of work.

40058.label: Deaths not in battle
40058.recap: The book sets out how many British soldiers in India were lost to disease rather than fighting, and where the figures behind the reform came from.

40058.label: Advising the War Office
40058.recap: From her rooms she becomes a kind of unofficial advisory council to the War Office, buried in ministers' letters, drafts, minutes and warrants.

40058.label: Helpers and visitors
40058.recap: A look at her hardest working years, the hired London houses she lived in, and the few friends she let past the door.

40058.label: The workhouse wards
40058.recap: The narrative turns to the sick wards of London workhouses, nursed by paupers who could not read and left locked and unvisited through the night.

40058.label: An ally for India
40058.recap: Fearing that Indian sanitary reform will stall for want of permanent machinery, she looks about for an ally who can build it.

40058.label: Plans from everywhere
40058.recap: Hospital plans and nursing questions arrive from across the country and the colonies, and she criticises and answers them all.

40058.label: Her training school
40058.recap: Out of official work at last, she takes the Nightingale school at St Thomas's more directly into her own hands.

40058.label: The house in South Street
40058.recap: A description of the plain London house where she lived and worked, and of the park view she turned into a moral.

40058.label: Her jubilee year
40058.recap: Fifty years after what she counted as her call to service, she looks back in a despondent mood and takes up a fresh fight over nursing.

40058.label: The last of life
40058.recap: Past seventy-five she still enjoys her days with something of the old vigour, before her powers slowly begin to fail.

40058.label: The final portrait
40058.recap: The biographer sets chronology aside and tries to gather into one impression the many sides of the character he has described.

40059.label: A grieving crossing
40059.recap: An Irish-born surgeon sails from Ireland to New York carrying fresh grief and an old private dream.

40059.label: The neighbour at dinner
40059.recap: A talkative, ringed, restless woman takes the seat beside him and gives away more of herself than he thinks proper.

40059.label: Counting her dead
40059.recap: Alone in her cabin, Valentine remembers the friends and mentors who taught her the newspaper trade in Africa.

40059.label: House-hunting in New York
40059.recap: Utterly unsuited to the task, she tramps the city looking for a house that will do as a nursing home.

40059.label: The ward comes home
40059.recap: Westenra's adopted girl arrives for the holidays, beautiful, arrogant and half wild.

40059.label: A hot, hard summer
40059.recap: The sanatorium swallows money faster than it earns, and the heat and the ledgers wear them both down.

40059.label: After the sickroom
40059.recap: He recovers from a long illness and is shaken by how worn and distant his nurse has become.

40059.label: A cheap island
40059.recap: Val settles the children in a lonely misty farmhouse in Jersey and schemes about poultry and rabbits.

40059.label: Bottles in the pantry
40059.recap: Sleepless with neuralgia, she reaches for brandy, then catches sight of what a week's drinking has left behind.

40059.label: The mad Americans
40059.recap: In a Normandy fishing village the little household is the talk of the locals for their sweaters and winter bathing.

40059.label: Back to Paris
40059.recap: With funds gone and the village haunted by sorrow, they leave for Paris and a chance meeting at the station.

40059.label: Southward with a secret
40059.recap: Travelling south in comfort, Westenra tells his ward something about Val that he has kept for years.

40284.label: Toward Terra
40284.recap: An alien scout pilots his ship down toward Earth, his mind on a woman named Elizabeth Danson.

40284.label: The Wreck
40284.recap: Detective Brice and an investigator pick over the wreckage of a strange downed aircraft.

40284.label: The Painter
40284.recap: Back on Earth, the artist Nick broods over his paintings after Beth leaves for the night.

40284.label: Among the Thistians
40284.recap: The ship lands among the friendly, yellow-eyed Thistians beside their walled white city.

40284.label: On the Home Planet
40284.recap: Far from Earth, Lors is drawn to a blue-eyed woman in the new fashion.

40284.label: The Prisoner
40284.recap: Lors goes to win over the captured detective Brice, the harder of his two prisoners to persuade.

40284.label: Two Husbands
40284.recap: Beth faces two identical men and cannot tell which is truly her husband.

40361.label: A midnight wireless
40361.recap: The Commissioner of Air Police is woken at one in the morning by a coded signal from Plymouth and decides it can keep till lunch.

40361.label: The Riviera Express
40361.recap: He travels down to Plymouth with a celebrated young actress, and notices a hatchet-faced man scowling on the platform.

40361.label: The Controller's statement
40361.recap: The head of the air line reads out an account of a mail liner that vanished from the tracking tapes over the Atlantic.

40361.label: A signal at half past two
40361.recap: A second wireless comes in during the night with news that turns the case into something personal.

40361.label: The thinking machine
40361.recap: An unassuming Japanese investigator sits down uninvited and lays out a plan before his host can object.

40361.label: Dinner at the Mille Colonnes
40361.recap: In disguise, the pair take a darkened corner table from which they can watch the whole restaurant unseen.

40361.label: The talkative landlord
40361.recap: A Cornish innkeeper gossips cheerfully about the strange gentlemen who bought a worthless tin mine on the cliffs.

40361.label: Above the cove
40361.recap: Lying at the cliff edge, he studies a boiling cove no boat could enter, then sees a grim granite house on the hill beyond.

40361.label: Cutting the wire
40361.recap: Alone in the dark with burglar's tools and an automatic, he works his way through the fences toward the silent manor.

40361.label: A drone in the cave
40361.recap: Deep inside a sea cavern a faint humming swells into something enormous rushing out of the dark.

40361.label: Moving the prisoners
40361.recap: Back at the air station, arrangements are made to send captured men up to London on the night mail train.

40361.label: Monte Carlo, two years on
40361.recap: Long afterwards the narrator takes a Riviera holiday and goes looking at villas above the town.

41537.label: The dark wood
41537.recap: At the midpoint of his life the poet finds himself lost in a wild wood, driven back by beasts until a shade offers to lead him another way.

41537.label: Through the gate
41537.recap: They pass an inscribed gateway into a starless air full of cries, where the guide explains who is held there.

41537.label: The first circle
41537.recap: Waking on the brink of the abyss, the poet is led down into a cloudy, sunless region and shown its inhabitants.

41537.label: The storm of lovers
41537.recap: In a lightless place a ceaseless wind drives shades before it, and two of them stop to tell how their love began.

41537.label: The freezing rain
41537.recap: The travellers come to a circle of cold hail and stench guarded by a three-throated monster.

41537.label: Among the tombs
41537.recap: Walking a narrow path between the ramparts and the torments, the poet asks about the open sepulchres and who lies in them.

41537.label: The twisted wood
41537.recap: They enter a pathless forest of gnarled and thorny trees where shrieking harpies nest.

41537.label: Down on a monster
41537.recap: A creature with a benign human face and a serpent's body is summoned to the ledge.

41537.label: The boiling pitch
41537.recap: A pit of tar, compared to the shipyards of Venice, is discovered full of wonder and darkness.

41537.label: A word to Florence
41537.recap: The poet turns aside to rebuke his native city before climbing on with his guide.

41537.label: Toward the last pit
41537.recap: They cross an encircling rampart in a strange half-light and hear a trumpet blast ahead.

41537.label: The frozen centre
41537.recap: At the bottom of everything the shades lie sealed in ice like straws in glass, and something vast looms through the murk.

42188.label: Run to ground
42188.recap: A fleeing girl is caught at the water's edge by the lord she escaped from.

42188.label: Out of the reeds
42188.recap: A blood-caked figure bursts from the marsh with murder plainly on his mind.

42188.label: Rowing into the dark
42188.recap: Out on open water the two strangers trade the stories of how each came to be there.

42188.label: The old parrot
42188.recap: They land on a wooded island and are greeted by a bird that speaks words neither of them knows.

42188.label: The thrown stone
42188.recap: Something inside a thicket hurls a block of stone no man could have lifted.

42188.label: The ruined hall
42188.recap: On the plateau they find a crumbling hall lined with unnervingly lifelike iron figures.

42188.label: A dream of the hall
42188.recap: Sleeping among the figures, she dreams of what happened in that hall long ago.

42188.label: A sail off the beach
42188.recap: From the cliff top they spot a ship at anchor and a rough crew already ashore.

42188.label: A ring on the sward
42188.recap: Two men settle an old grudge with swords while the whole crew watches.

42188.label: Waiting for dark
42188.recap: Alone among the rocks, she resolves to go down to the ruins once night falls.

42188.label: Under the cliffs
42188.recap: Something enormous steps out of the darkness to bar their way.

42188.label: Dawn on the beach
42188.recap: Survivors stagger out of the trees at first light and find the ship already held against them.

42196.label: A warning in the bazaar
42196.recap: A nomad clutches Conan's arm in a crowded bazaar and begs him not to take a room at a certain innkeeper's house.

42196.label: The inn at road's end
42196.recap: Conan reaches the last house on the westward road, wonders why the huts opposite stand empty, and is shown to a well-barred room.

42196.label: Something at the door
42196.recap: A bolted door swings open in the dark, and what comes through it explains why nobody in this city sleeps outdoors.

42196.label: A cry in the road
42196.recap: A struggling captive is hauled past the deserted huts, and Conan crosses the starlit road at a run.

42196.label: The figure in the alley
42196.recap: Walking back toward the city, the two come on a silent man standing in an alley mouth with a sword in his hand.

42196.label: Toward the shrine
42196.recap: Conan and his companion cross the sleeping city to the temple of Hanuman, hiding once from a heavily armed watch patrol.

42196.label: The hidden door
42196.recap: Behind the idol the girl feels along the marble for a secret spring, and the wall answers faster than either of them expected.

42196.label: The man on the divan
42196.recap: Searching the temple, Conan finds a richly furnished room where an enormous stranger lies waiting and mockingly invites him in.

42196.label: On the other side of the wall
42196.recap: The dancing-girl comes face to face with the priest she came to kill and hears his version of why her lover lost his mind.

42196.label: A square she cannot leave
42196.recap: Four jars shatter around the girl, and she has to keep moving in a very small space to stay out of reach.

42196.label: The truth in the archway
42196.recap: Before they part, the woman corrects the story she told Conan and names the reward he will actually get.

42196.label: Back down the western road
42196.recap: Conan hammers a horse-trader awake in the small hours and rides out to settle his own unfinished account.

42236.label: Climbing the palisade
42236.recap: A lone climber hauls himself up a sheer wall of rock toward a valley nobody is allowed to enter.

42236.label: How he came here
42236.recap: The tale of the treasure that drew him to this kingdom, and of the rival envoy who threatens to squeeze him out.

42236.label: Into the empty valley
42236.recap: He drops into the deserted vale and picks his way past broken fountains toward the domed palace.

42236.label: Behind the golden door
42236.recap: In a small marble chamber he finds not a statue but a perfectly preserved body dressed in gold and silk.

42236.label: Tapping the walls
42236.recap: Hunting for a hidden crypt, he learns how the oracle's voice was worked, and then a gong sounds.

42236.label: The black river
42236.recap: Swept along a lightless channel, he fights his way to a ladder and climbs back up into the palace.

42236.label: The goddess stirs
42236.recap: The body he examined earlier opens its eyes and speaks to him.

42236.label: Out at dusk
42236.recap: He slips out into the valley to deal with the man waiting among the lotus trees.

42236.label: The priests arrive
42236.recap: The high priest and his acolytes enter the palace by torchlight to put their question to the oracle.

42236.label: A crack in the marble
42236.recap: A scrap of torn silk shows him a hidden stair leading down beneath the oracle chamber.

42236.label: The dragon-mouth door
42236.recap: Following a trail through the moonlit brush, he finds a great carved door standing open in the cliff.

42236.label: The cavern of the river
42236.recap: From a high stone gallery he looks down on the altar where the priests have finally stopped.

42243.label: A midnight ritual
42243.recap: Four men work a sorcerous ceremony over a jade sarcophagus in a shuttered chamber while something scratches at the door.

42243.label: Plague, crown and war
42243.recap: Plague and a change of king in Nemedia are followed by a sudden invasion, and two armies camp on either side of a shallow valley.

42243.label: Carried to Belverus
42243.recap: Conan is brought helpless into the enemy capital and wakes in chains before a calm, golden-voiced stranger.

42243.label: Down in the pits
42243.recap: Chained in a lightless dungeon beneath the palace, Conan hears keys turning in locks he cannot see.

42243.label: Through the sleeping palace
42243.recap: Out of the pits at last, he follows his rescuer along corridors toward a horse hidden beyond the city wall.

42243.label: The ride for the border
42243.recap: He rides hard westward across sleeping country, leaving the roads and their watchtowers behind him.

42243.label: Into the occupied city
42243.recap: A one-eyed traveller with a heavy staff walks into his own captured capital, where enemy soldiers now shoulder people aside.

42243.label: A black boat southward
42243.recap: A funeral boat that other craft refuse to approach carries two fugitives two hundred miles down the great river.

42243.label: Waking at sea
42243.recap: He comes to aboard a trading galley, weaponless among jeering sailors and chained oarsmen, some of whom know his face.

42243.label: Into a hostile port
42243.recap: Dressed as a fisherman, he slips into a southern city where strangers are barely tolerated after dark.

42243.label: The hosts converge
42243.recap: Word spreads that the king is alive, and rival armies manoeuvre for a crossing of a snow-swollen river.

42243.label: The valley of lions
42243.recap: Both armies take their ground in a narrow terraced valley for a battle neither side can walk away from.

42259.label: A king dies
42259.recap: The young king of Vendhya dies of no visible cause while his sister keeps a helpless vigil, and across the city a man in a green turban explains to a nobleman how such a thing is done.

42259.label: A climber at the window
42259.recap: A hillman drops from the parapet into the governor's chamber to bargain for seven imprisoned tribesmen, and the parley ends in sudden violence.

42259.label: A maid slips away
42259.recap: While the fortress turns out its guard, a servant girl runs to the city and urges the man who loves her to use his masters' forbidden arts for themselves.

42259.label: At the prison gate
42259.recap: A sentry finds a stranger standing before him whose eyes take away his will, and the inner doors of the prison give way.

42259.label: Into the Zhaibar
42259.recap: Carried at speed up into the pass, captive and captor ride straight into a javelin out of the dark and must throw in their lot with hill raiders.

42259.label: Morning in the village
42259.recap: Waking in a chief's hut, the Devi eats rough fare, refuses to write the ransom letter, and listens through a loop-hole while angry warriors argue over her.

42259.label: An errand and a bead
42259.recap: A humiliated tribesman meets a robed stranger sitting beside the path and walks back to the village carrying a small polished black sphere.

42259.label: A trade on the trail
42259.recap: A gold coin buys a passing hill-girl's clothes, and the Devi steps out from behind a rock looking like another creature altogether.

42259.label: On the high ledge
42259.recap: The stallion balks on a ledge above a precipice, and the man in the green turban is waiting there for them.

42259.label: The Master's hall
42259.recap: Yasmina comes to her senses in a shadowed room hung with dragons, facing a calm seated man who says he has already read her mind.

42259.label: Climbing Yimsha
42259.recap: A small band leaves the horses and toils up the naked slope toward the seers' tower, and the mountain begins to strike back at them.

42259.label: After the fighting
42259.recap: With the valley cleared, the Cimmerian comes up the ridge bloody and torn to where the Devi sits among her nobles, and they settle the reckoning between them in their own fashion.

42389.label: Jarlshof on the cliff
42389.recap: The ruined earl's mansion at the southern tip of Zetland is described, along with the silent stranger who has taken it and the plain, generous landlord of the district.

42389.label: Two sisters at Burgh-Westra
42389.recap: The dark and serious Minna and the fair and merry Brenda are introduced as the indulged daughters of the old Udaller.

42389.label: Leaving before the weather turns
42389.recap: Mordaunt insists on walking home across the wastes although his hosts read every sign of a coming gale in the sky and the seabirds.

42389.label: A door that will not open
42389.recap: The new Scottish tacksman and his frugal sister argue over whether to admit a soaked stranger who is hammering at their door in the tempest.

42389.label: An unexpected guest
42389.recap: Norna of Fitful-head arrives at the shaking house and warns the company that anyone who wishes to live should leave it.

42389.label: A hulk in the roost
42389.recap: From the top of Sumburgh Head father and son watch a dismasted vessel drift helplessly toward the foot of the precipice.

42389.label: Weighing the stranger
42389.recap: Left without his father's counsel, Mordaunt turns over his own uneasy feelings about the shipwrecked captain and the handsome gun he accepted from him.

42389.label: The great feast
42389.recap: Guests arrive by pony and by boat in such numbers that the Udaller's open house can barely hold them all for the festival.

42389.label: The house on the rock
42389.recap: Norna's home, an ancient stone tower perched on a point of rock and cut off by a chasm, is described in detail.

42389.label: Alone in the ruined hall
42389.recap: In Kirkwall, Cleveland paces the empty banqueting hall of the Earl's Palace, dressed now in a richly laced uniform.

42389.label: A request at sunrise
42389.recap: Brenda wakes Mordaunt at his post and begs him to let the two sisters slip quietly out to the Standing Stones of Stennis.

42389.label: The frigate's captain
42389.recap: Captain Weatherport reaches Kirkwall and produces the letter that brought him, which the Provost swears he never wrote.

42486.label: A story by the fire
42486.recap: On Christmas eve a guest promises the company a written account far worse than the tale they have just heard, and sends to town for it.

42486.label: Arriving at Bly
42486.recap: A young governess reaches the country house, meets the housekeeper and the little girl, and finds the place far lovelier than she had feared.

42486.label: A man on the tower
42486.recap: During her evening walk she looks up at the house and sees a stranger standing on the battlements, staring steadily down at her.

42486.label: What happened by the lake
42486.recap: She tells the housekeeper about a second figure she saw across the water while sitting quietly with the little girl.

42486.label: The stair at dawn
42486.recap: Unable to sleep, she carries a candle out into the passage and comes within sight of the great window over the staircase.

42486.label: The lawn by moonlight
42486.recap: Back in her room she finds a bed empty, and later goes hunting through the dark house for a window that commands the grounds.

42486.label: Across the water
42486.recap: At the lake she finally says a forbidden name out loud in front of both the housekeeper and the child.

42486.label: The last evening
42486.recap: Alone in a room with the boy, she presses him for the truth while keeping his back turned to the window.

42486.label: An old hall, an old servant
42486.recap: In the second story an ageing caretaker waits in a shabby, magnificent country hall for the visitors expected that afternoon.

42486.label: The heir and the creditor
42486.recap: The young owner of the house arrives at last and learns exactly how completely the man holding his mortgages has him.

42486.label: An American in raptures
42486.recap: A visiting American lady sweeps through the house praising every inch of it, and tries to carry the butler home with her.

42486.label: Under the portraits
42486.recap: A party of sightseers looks up at the old pictures while their guide is asked to identify one of them.
