42681.label: Two smiths and a bottle
42681.recap: A man dressed as a workman waits by the Seine bridge and buys wine for a tired traveller of his own trade, then begins asking questions.

42681.label: Three odd customers
42681.recap: Three strange figures take the next table, and the locksmith learns that none of them is quite what the clothes suggest.

42681.label: The road into Paris
42681.recap: The royal family is escorted from Versailles to the capital through a crowd that cheers for everyone except its king.

42681.label: An old master revealed
42681.recap: The king's physician is led to a hidden house where his host sheds a disguise and shows how closely he has followed his career.

42681.label: Home to the farm
42681.recap: A young village hero returns to the Billet farmhouse in his helmet and sabre, hoping the farmer's daughter will notice.

42681.label: The rendezvous in the wood
42681.recap: Pitou keeps watch on the path to a hunting lodge and finds a way to let Catherine know that he knows.

42681.label: A first conversation
42681.recap: A count in mourning calls at last on the wife he married and never lived with, and they speak carefully around everything that matters.

42681.label: The portrait of Charles
42681.recap: Louis keeps returning to a painting of a doomed English king, and asks his physician for a plain reading of his own position.

42681.label: Blood on his cuffs
42681.recap: Arriving from a lynching he tried to stop, the doctor presses the queen to accept the two men who could still save the crown.

42681.label: Back at the royal forge
42681.recap: The king's old locksmith is admitted to the palace workshop with a new apprentice, and grumbles his way through the reunion.

42681.label: A whist table and a rumour
42681.recap: At a Christmas reception the talk turns to a new execution machine, while four players discuss a plan of escape over cards.

42681.label: Under Catherine's window
42681.recap: Hidden in the willows, Pitou watches a rider approach the farm and a father wait in the dark with a loaded gun.

43063.label: A farewell breakfast
43063.recap: The narrator promises an account of one young man killing another, then begins with a cheerful morning party in a Chelsea studio.

43063.label: On the studio roof
43063.recap: A torn parachute lodges on the roof and one of the guests climbs out over the tiles to reach the men caught in it.

43063.label: The host comes up
43063.recap: The missing host reappears from the cellar behaving so oddly that two of his friends quietly begin to watch him.

43063.label: The man in the pub
43063.recap: The narrator, a journalist, goes hunting for ordinary opinion in a crowded saloon bar near the scene.

43063.label: Back that evening
43063.recap: Returning to the house at dusk, the narrator finds his host worn out and learns the name of the surviving flyer.

43063.label: The Yorkshire coast
43063.recap: The narrator describes the wide chalk uplands where the family has gone, and the young girl who seems made for them.

43063.label: The Inspector calls
43063.recap: A police inspector arrives with careful questions and the friends quietly close ranks around a version of events.

43063.label: Meeting the flyer
43063.recap: The narrator finally meets the surviving airman, convalescing with a stick among the Esdailes at the coast.

43063.label: The framer's shop
43063.recap: A visit to a dusty picture-framer convinces the narrator to keep his own discoveries to himself for now.

43063.label: Painting on the cliff
43063.recap: On the cliff-top the painter loses patience with the endless motor-bicycle chatter of the two young people he is trying to paint.

43063.label: Glasses raised
43063.recap: The party gathers one last time for a toast and a taxi before a departure.

43936.label: Gray Kansas
43936.recap: A little girl, her dog and a bare one-room prairie house are caught up by a cyclone.

43936.label: A soft landing
43936.recap: The house comes down in a country of astonishing beauty, where small people greet her with startling news.

43936.label: A wink from a pole
43936.recap: On the road of yellow brick she finds a stuffed man on a pole who would very much like to come with her.

43936.label: A groan in the wood
43936.recap: Groaning in the trees leads them to a man made of tin who has not been able to move for a year.

43936.label: The roaring beast
43936.recap: A lion springs into the road, and Dorothy tells him exactly what she thinks of him.

43936.label: Two great ditches
43936.recap: Deep gulfs cut the road in two places, and something with the body of a bear and the head of a tiger comes after them.

43936.label: The green city
43936.recap: Inside the walls everything glitters green, and each traveller is summoned before the great Oz alone.

43936.label: Westward
43936.recap: They set out across an empty country where a one-eyed witch is already watching them from her door.

43936.label: The Winkies set free
43936.recap: The yellow Winkies celebrate the end of their servitude and help go looking for the missing members of the party.

43936.label: Back at the palace
43936.recap: They return to claim what was promised them, and are kept waiting outside the throne room for days.

43936.label: The witch on the ruby throne
43936.recap: A kind red-haired witch listens to Dorothy's whole story and names her price for an answer.

43936.label: Home again
43936.recap: A very short reunion beside the cabbage patch.

44608.label: The country of Farghana
44608.recap: A boy ruler surveys his small mountain-ringed country town by town, dwelling on melons, pheasants and gardens.

44608.label: Trouble at court
44608.recap: With his grandmother's counsel the household decides to remove a commander who has turned against the young ruler.

44608.label: Camped outside Samarkand
44608.recap: A long siege in worsening cold turns on a sortie by the townsmen and the sudden arrival of a rival khan.

44608.label: Landless in Tashkent
44608.recap: With no country left and most retainers gone, he lives on a kinsman's charity and quietly plans to slip away eastward.

44608.label: Setting out in exile
44608.recap: He leaves his homeland for good with a few hundred followers, most on foot, and two tents between them.

44608.label: Down through the passes
44608.recap: The army moves toward the plains, pausing in a beloved garden for drinking parties while reinforcements come up.

44608.label: Facing a larger army
44608.recap: Outnumbered and months from home, he fortifies his position with carts, ditches and branches and waits.

44608.label: Weighing the new country
44608.recap: He sets down a blunt catalogue of everything the conquered land lacks, then of what it plainly has.

44608.label: A meal goes wrong
44608.recap: A dish tastes ordinary and then does not, and he writes home an exact account of the hours that followed.

44608.label: Riding out to Gwalior
44608.recap: In his settled years he travels to inspect forts, waterworks and the gardens he has ordered cut into rock.

44608.label: Fruit from home
44608.recap: Grapes and melons grown in the new country reach his table and fill his measure of content.

44833.label: A prisoner's complaint
44833.recap: A man who has lost everything begins his book in tears, saying that only sorrowful verses will come to him now.

44833.label: A visitor at the bedside
44833.recap: As he writes, a woman of shifting height appears above him, carrying small books in one hand and a sceptre in the other.

44833.label: The wiles of Fortune
44833.recap: His visitor begins her cure by describing the double face of Fortune and the flattery she uses on those she means to ruin.

44833.label: Asking for sharper remedies
44833.recap: Comforted by her singing, he asks for the harder medicine, and she promises first to show him what false happiness looks like.

44833.label: Why the wicked prosper
44833.recap: He interrupts with the question that hurts most: how evil can flourish and go unpunished under a good governor.

44833.label: Chance and foreknowledge
44833.recap: He asks whether chance is anything at all, and she turns to the most difficult argument of the whole dialogue.

44833.label: A seer leaves Troy
44833.recap: In the besieged city a learned man foresees its fall, slips away to the Greek camp, and leaves his daughter behind him.

44833.label: An uncle comes visiting
44833.recap: On the third day of May a restless uncle rises early and walks over to his niece's house with an errand to deliver.

44833.label: Rehearsing what to say
44833.recap: A young man lies going over his speech in his head while the person he means to say it to is led in to him.

44833.label: A day of fighting
44833.recap: Greeks and Trojans meet in the field, prisoners are taken on both sides, and a truce is called so that they can be exchanged.

44833.label: The morning of departure
44833.recap: The day the fates have fixed arrives, and at dawn a rider waits to conduct her out of the town.

44833.label: The poet's farewell
44833.recap: The narrator frets about how his book will be copied and mispronounced, then sends it out with a prayer.

45451.label: Outside the chapel
45451.recap: A village schoolteacher, engaged to a young preacher bound for Africa, endures a neighbour's loud curiosity about her prospects.

45451.label: Meeting at the Roman ruins
45451.recap: An army captain home from Africa meets his cousin among old Roman walls to hear why she has chosen somebody else.

45451.label: First night at sea
45451.recap: Seasick and homesick in a crowded cabin, Lucy sails for East Africa and spends the night regretting everything.

45451.label: Married at the consulate
45451.recap: Lucy is married at the British Agency and then at the cathedral, and is handed a small parcel by the acting consul.

45451.label: Life at the mission
45451.recap: At the hill station she tries to be a missionary's wife while her husband thrives on building, teaching and fighting the slave trade.

45451.label: A station in ruins
45451.recap: The travelling party reaches a mission station and finds it burnt and deserted, and must decide who goes on and who turns back.

45451.label: Into the Happy Valley
45451.recap: The caravan descends into an untouched valley of lake and game, and its leader decides not to fire a shot in it.

45451.label: The cliff path
45451.recap: Guides lead the caravan up a precipice trail barely a foot wide, with no room anywhere to turn back.

45451.label: Back in London
45451.recap: The couple take a flat with a good address while the Foreign Office grumbles about newspapers and questions in Parliament.

45451.label: A Highland house party
45451.recap: Plain country manners and two evening dresses are quietly mocked at a shooting lodge run by an old sweetheart.

45451.label: The red crater
45451.recap: Roger rides three days north to knock on the gate of a fortified crater and face the freebooter living inside it.

45451.label: After the war
45451.recap: With the fighting past, he settles the valley again, takes in refugees, and weighs whether England is any place for him now.

45631.label: Two strangers in Saratoga
45631.recap: A free New York fiddler accepts a well-paid job from two agreeable strangers, travels south with them, and wakes in the dark in chains.

45631.label: The pen near the Capitol
45631.recap: The cellar door opens on a slave dealer who insists he is property, and answers his protests with the paddle.

45631.label: Marched through Washington
45631.recap: He and a grieving mother with her two children are handcuffed through the sleeping streets at midnight and put aboard a steamboat.

45631.label: The brig Orleans
45631.recap: On the voyage from Norfolk he is made steward, meets another man seized off the street, and hears talk of what might be attempted.

45631.label: The New Orleans showroom
45631.recap: Washed, dressed and drilled to look lively, the new lot is paraded and made to dance while buyers inspect them.

45631.label: Up the Red River
45631.recap: Sold to a Louisiana planter, he travels into the Great Pine Woods and takes up work at the mills and on the rafts.

45631.label: The hatchet
45631.recap: A carpenter's temper turns murderous over a plane stroke, and the day ends with hounds working his track through the swamp.

45631.label: A cotton planter's year
45631.recap: He describes his next owner and the round of ploughing, hoeing, picking and weighing that fills every day and fills it with fear.

45631.label: Christmas on the bayou
45631.recap: Three days of feasting, red ribbons, fiddling and dancing interrupt the year's labour.

45631.label: A sheet of paper
45631.recap: After nine years he finally obtains paper and ink, and has to decide whom he dares trust with a letter north.

45631.label: A visitor at Christmas
45631.recap: A sympathetic carpenter rides in with disappointing news and a different plan, and the two snatch a few dangerous minutes alone.

45631.label: The road home
45631.recap: The journey back runs through New Orleans, Charleston and Washington, where old accounts are taken up before he reaches his family.

46276.label: A view from above
46276.recap: The narrator hovers over the Sonoran wilds and picks out several small parties all converging on one spot.

46276.label: An arrow in the thicket
46276.recap: An unseen archer kills the last companion of three starving travellers, who are already without horses or weapons.

46276.label: A night in the branches
46276.recap: The young Mexican hoists his companions onto a broken cottonwood and keeps watch below until sleep takes him.

46276.label: The runaway Englishman
46276.recap: The book backs up to introduce a sailor who ran away to sea at twelve and has been pleasing himself ever since.

46276.label: A map copied in silver
46276.recap: With a storm coming on, the Englishman copies a chart scratched in the dirt onto cigarette paper.

46276.label: Shelter in the tower
46276.recap: Driven by weather, he makes for a strange old brick tower standing alone on the plain.

46276.label: Monte at the banker's
46276.recap: At a merchant's villa the Englishman is drawn into a card game against a room full of strangers.

46276.label: Fitting out for the hunt
46276.recap: With a vessel to command he picks a crew and looks for divers who can work an oyster bed.

46276.label: The editor objects
46276.recap: The author pauses to write "The End" and his editor stops his hand and demands more.

46276.label: Riders at the ranch door
46276.recap: A large mounted band halts outside a lonely ranch while the innkeeper parleys through a wicket.

46276.label: The garrison waits
46276.recap: Besieged defenders watch through the night for a signal from the men who slipped out of the walls.

46276.label: Blade against blade
46276.recap: Two long-standing enemies settle their account face to face with steel, watched by a single witness.

47221.label: Rescue off Capreae
47221.recap: At dawn a Batavian traveller's galley spots a small pleasure boat caught by a rising squall and turns to take its passengers aboard.

47221.label: Up the hill to the villa
47221.recap: The rescued party is carried home through the crowded pleasure resort while their new guest rides beside the litters, asking the way.

47221.label: A summons by moonlight
47221.recap: Quintus climbs to a hilltop pavilion to meet the writer of an anonymous letter, and finds out who has sent for him.

47221.label: Before dawn in the garden
47221.recap: Unable to sleep, Quintus broods on two faces he cannot get out of his head until his cousin comes out and finds him.

47221.label: Leaving Baiae
47221.recap: On the morning of departure Quintus teases his cousin over the packing and slips out to watch one last sunrise over the bay.

47221.label: The priest's morning levee
47221.recap: In Rome the high priest works through a hall full of petitioners, then hears from Caesar's adjutant what the crowd shouted at the races.

47221.label: A banquet in the city
47221.recap: At a supper of staggering luxury the Batavian gapes at the plate on the table and argues with his neighbour about a fashionable poet.

47221.label: Night visit to Isis
47221.recap: Cornelia slips out after dark with her maid and a slave to lay a troubling dream before the priest of the temple of Isis.

47221.label: The Empress alone
47221.recap: Reconciled in public with her husband that morning, Domitia lies among her cushions turning humiliation into something colder and more patient.

47221.label: Six men in a small house
47221.recap: After a deliberately dull supper the guests move through to the study, where the conversation they actually came for can begin.

47221.label: Across country in the rain
47221.recap: A small party carries an injured man through storm-soaked fields and under aqueduct arches toward a road, sharing the load as they tire.

47221.label: At the end of the walk
47221.recap: At the far end of a garden path Aurelius realises the afternoon is nearly gone and asks Claudia the question he has been carrying.

47262.label: A boy watching for boats
47262.recap: He traces a seafaring family line and remembers racing to a clay bank as a six-year-old to watch steamers pass.

47262.label: Dugouts at the levee
47262.recap: He describes the Chippewa and Sioux who traded at Prescott and the old battle relics boys dug from the sand to sell to tourists.

47262.label: Life on the levee
47262.recap: The raft crews, the saloons, the warehouses and his father's transfer business make the little river town hum.

47262.label: Below decks
47262.recap: He sets out frankly how crews were made up before the war and what kind of man the mate had to be.

47262.label: Knowing the river
47262.recap: He explains what piloting meant when there were no lights, no beacons and nothing but the shapes of distant bluffs to steer by.

47262.label: A night storm
47262.recap: Left in charge of a loaded boat for the first time, he heads up the lake into a wall of wind, rain and lightning.

47262.label: Cardsharps aboard
47262.recap: He sorts the fiction of river gambling from what he actually saw, and describes the men who worked the forward cabin.

47262.label: The truth about racing
47262.recap: He deflates the legend of steamboat races and explains why boats really hurried each other to a landing.

47262.label: Wildcat money
47262.recap: He recalls the worthless banknotes and paper towns that separated settlers and eastern buyers from their savings.

47262.label: A preacher at the wheel
47262.recap: He introduces a captain who was also a Methodist preacher, and the wreck he saw him handle.

47262.label: War pulls men away
47262.recap: A battery is moved downriver as the country goes to war, watched closely by hundreds of Indians camped before the fort.

47262.label: Living it over again
47262.recap: Twenty years off the river, he walks aboard a passing steamer, finds his old chief in the pilot house, and is invited to take a trick at the wheel.

47960.label: The chorus sets the scene
47960.recap: A prologue announces two feuding households in Verona and the lovers born between them.

47960.label: Servants pick a fight
47960.recap: Two swaggering servingmen trade jokes and then deliberately provoke men of the rival house in the street.

47960.label: Masked on the way to a feast
47960.recap: Young men in masks banter outside a party, and one of them spins a long fantasy about dreams.

47960.label: Under the window
47960.recap: Hidden in an orchard at night, a young man overhears the girl above him speak her mind.

47960.label: A hot day in the square
47960.recap: Friends argue about who is the more quarrelsome just as their rivals come down the street.

47960.label: Parting at dawn
47960.recap: Two lovers argue over whether the bird they hear means night or morning.

47960.label: A father fixes a date
47960.recap: A grieving household suddenly settles on a wedding day without consulting the bride.

47960.label: Alone with a vial
47960.recap: Left by herself at night, a young woman talks herself through every terror before she drinks.

47960.label: News reaches Mantua
47960.recap: An exile wakes in good spirits and then receives word from home from his servant.

47960.label: Night in the churchyard
47960.recap: A mourner comes secretly to a tomb with flowers, and hears someone else approaching in the dark.

48296.label: Wager of Battle
48296.recap: In a Tyrolese inn the Englishmen Will and Florian watch a fierce village dance among the mountain folk.

48296.label: And If For Ever
48296.recap: The witty Florian argues Will past his hesitations over the peasant singer Linnet.

48296.label: Florian on Matrimony
48296.recap: A happy excursion in the Dolomites, with Florian holding forth on love and marriage.

48296.label: Auld Lang Syne
48296.recap: Back in London, Will wanders Bond Street with his head full of melodies and memories.

48296.label: Playing with Fire
48296.recap: A celebrated singer now and married to Andreas, Linnet finds a guilty happiness in Will's nearness.

48296.label: Open War
48296.recap: A compromising scene throws Linnet's marriage into open crisis.

48296.label: A Confession of Faith
48296.recap: Newly widowed and grieving among her own people, Linnet feels how far she has outgrown them.

48320.label: The masked visitor
48320.recap: Watson calls on his old friend and finds him expecting a caller who has warned that he will arrive in a mask.

48320.label: A red-headed client
48320.recap: A stout pawnbroker with flaming hair produces a newspaper advertisement and begins a very odd complaint.

48320.label: Stranger than invention
48320.recap: Holmes argues that real life outstrips any novelist just as a new client comes up the street.

48320.label: A wire at breakfast
48320.recap: A telegram pulls Watson away from his table and out to a tragedy in the West of England.

48320.label: A visitor in the storm
48320.recap: On a wild night a young man up from Horsham arrives at Baker Street asking for advice and for help.

48320.label: Errand to the riverside
48320.recap: Watson promises a distressed wife that he will fetch her husband out of an opium den in the east of London.

48320.label: The lost hat and goose
48320.recap: Two days after Christmas Holmes is examining a battered hat left behind in a street scuffle.

48320.label: The early caller
48320.recap: A veiled woman with prematurely grey hair arrives before breakfast, shaking with something other than cold.

48320.label: The engineer's collapse
48320.recap: A hydraulic engineer arrives at Watson's surgery fresh from a night journey and breaks down before he can speak.

48320.label: A nobleman writes ahead
48320.recap: A titled bridegroom sends word that he will call at four to consult Holmes about a painful wedding-day event.

48320.label: Running through the snow
48320.recap: From the bow window the two men watch a richly dressed gentleman come racing down Baker Street.

48320.label: The governess's question
48320.recap: A young woman writes asking whether she ought to accept a strangely generous offer of a situation.

48893.label: In defence of vice
48893.recap: The author opens with a mocking preface aimed at journalists who have appointed themselves guardians of public virtue.

48893.label: A letter to Silvio
48893.recap: In his first letter a restless young man tells his oldest friend how monotonous his days are and how badly he wants a mistress.

48893.label: Hunting a mistress
48893.recap: He sets out through the town appraising every woman he passes, and comes home with nothing but complaints.

48893.label: The showman's gallery
48893.recap: A worldly friend walks him around a crowded soirée, pricing each woman there and explaining how to approach her.

48893.label: The titular lover
48893.recap: Installed as the pink lady's acknowledged lover, he finds society treats him differently and examines what he actually feels.

48893.label: A kiss on horseback
48893.recap: Riding under an avenue of elms at sunset, he comes nearer to being genuinely in love than he ever has.

48893.label: Five months of Rosette
48893.recap: Five months into the affair he takes stock of an attachment that pleases him without ever moving him.

48893.label: A young cavalier arrives
48893.recap: A newly arrived guest at the country house strikes him as the most beautiful creature he has ever seen, to his own confusion.

48893.label: The sleeping page
48893.recap: The book leaves the letters behind to watch the new arrival carry his exhausted page to bed and sit beside him for hours.

48893.label: A knock after nightfall
48893.recap: A soft voice knocks at Théodore's door late in the evening, and the visitor is let in.

48893.label: The branch across the path
48893.recap: Racing to rejoin the hunt, the little page is swept from the saddle, and the lady who kneels to revive him makes a discovery.

48893.label: The last letter
48893.recap: Writing to Silvio again, he confesses that he has at last fallen in love and that the fact horrifies him.

49402.label: The man himself
49402.recap: The book opens with a close physical and temperamental portrait of Black Hawk drawn from his autobiography and from travellers who met him.

49402.label: A disputed treaty
49402.recap: Black Hawk's own account of the 1804 land treaty is set out at length beside the author's rebuttal of it.

49402.label: Fort Madison rises
49402.recap: A fort goes up at the Des Moines Rapids, chiefs are consulted, and rumours of an attack begin reaching its small garrison.

49402.label: Major Taylor on the river
49402.recap: A detachment under Zachary Taylor is sent against the Rock River village, and his own report of the running fight is quoted in full.

49402.label: Settlers pour in
49402.recap: Bounty land warrants open the Military Tract and waves of settlers move north toward the old village, hardening feeling on both sides.

49402.label: Father Dixon's ferry
49402.recap: The lone ferry and log house on Rock River becomes the hinge of the campaign, and its hospitable owner is introduced.

49402.label: Supper at Old Man's Creek
49402.recap: Militia camp beside a swollen creek, three men arrive with a white flag, and an undisciplined camp loses its head.

49402.label: Following a false trail
49402.recap: A scouting party works out that the southward trail was a ruse, just as word of killings at Indian Creek reaches the army.

49402.label: Riders to Apple River
49402.recap: Three dispatch riders reach a lightly held fort at noon and ride straight into an ambush a few hundred yards beyond it.

49402.label: The steamboat and the river
49402.recap: A gunboat on the Mississippi opens fire on a camp at the mouth of the Bad Axe, and the pursuing army closes in overland.

49402.label: Taken east
49402.recap: A rival chief works for the prisoners' release while orders send them instead to Washington and on to Fortress Monroe.

49402.label: The cabin by the river
49402.recap: In his last years he settles beside the Des Moines, keeps company with white neighbours, and chooses the ground where he wishes to lie.

49987.label: Merry England
49987.recap: The tale opens with a fond picture of old merry England in the greenwood days of long ago.

49987.label: A May Day
49987.recap: On a warm May day the story moves among the outlaws and gentlefolk of Sherwood.

49987.label: Opposite Scenes
49987.recap: Fortunes turn swiftly, with revelry and anguish standing side by side as the plot thickens.

49987.label: A Midnight Vigil
49987.recap: Imprisoned in the castle, Hugh de Monthermer keeps a midnight vigil, facing the shadow of death.

49987.label: The Eve of Battle
49987.recap: All Nottingham fills with crowds on the eve of a trial by combat that will decide everything.

49987.label: The Wager of Battle
49987.recap: By the Trent the lists are raised for the great wager of battle, with the king and ladies looking on.

50133.label: The road to Dunwich
50133.recap: A traveller who takes a wrong fork finds a decayed hill country of stone circles, whippoorwills and shuttered houses that outsiders learn to avoid.

50133.label: A birth at Candlemas
50133.recap: A child is born before dawn at an isolated hillside farm, and his grandfather boasts strangely to the village about the father.

50133.label: Sounds from upstairs
50133.recap: Callers notice that the boy and his grandfather spend their days behind a boarded-up upper storey that nobody is allowed to enter.

50133.label: A doctor at midnight
50133.recap: A doctor is fetched to the farmhouse, where the dying old man gives his grandson a last set of instructions.

50133.label: A visit to the library
50133.recap: The grown boy travels to a university town to consult a guarded book, and the librarian looks over his shoulder and refuses him.

50133.label: Night alarm at the library
50133.recap: A watchdog and a scream wake half the town, and three men unlock the library doors to find out what got inside.

50133.label: Tracks toward the glen
50133.recap: The countryside gathers to stare at enormous round prints and flattened fields that lead down into a ravine nobody will enter.

50133.label: Barricaded farms
50133.recap: Families bar their doors and sit in silence while something works among the barns in the dark.

50133.label: Breaking the cipher
50133.recap: In Arkham a librarian works night after night over a coded ledger until the strange alphabet finally gives up its meaning.

50133.label: Three men from Arkham
50133.recap: The three scholars drive to the stricken valley, question the frightened natives and prepare to keep watch near the glen.

50133.label: On the hilltop
50133.recap: Watchers in the road below see the daylight change over the summit while a chant rises from three tiny figures on the ridge.

50290.label: A fight in the dark
50290.recap: Unarmed and in total darkness, Corriston dodges the blows of a knife-carrying stranger deep inside a ship.

50290.label: Arrival at the Station
50290.recap: Half an hour earlier, passengers crowd the viewscreen as the great artificial moon rises, and Corriston starts talking to the woman beside him.

50290.label: The lounge door
50290.recap: A bodyguard grows uneasy as women come and go from the ladies' lounge and his charge does not.

50290.label: The sanity cell
50290.recap: Nobody believes his account, and Corriston finds himself confined on the Station as a case of space-shock.

50290.label: A freighter falls
50290.recap: From the Station's promenade Corriston watches a runaway freighter spiral down toward Earth.

50290.label: Hiding in the machinery
50290.recap: Hunted by guards, Corriston wakes in a rag bin among the Station's machinery and hears a voice through the wall.

50290.label: Toward the control room
50290.recap: Corriston moves along the corridors toward the main control room, grimly resolved on a very brief kind of violence.

50290.label: A shadowed cabin
50290.recap: In a dim cabin two people finally get a quiet moment to talk to each other.

50290.label: At the point of a gun
50290.recap: Held at gunpoint in the chart room, Corriston answers hard practical questions about the long flight to Mars.

50290.label: A town on Mars
50290.recap: The story reaches a rough colonists' settlement of prefabricated buildings on the red Martian plains.

50290.label: The sandstorm
50290.recap: A column of tractors crawls across the desert through hours of raging Martian sand.

50290.label: At the fortress gate
50290.recap: Alone on the sand, Corriston walks up to the huge steel gate of a guarded citadel with nothing but his nerve.

50498.label: Two girls on a raft
50498.recap: Jehane and her friend Nan, unmarried at twenty-five in Oxford, torment themselves over the men who never think to choose them.

50498.label: A stranger in the street
50498.recap: A caller arrives for Jehane's absent father and she leans from the window to look him over before he is shown up.

50498.label: Alone on the river
50498.recap: Left to punt home in the dusk with Barrington, Jehane says far more about her life than she meant to.

50498.label: Christmas at Topbury
50498.recap: Jehane is invited to Topbury for Christmas, where Barrington's shabby, joking cousin Ocky Waffles begins paying her attention.

50498.label: Peter's first parting
50498.recap: Four-year-old Peter is packed off to his aunt's house while his parents travel, and comes home asking his mother for a baby.

50498.label: The home life of a financier
50498.recap: Ocky blusters about his prospects and his rich relations while Jehane, worn thin, measures him against the man she lost.

50498.label: Waiting for the smash
50498.recap: Letters stop coming and the Topbury household passes foggy November days dreading news of Ocky's business.

50498.label: A secret on Christmas Eve
50498.recap: Amid the family's Christmas cheer Peter lies awake, sick with a secret he has kept from his father.

50498.label: The haunted wood
50498.recap: Peter and his sister Kay tricycle out to the countryside hideaway they have told no one about, and find it strangely empty.

50498.label: A night with the moon
50498.recap: Nineteen and out of his depth, Peter drifts downstream in the moonlight with the girl who has upended his summer.

50498.label: The spreading of wings
50498.recap: Peter leaves for Oxford, and his mother feels the first of all the departures still to come.

50498.label: Back to the river
50498.recap: Older and quieter, Peter travels by punt to a riverside inn, looking for someone he spent years overlooking.

50508.label: First sight of the fleet
50508.recap: A twelve-year-old is rowed out to a flagship, shouts at the oarsmen to row faster, and gets his first lesson in naval etiquette.

50508.label: Joining a great ship
50508.recap: He climbs aboard his first ship to an unflattering remark from two old hands, and finds he loves the place anyway.

50508.label: Strict service
50508.recap: He serves under a captain who would not use steam, in a ship famous for smartness and hard discipline.

50508.label: Cruising with a prince
50508.recap: Newly a lieutenant, he joins a frigate commanded by a royal duke for a long voyage to the far side of the world.

50508.label: An Irish election
50508.recap: He marches tenants to the poll in a Kerry contest, then loses an argument in the street rather abruptly.

50508.label: To India with the Prince
50508.recap: He is attached to the royal suite for a state visit to India and lists the extraordinary company he travelled with.

50508.label: Riot in Alexandria
50508.recap: Driving into the city to look for a missing wife, he is surrounded by a mob and has to turn the horses in a blocked street.

50508.label: Ordered up the Nile
50508.recap: He is appointed to the staff of a relief expedition and sails for Egypt as the boats and stores go up the river.

50508.label: The square at Abu Klea
50508.recap: A column is caught with one corner of its square still open as thousands of Arabs come on at a gallop.

50508.label: A steamer sent to rescue
50508.recap: A patched-up river steamer is loaded with picked men and guns and sent off to reach a stranded force.

50508.label: Fighting for the fleet
50508.recap: Out of the Admiralty and into public argument, he presses for a shipbuilding programme and finds the case made independently inside the service.

50508.label: Hauling down the flag
50508.recap: After fifty years' service he is ordered ashore, and old shipmates crowd the Hard and the station to see him home.

50559.label: A lord's practical joke
50559.recap: A hunting lord finds a drunken tinker asleep outside an alehouse and decides to carry him home and treat him as a nobleman.

50559.label: The wooing plan
50559.recap: Left alone to wait for the elder daughter, a bold suitor lays out exactly how he will answer whatever she says to him.

50559.label: Bidding for Bianca
50559.recap: Two rivals outbid each other in ships, farms and ducats for the younger sister's hand while her father totals the offers.

50559.label: Arrival at the country house
50559.recap: A frozen, beaten servant reaches his master's house ahead of the newlyweds and demands a fire from the household staff.

50559.label: The wedding banquet
50559.recap: The Padua households sit down together at last, and the teasing at table quickly turns into a contest between the wives.

50559.label: Mourning at Rousillon
50559.recap: A widowed countess parts with her son for the king's court while a dead physician's daughter listens in black beside them.

50559.label: A maid chooses a husband
50559.recap: Restored to health, the king lines up his young lords and grants his healer the right to name whichever one she wants.

50559.label: Gossip in the camp
50559.recap: Two French officers trade uneasy news about the young count's conduct in Florence and prepare a trap for his boastful companion.

50559.label: Washed up in Illyria
50559.recap: A shipwrecked young woman questions the captain about her missing brother and about the duke who governs this strange coast.

50559.label: The box-tree
50559.recap: A steward strolls in the garden imagining his own greatness, unaware that three delighted eavesdroppers are crouching in the hedge.

50559.label: A king turns jealous
50559.recap: Watching his wife charm his oldest friend into staying, a king talks himself into a bitter certainty about them both.

50559.label: On a wild shore
50559.recap: A lord lands a baby on a deserted coast under a gathering storm, obeying an oath he bitterly regrets, and a shepherd comes by afterwards.

50559.label: The sheep-shearing
50559.recap: A prince in a swain's clothes praises the shepherdess presiding over the feast, while she frets about what his father would say.

50559.label: In the chapel
50559.recap: Guests come to a private chapel to look at a statue that the sculptor has made unnervingly like the living woman.

51428.label: The prettiest wedding
51428.recap: A comparatively poor young Guardsman marries a rich, club-loving girl, and the season's smartest wedding is followed by four cloudless months.

51428.label: Bad news in Paris
51428.recap: On a Paris terrace in Grand Prix week the bride confesses a private terror to her husband, and he answers her badly.

51428.label: A spill on the avenue
51428.recap: A motorcyclist crashes to avoid a careless woman, and the dusty young inventor who picks himself up turns out to be no stranger.

51428.label: Patrine at dinner
51428.recap: At a London dinner a striking, outspoken young woman trades sharp talk with a Prussian guest who admires her far too openly.

51428.label: A Paris pleasure garden
51428.recap: In a lamplit garden a wager about hair colour ends in an insult that cannot be answered in public.

51428.label: A scout's new badge
51428.recap: A doctor's twelve-year-old son comes into the consulting room to show off a hard-won badge and share a secret.

51428.label: A word at the aerodrome
51428.recap: At a flying ground a watchful old chief decides to set a Boy Scout's sharp eyes on a foreign visitor.

51428.label: High over England
51428.recap: Strapped into a cockpit far above the fields, the boy taps out signals to the pilot and gets no reassuring answers.

51428.label: The house waits
51428.recap: A grim account is finished for a mother's sake, and the household settles into prayer and sleeplessness.

51428.label: News at the club
51428.recap: An engagement is announced over cigarettes, and a young officer works out what a family death may mean for his own prospects.

51428.label: A ruined market town
51428.recap: A hurt man hidden in a wrecked house watches a German aeroplane land, then hears an English voice crying in the street.

51428.label: Flanders in April
51428.recap: In a shelled Flemish city a blinded flyer walks among the ruins with the woman who loves him.

51649.label: The keeper and his prisoners
51649.recap: A disguised jailer moves along an underground passage, speaking through grated traps to the prisoners he keeps in the cells.

51649.label: Down to the worst cell
51649.recap: A young woman takes a lamp and walks alone to the end of the passage to speak through the door of the most dangerous prisoner.

51649.label: The Insolvent Debtors' Court
51649.recap: The narrator takes the reader into the shabby court where bankrupts are heard, and through the crowd that gathers outside it.

51649.label: A projected railway
51649.recap: A hurrying promoter arrives with a roll of papers at the aggressively new mansion of a very rich man, quarrelling with his cabman as he goes.

51649.label: Two women on the road
51649.recap: On a stifling night two footsore women, one old and sinister, one young and beautiful, toil along the highroad toward London.

51649.label: Accosted in Pall Mall
51649.recap: After a week of evening watching outside a nobleman's house, an old woman finally stops the young man she has been waiting for.

51649.label: A dressmaker in the rain
51649.recap: A long inset tale begins with a young workwoman carrying a finished dress through a downpour on Oxford Street.

51649.label: Bailiffs at the door
51649.recap: Left alone in bed without his only pair of trousers, a captain hears two men downstairs asking very politely for him.

51649.label: Laura in Paris
51649.recap: Alone in Paris, Laura buys a carriage, takes boxes at the theatres and sets herself methodically to being talked about.

51649.label: The three ruined houses
51649.recap: The narrative doubles back to describe three blackened, shuttered houses that have been left to rot for twenty years.

51649.label: On Shooter's Hill
51649.recap: Two exhausted men climb to the top of a moonlit hill, look up and down the empty road, and stop as if by agreement.

51649.label: Accounts settled
51649.recap: The narrator gathers up the characters still outstanding and reports, one by one, what became of each of them.

52404.label: Ambush at the platform
52404.recap: A young Englishman waiting for a shuttle train beside a wood is jumped by two armed men and fights them both off.

52404.label: A stranger asks a favour
52404.recap: An American painter in a noisy French market crowd is approached by an Englishman who says he needs a friend, not money.

52404.label: The thin envelope
52404.recap: The Englishman hands over a long, very thin envelope for safekeeping, and the two men quietly take each other's measure.

52404.label: The cabaret cashier
52404.recap: In a provincial cabaret the painter coaxes the thin, heavily painted young cashier down from her high chair to dance.

52404.label: Orders behind the counter
52404.recap: The cabaret's patron makes plain that he has set the girl to pump his customers for information, and orders her to keep at it.

52404.label: A shot from the willows
52404.recap: A rifle shot fired across the fields drives Halkett into a village schoolroom, where a young Sister of Charity calmly demands to know why.

52404.label: News from the road
52404.recap: At the inn garden Halkett frets about a friend who never arrived, and repeats what he has just learned by telephone.

52404.label: The year of war dawns
52404.recap: Mobilisation notices go up in the sleepy hamlet while the miller, the washerwomen and the cowherd go about their ordinary morning.

52404.label: Behind the locked door
52404.recap: Warner hammers on a locked upstairs door in the shuttered cabaret while the man on the other side holds his breath and then runs.

52404.label: The cavalry pass
52404.recap: England enters the war, and from an inn window the two men watch French heavy cavalry ride by in blazing armour and crimson breeches.

52404.label: Brought to headquarters
52404.recap: A bound prisoner is walked through the wreckage of a battlefield, past newly dug graves, to face a general's questions.

52404.label: After the guns move on
52404.recap: With the army gone east and the chateau quiet again, farewells are made under a sky thick with stars.

53154.label: A Supper at the Seigneur's
53154.recap: The young friends Jules d'Haberville and the Scottish exile Archibald Cameron are welcomed to a lavish supper at a Canadian manor.

53154.label: The Feast of St. Jean-Baptiste
53154.recap: The parish keeps the joyful midsummer feast of St Jean-Baptiste in the old Canadian way.

53154.label: Farewell at the Manor
53154.recap: A shadow falls over the manor as young Jules prepares to sail away to France.

53154.label: The Plains of Abraham
53154.recap: The fateful battle on the Plains of Abraham brings the fall of New France.

53154.label: The Family Hearth
53154.recap: After war, fire and famine have ravaged the land, the scattered family gathers once more at the hearth.

53416.label: The Thames Valley
53416.recap: In a peaceful Thames-valley evening, the artist's niece Stella Etheridge first appears.

53416.label: A First Embrace
53416.recap: A chance moment in Lord Leycester's arms kindles a sudden love between them.

53416.label: Bad News
53416.recap: Stella's uncle is thrown into anguish by sudden bad news, drawing her into worry.

53416.label: Jasper's History
53416.recap: The scheming Jasper Adelstone presses Stella with a story whose hidden meaning binds her to him.

53416.label: An Unwanted Engagement
53416.recap: Parted from Leycester, Stella finds herself engaged to the persistent Jasper.

53416.label: Far from Home
53416.recap: Talk of English scenery stirs longing as the lovers' fortunes hang in the balance.

53419.label: A confession before dawn
53419.recap: A condemned man sets out to record the plain household events that he says destroyed him, beginning with his lifelong tenderness toward animals.

53419.label: A souvenir from Normandy
53419.recap: Students are drinking and joking together when a friend bursts in carrying a grisly relic he bought at a dead sorcerer's sale.

53419.label: News in the saloon
53419.recap: In a small western town the drinkers pass around word that a young labourer has been accused of killing his employer's daughter.

53419.label: Curtains of blue denim
53419.recap: A woman visiting her friend's seaside cottage asks why every room has been draped in a colour her hostess openly dislikes.

53419.label: A room nobody uses
53419.recap: A travelling salesman begins the story of a shabby Arkansas inn and of his own request to sleep in its abandoned chamber.

53419.label: Supper and a strange room
53419.recap: A traveller blames his heavy supper for the uneasy fancies crowding in as he settles into an enormous bedroom he cannot lock.

53419.label: The face at the window
53419.recap: A solicitor becomes fixed on a mysterious woman he glimpses at the same ground floor window evening after evening.

53419.label: New faces at the spa
53419.recap: The bored guests of a watering place watch the door for arrivals and are struck by a pale young woman and her white haired father.

53419.label: Christmas hunting camp
53419.recap: A hunting party camped in the Mississippi pine woods settles by the fire to hear their driver's stories about a place he avoids after dark.

53419.label: Cheap rent, one ghost
53419.recap: A small family moves happily into a large house they could never otherwise afford, joking about the tenant they expect to share it with.

53419.label: An invitation to Yorkshire
53419.recap: An officer newly home from India accepts an old friend's pressing invitation and is shown to a tapestried room with a four-post bed.

53419.label: Christmas ride to Valley Forge
53419.recap: A young cyclist touring Pennsylvania stops at a derelict farmhouse and finds a small corked bottle lying on the hearth.

53874.label: Craigaderyn
53874.recap: At a sun-dappled luncheon on a Welsh estate, the narrator is drawn to his host's lovely daughters.

53874.label: The Waterfall
53874.recap: By a hidden waterfall and pool on the estate, romance and quiet rivalry take shape.

53874.label: Farewell to England
53874.recap: On the eve of sailing for the war, the narrator takes a wistful farewell of the English countryside.

53874.label: In the Trenches
53874.recap: In the Crimean trenches, weary from night duty, the narrator's old rival Guilfoyle resurfaces.

53874.label: A Lonely Ride
53874.recap: Riding alone through dangerous country, the narrator presses on amid the uncertainties of the campaign.

53874.label: Valerie
53874.recap: The narrator's love for Valerie deepens, shadowed by the hostility of her brother, Count Tolstoff.

53874.label: The Redan
53874.recap: The narrator joins the bloody assault on the Redan before Sebastopol.

53874.label: For Valour
53874.recap: Back in London, a grand ceremony honours the survivors of the Crimean War.

54879.label: After the giant
54879.recap: The author confesses his reluctance to write about the small world left behind once Napoleon vanished from the stage.

54879.label: A seat among the peers
54879.recap: While winning votes at Orleans he is summoned instead to the House of Peers, and his career changes direction.

54879.label: Night at the Opera
54879.recap: Roused from bed by terrible news, he pushes through crowds at the Opera and reaches the door of a box where a prince lies dying.

54879.label: Arriving in Berlin
54879.recap: As the new ambassador to Prussia he presents his credentials to a king who drives himself out each day to smoke a cigar in the park.

54879.label: A court polonaise
54879.recap: At a palace celebration two royal ladies take his arm for the dance, and a Berlin paper prints an admiring sketch of the visiting author.

54879.label: London again
54879.recap: Installed in Portland Place, he walks in Kensington Gardens among memories of the poverty and exile he once knew in England.

54879.label: What the King noticed
54879.recap: He sets down the private details behind a British minister's sudden death, including a strange conversation the King had reported to him.

54879.label: Farewell to England
54879.recap: Called away to the Congress of Verona, he takes leave of a changed England and of a woman who belonged to his youth.

54879.label: A borrowed crown
54879.recap: The King of Naples wavers between Napoleon and the Allies while his army is driven back across Italy.

54879.label: The little room upstairs
54879.recap: Reduced fortunes bring Madame Récamier to a small convent apartment that becomes the meeting place of every opinion in Paris.

54879.label: The road to Rome
54879.recap: He travels to the Roman embassy with his wife, his melancholy keeping pace with him through Switzerland and the Alps.

54879.label: Digging in the campagna
54879.recap: He opens an excavation among grassy ruins outside Rome and writes home about marble fragments and the silence of the dead.

55179.label: An Old Sweetheart
55179.recap: The narrator recalls a Scottish sweetheart whose memory has followed him through years of soldiering.

55179.label: A Reproach
55179.recap: The girl he left behind gently reproaches him for staying so long away.

55179.label: The Allied Camp
55179.recap: Among the allied armies a French Zouave flirts with the spirited vivandiere Sophie.

55179.label: The Alma
55179.recap: At the Alma the cavalry, long held back, finally surge across the river into the battle.

55179.label: After the Battle
55179.recap: Surgeons and sailors tend the wounded as the army presses on toward Sebastopol.

55179.label: A Matter of Honour
55179.recap: Wronged by a treacherous rival, the narrator faces a duel and a sleepless night.

55201.label: Down to the Piraeus
55201.recap: Socrates walks home from a new festival and is cheerfully waylaid by a group of young men who refuse to let him leave.

55201.label: The old man's garland
55201.recap: At the house of an aged host the talk turns to what old age really feels like and whether wealth makes it easier.

55201.label: A sophist interrupts
55201.recap: A blunt visitor loses patience with the polite questioning and demands a definition of justice on his own terms.

55201.label: The shepherd's ring
55201.recap: Glaucon retells a legend of a ring that grants invisibility, to test whether anyone is honest by choice rather than fear.

55201.label: Which tales to tell
55201.recap: The company argues over which stories the young should hear and which ought to be kept from them.

55201.label: Are the guardians happy?
55201.recap: An objection is raised that the imagined city makes its own protectors poor and joyless.

55201.label: Refusing to let him off
55201.recap: The listeners interrupt and insist Socrates explain the household arrangements he had tried to skip past.

55201.label: True and false philosophers
55201.recap: The discussion turns to who is fit to rule and why thinkers are so often distrusted by everyone else.

55201.label: The underground den
55201.recap: Socrates describes prisoners chained before a wall of shadows and imagines what happens when one of them is freed.

55201.label: How cities decay
55201.recap: Socrates traces the slide of a well-ordered state through a sequence of worse and worse forms of government.

55201.label: The tyrant's soul
55201.recap: The talk moves to the man ruled by his wildest appetites and asks whether such a life can be happy.

55201.label: A soldier's report
55201.recap: The dialogue closes with the story of a man slain in battle who woke on his funeral pyre with an account of the other world.

57426.label: A dog out of sorts
57426.recap: The narrator notices his dog has lost both appetite and spirits, and finally works out what the animal has been trying to tell him.

57426.label: North through Russia
57426.recap: He crosses frozen lakes and rivers toward the Urals and hires a local teamster for the last stretch of road.

57426.label: Trouble on the road
57426.recap: The hired driver turns on his passenger, and the dog settles the matter.

57426.label: The bottomless well
57426.recap: Recovering in a peasant cottage, he coaxes an old herb-woman into admitting she knows where a well without a bottom lies.

57426.label: Up to the brink
57426.recap: Left without guides, he improvises help, climbs through a wilderness of broken rock, and reaches the edge of the well.

57426.label: Sunrise below ground
57426.recap: Underground, light rises and fades like a day, and along a marble road he meets the first inhabitant of the place.

57426.label: The crystal throne
57426.recap: He is presented to the queen of the transparent folk, who is charmed by his dog's manners.

57426.label: Guards at the silver gate
57426.recap: Three small guards block his path and communicate in a way he has to puzzle out for himself.

57426.label: The dark river
57426.recap: Rowing a shell boat down an unlit river, he is set upon by pale armoured creatures in the water.

57426.label: A palace of ice
57426.recap: A glittering palace appears on the terraces above him, and he resolves to knock at its door whoever may answer.

57426.label: A ride on the ice
57426.recap: Feeling his way along a pitch-dark frozen passage, he finds the floor beneath him beginning to move.

57426.label: The rushing tunnel
57426.recap: Wind driving through a great natural pipe turns suddenly to water, and the traveller is swept helplessly along it.

57641.label: Beachbourne
57641.recap: In the Sussex town of Beachbourne we meet the shrewd old surgeon Dr Trupp.

57641.label: The Man from the North
57641.recap: From the hostel loggia the Colonel watches two visitors approach along the coast path, among them the town's notable minister.

57641.label: Nightmare
57641.recap: Dr Trupp's blunt words hint at hard trouble in a household and a violent man's comeuppance.

57641.label: Pitched Battle
57641.recap: The town's gossip turns to the strained relations within the Caspar family.

57641.label: The Avalanche Moves
57641.recap: As the Irish crisis deepens, the King calls a conference at Buckingham Palace and the nation holds its breath.

57641.label: Beau-nez
57641.recap: Ernie tenderly comforts his small daughter Alice, mocked by cruel children.

57641.label: Victory and Revenge
57641.recap: A bitter feud between workmen flares into violent confrontation.

57669.label: Meeting the Thinking Machine
57669.recap: We are introduced to Professor Van Dusen, a tiny, squinting logician who insists that nothing whatever is impossible.

57669.label: Inside Cell 13
57669.recap: Shut in a death cell with only what he stands in, the scientist studies the prison's walls, lights and guards from his window.

57669.label: Gas in the night
57669.recap: A reporter lays out the case of a young broker who keeps waking half-asphyxiated behind a door locked from the inside.

57669.label: A caller with no name
57669.recap: A well-dressed stranger arrives who cannot remember his own name, his home, or anything at all before four weeks ago.

57669.label: Night drive in the Green Dragon
57669.recap: An actress and two old friends set out from a Boston hotel in a fast car, bound for a country inn and supper.

57669.label: A stop for gasoline
57669.recap: A leaking tank forces the car to halt at a roadside inn, and the actress is left sitting alone while the men go in.

57669.label: Assigned to a haunted house
57669.recap: A reporter is sent down to a shuttered house above the sea where labourers claim to have seen a burning figure.

57669.label: The thing on the stairs
57669.recap: Hatch describes to the scientist what appeared to him while he sat alone in the dark of the empty house.

57669.label: The bank closes for the day
57669.recap: A teller checks the day's packages of bills, and the small routines of the Ralston National are set out in detail.

57669.label: The safe is blown
57669.recap: That night the bank's supposedly impregnable safe is opened, a great sum is gone, and the watchman is found bound and beaten.

57669.label: The painting called Fulfillment
57669.recap: A celebrated picture hangs in a Boston museum and nobody can discover who posed for it.

57669.label: The last explanation
57669.recap: The scientist lays out his chain of reasoning for the final case and answers the last questions put to him.

58820.label: A forgotten catalogue
58820.recap: Lord Peter turns his taxi back for a sale catalogue and takes a telephone call from his mother about a neighbour's very strange morning.

58820.label: The architect's front room
58820.recap: A shaken little Battersea architect thanks his titled caller and pours out everything the police have been doing in his flat all day.

58820.label: A friend out of the fog
58820.recap: Back in his black and primrose library, Lord Peter welcomes a Scotland Yard man in from a raw November night and offers to share his puzzle.

58820.label: Sonata and deductions
58820.recap: Over the piano, Parker lays out everything the body itself suggests about the person who arranged it.

58820.label: Burnt porridge and a summons
58820.recap: Parker wakes in his cheerless Great Ormond Street flat to fog and a telephoned invitation to a far better breakfast.

58820.label: The inquest
58820.recap: A brisk coroner throws open the windows, swears in his jury and sends them off to view the body while the public crowd in.

58820.label: A luncheon he cannot refuse
58820.recap: Bunter blocks the door over a pair of trousers while his master tries to reach a luncheon party before another guest does.

58820.label: A wakeful night
58820.recap: Unable to settle, Lord Peter picks up a heavy scientific book in the hope of dulling a mind that will not stop turning.

58820.label: Orders and a warrant
58820.recap: Lord Peter hands Parker a sheet of instructions and asks that men be held in readiness, while refusing to say what he suspects.

58820.label: The medical student
58820.recap: A large, freckled young man from the hospital finds himself drinking astonishing brandy in a stranger's magnificent library.

58820.label: Fog over the graves
58820.recap: In choking yellow fog a small official party gathers at a graveside while two men work with spades.

58820.label: A letter about chess
58820.recap: A long letter arrives that opens with the memory of an old man who would never concede a lost game.

58866.label: A Fellow Traveller
58866.recap: On the train back from France, Hastings has a sparring encounter with a saucy young woman he dubs Cinderella.

58866.label: An Appeal for Help
58866.recap: Poirot receives an urgent letter from a wealthy stranger in France, begging him to come at once.

58866.label: At the Villa Geneviève
58866.recap: They arrive too late: the millionaire Paul Renauld has already been found murdered.

58866.label: The Letter Signed Bella
58866.recap: Renauld lies stabbed in the back in an open grave on the golf links, a love letter among the first clues.

58866.label: Mrs. Renauld's Story
58866.recap: The widow tells of masked intruders who seized her husband from his bed in the night.

58866.label: Madame Daubreuil
58866.recap: Suspicion stirs around the Renaulds' beautiful and secretive neighbour, Madame Daubreuil.

58866.label: Giraud Finds Clues
58866.recap: The brilliant, arrogant Paris detective Giraud arrives and treats Poirot's methods with open scorn.

58866.label: Jack Renauld
58866.recap: The dead man's son, Jack Renauld, returns and falls under a cloud of suspicion.

58866.label: The Girl with the Anxious Eyes
58866.recap: Hastings crosses paths again with his mysterious Cinderella, whose nerves seem strangely on edge.

58866.label: The Second Body
58866.recap: A shocking second discovery throws the whole investigation into confusion.

58866.label: The Beroldy Case
58866.recap: Poirot recalls an old murder trial whose details echo eerily through the present mystery.

58866.label: Poirot on the Case
58866.recap: His grey cells triumphant, Poirot lays out the reasoning that unlocks the puzzle.

58866.label: An Unexpected Dénouement
58866.recap: The courtroom proceedings take a sudden and dramatic turn.

58866.label: Journey's End
58866.recap: The last truths come out, and Hastings finds his own heart finally settled.

59827.label: Earliest Irish memories
59827.recap: A small boy in Ireland recalls his first scraps of memory, the sudden loss of his mother, and a trick that wins him sugar from the nurse.

59827.label: An English grammar school
59827.recap: He contrasts the kindly Irish schoolrooms he loved with an English school run on punishment, lines, and fagging.

59827.label: A question about God
59827.recap: A single question from an older schoolfellow topples the boy's religious certainties in the space of an hour.

59827.label: Landing in New York
59827.recap: The runaway boy sees the harbour of a new world for the first time and quietly slips away from the guardians who brought him over.

59827.label: Night clerk in Chicago
59827.recap: He takes a night-clerk job in a second-class hotel and works his way steadily into more of the business.

59827.label: The city burns
59827.recap: A second night's alarm brings him out to a fire that swallows Chicago block by block.

59827.label: Poetry on a hot train
59827.recap: A stranger's book of verse, picked up idly on a Kansas train, overwhelms him and changes what he wants from life.

59827.label: A cold first meeting
59827.recap: At his new lodgings he sets out to charm the whole family while staying pointedly cool toward their daughter.

59827.label: The crash of 1873
59827.recap: A financial collapse ruins his brother's speculations and forces him to reckon with money, debts, and family loyalty.

59827.label: Philadelphia and Concord
59827.recap: He nurses an ailing friend, writes up a lecture on impulse, and finds himself taken on as a newspaper reporter.

59827.label: First day in Paris
59827.recap: Leaving America behind, he travels east by easy stages and spends a whole day walking Paris, dazzled by its history.

59827.label: Calling on Carlyle
59827.recap: In London he seeks out the writer who shaped him most, and is received with unexpected warmth.

59828.label: The shop by St Dunstan's
59828.recap: A small barber's shop beside the church is described, along with its odd proprietor and the terrified apprentice he has just sworn to silence.

59828.label: A sailor's errand
59828.recap: A newly landed seaman watches the church chimes with his dog, carrying sad news and a valuable gift for a girl he has never met.

59828.label: The spectacle-maker's daughter
59828.recap: A spectacle-maker calls his daughter down to breakfast, and she comes with her thoughts fixed on a sweetheart who sailed for India.

59828.label: Noon in Bell-yard
59828.recap: On the stroke of twelve the law clerks stampede into Bell-yard for the most celebrated pies in London.

59828.label: The stranger at Lovett's
59828.recap: A ragged and starving man asks the pie-shop keeper for any employment whatever, and is told what work there is to be had.

59828.label: A tale at the madhouse
59828.recap: The keeper of a private asylum fills the glasses and explains to a visitor how his business is really conducted.

59828.label: The run to London
59828.recap: The apprentice runs for the city with terror at his heels, and every passer-by who tries to stop him takes him for a madman.

59828.label: Watchers in Fleet Street
59828.recap: Officers begin passing and repassing the shop window so that no customer is ever left inside alone.

59828.label: Preparations at dawn
59828.recap: A new day breaks over Fleet Street with the barber's own arrangements complete and only one thing still wanting.

59828.label: Sentence in court
59828.recap: A crowded courtroom is hushed and every eye turns to the dock as the judge prepares to speak.

59828.label: A hail on the river
59828.recap: A shout across the dark water sends a fugitive cowering into the bottom of the boat while the watermen pull for a barge.

59828.label: The London road
59828.recap: Two young men get to horse within minutes and take the London road after a rider with a long start.

59892.label: A courtroom in January
59892.recap: A sunburnt, dignified woman stands trial for a killing ten years old while her famous lawyer declines to cross-examine a single witness.

59892.label: Home after twelve years
59892.recap: An emigrant rides back to the Ulster farm of his boyhood and finds every field and stone unexpectedly strange.

59892.label: A quarrel in the rain
59892.recap: A Belfast linen master watches the woman he loves walk away over a strike he refuses to settle.

59892.label: The bridge in the Andes
59892.recap: An engineer returns to the great span he is building and feels that the bridge resents every absence.

59892.label: Mount Kyteler remembered
59892.recap: A narrator walks in memory through an emptied Irish estate above Dublin, listing its trees, birds and lost voices.

59892.label: The November hunt
59892.recap: A man back from twenty years abroad joins an Irish hunt and finds the whole field still cold toward him.

59892.label: A writer with nothing
59892.recap: A would-be author sits at his desk certain that his quiet home and kind family hold no story worth telling.

59892.label: The queen's long journey
59892.recap: A young Abyssinian queen leads her enormous caravan down from the mountains, wavering at the edge of a journey to a foreign king.

59892.label: Night in the desert
59892.recap: On a moonlit Egyptian plain the beasts of the world gather in a great orderly silence.

59892.label: Dusk over Gaza
59892.recap: A woman on a balcony watches the crowded street and remembers the man her enemies still curse her for.

59892.label: The Manchu on Fifth Avenue
59892.recap: A Manchu duke keeps a treasure shop in New York, refuses to sell to the wrong buyers, and befriends a poor young customer.

59892.label: A visit to Brother Sergius
59892.recap: A prosperous manufacturer calls furtively on a black-robed Russian to ask whether the dead can be made to answer.

60316.label: A litter on the road
60316.recap: A king of Sistan, riding home from a hunt, catches sight of his vizier's daughter and decides on the spot to marry her.

60316.label: Flight by night
60316.recap: With the city seized around them, the king and his pregnant queen slip out through a hidden passage into the desert.

60316.label: The robbers' find
60316.recap: A band of robbers riding past the well discovers a richly wrapped infant, and their chief takes him home to raise.

60316.label: Keeper of the treasure
60316.recap: The young man rises fast in the king's service until ten viziers begin to resent how far he has come.

60316.label: The wrong room
60316.recap: Too drunk to know where he is walking, Bakhtyar falls asleep somewhere he has no business being.

60316.label: The unluckiest merchant
60316.recap: To buy himself a day, Bakhtyar tells of a rich man whose every sensible venture went wrong.

60316.label: The impatient prince
60316.recap: The next tale concerns a prince who could never wait for anything, and what his haste ended up costing.

60316.label: The patient man
60316.recap: Against the impatient prince, Bakhtyar sets a villager whose entire fortune is his patience.

60316.label: Two viziers, one daughter
60316.recap: A king's ear is turned against an innocent girl by the counsellor she refused.

60316.label: The jeweller's son
60316.recap: A jewel-merchant is summoned to court and leaves his pregnant wife, naming the son he has not yet seen.

60316.label: Arguing with fate
60316.recap: The last tale tells of a king warned in a dream about his unborn son, who sets out to defeat the prophecy.

60316.label: The cloak produced
60316.recap: As the crowd gathers for the execution, the robber chief rides in wearing something the king recognises.

60979.label: Board boy at fourteen
60979.recap: A boy quick at figures takes a job chalking stock prices and starts a private notebook of how the numbers behave.

60979.label: The first trade
60979.recap: A friend's tip on Burlington gives him a chance to test his notebook with real money for the first time.

60979.label: Twenty-one, off to New York
60979.recap: Barred at home, he goes to New York with twenty-five hundred dollars to trade through a real Stock Exchange house.

60979.label: A shop in New Haven
60979.recap: On a motor trip he stops at a small bucket shop whose manager greets two young men with a magnificent speech.

60979.label: Old Turkey's one answer
60979.recap: An elderly customer answers every request for advice with the same maddening remark about what kind of market it is.

60979.label: A hunch on the Boardwalk
60979.recap: On a seaside rest he wanders into a branch office and feels a sudden, unexplained urge to sell.

60979.label: News reaches the yacht
60979.recap: A newspaper passed over from a motor boat tells him the market has rallied hard, and he goes ashore to act.

60979.label: Held up by corn
60979.recap: A planned fishing trip is stalled by a losing short line in corn that a Chicago operator has cornered.

60979.label: A letter from Percy Thomas
60979.recap: The most famous cotton man in the world asks for a meeting and proposes a working alliance.

60979.label: Broke and in debt
60979.recap: Wiped out and owing money, he finds he can no longer trust his own nerve or trade in a small way.

60979.label: A favour he cannot refuse
60979.recap: A broker friend asks him to take on marketing a large block of a stock he would rather leave alone.

60979.label: Closing counsel
60979.recap: He ends with a survey of the abuses a speculator still has to guard against and a last word on tips.

61168.label: A dressing room in Paris
61168.recap: After her triumph a dancer receives a fellow conspirator and hints that she holds something over their retiring chief.

61168.label: Anne begins her story
61168.recap: Anne Beddingfeld introduces herself as the daughter of a celebrated, penniless anthropologist and admits she is starved of adventure.

61168.label: Free and penniless
61168.recap: Left alone in the world, Anne politely refuses every safe offer of a home and sets out for London instead.

61168.label: Hyde Park Corner
61168.recap: A frightened stranger falls from the platform, and Anne keeps a paper dropped by the doctor who examines him.

61168.label: Bluffing a press baron
61168.recap: Anne talks her way into the house of the owner of the Daily Budget and bargains for a place on his paper.

61168.label: Sir Eustace's diary
61168.recap: A comfort-loving Member of Parliament grumbles into his diary as his tireless secretary brings unwelcome news.

61168.label: Aboard the Kilmorden
61168.recap: Anne sails for South Africa and spends her first three days flat on her back in her cabin.

61168.label: Fancy dress at the equator
61168.recap: Sir Eustace records a shipboard costume dance, good champagne and a surprisingly talkative Colonel Race.

61168.label: Table Mountain at dawn
61168.recap: The ship glides into Table Bay at sunrise and Anne finds she is not the only person awake on the boat deck.

61168.label: Wooden animals in Bulawayo
61168.recap: The travelling party arrives laden with carved souvenirs while Sir Eustace's temper frays in the heat.

61168.label: Into a city under fire
61168.recap: Anne travels alone towards the sound of guns and is shown into a shabby room where someone unexpected is waiting.

61168.label: Letters from far away
61168.recap: Two years on, Anne reads over letters from old friends and takes stock of the life she chose.

61262.label: The film star's diamond
61262.recap: A famous actress climbs the stairs to Poirot's rooms carrying three anonymous letters that demand she give up her great diamond.

61262.label: A heavily insured man
61262.recap: An insurance company asks Poirot to look into the death of a nearly bankrupt client found in the grounds of his own manor.

61262.label: A flat too cheap
61262.recap: At a friend's party a young bride describes the impossibly cheap Knightsbridge flat she has somehow just been given.

61262.label: Detecting from a sickbed
61262.recap: Flat on his back with influenza and enjoying his medicine bottles, Poirot receives a frantic visitor and sends Hastings out in his place.

61262.label: Bonds lost at sea
61262.recap: A composed young woman arrives to ask Poirot about a million dollars in bonds that vanished during an Atlantic crossing.

61262.label: The curse of the tomb
61262.recap: After a run of deaths follows the opening of an Egyptian tomb, an archaeologist's widow asks Poirot for his views on the supernatural.

61262.label: A weekend in Brighton
61262.recap: Hastings treats Poirot to a grand seaside hotel where the diners are plastered with jewels and one guest's pearls are famous.

61262.label: An attempt on the Prime Minister
61262.recap: The evening papers carry a censored account of a shot fired at the Prime Minister, while Poirot gives his attention to a grease spot.

61262.label: A banker walks out
61262.recap: Over tea Japp brings the case of a financier who left his house on Saturday and vanished, and Poirot sorts disappearances into categories.

61262.label: A cry on the telephone
61262.recap: A doctor's housekeeper bursts in with a message gasped down the telephone by a man who said he had been killed.

61262.label: An uncle's challenge
61262.recap: A brisk young woman explains how her uncle left her a farmhouse and a puzzle instead of a straightforward inheritance.

61262.label: Off the train at Taunton
61262.recap: Beaten and dissatisfied on the journey home, Poirot suddenly hauls Hastings onto a platform, having realised what he overlooked.

64317.label: West Egg
64317.recap: Nick Carraway settles next to the mansion of the mysterious Gatsby and dines with his cousin Daisy and her brutish husband Tom.

64317.label: The Valley of Ashes
64317.recap: Tom drags Nick to the flat he keeps with his mistress Myrtle, where a drunken little party turns ugly.

64317.label: Gatsby's Party
64317.recap: At one of Gatsby's lavish parties Nick finally meets his host, a courteous young man wrapped in rumour.

64317.label: Gatsby's Past
64317.recap: Gatsby takes Nick to lunch and, through Jordan, reveals he loved Daisy years ago and longs to win her back.

64317.label: Reunion
64317.recap: Nick arranges tea, and Gatsby and Daisy meet again after five years, awkward at first and then radiant.

64317.label: The Truth About Gatsby
64317.recap: Gatsby's humble beginnings surface, Tom grows suspicious, and a party leaves Daisy cold.

64317.label: The Confrontation
64317.recap: On a sweltering day the rivalry erupts in a hotel room, and the drive home ends in a fatal accident.

64317.label: The Vigil
64317.recap: Gatsby keeps watch over Daisy through the night as the consequences of the accident close in around him.

64317.label: After
64317.recap: Nick arranges Gatsby's near-empty funeral and, sickened by the careless people he leaves behind, returns west.

65238.label: Anthony Cade Signs On
65238.recap: In Africa the easygoing adventurer Anthony Cade takes a simple-sounding job: carry a dead statesman's explosive memoirs to London.

65238.label: The Gentle Art of Blackmail
65238.recap: In London the charming Virginia Revel is called upon by a blackmailer over some compromising letters.

65238.label: A Dead Man
65238.recap: Virginia comes home to find the blackmailer shot dead in her own drawing-room.

65238.label: Chimneys
65238.recap: At the great country house of Chimneys a guest is found murdered, throwing a delicate political weekend into chaos.

65238.label: Superintendent Battle Arrives
65238.recap: The stolid Superintendent Battle of Scotland Yard takes quiet charge of the baffling case.

65238.label: Anthony Tells His Story
65238.recap: Anthony arrives at Chimneys and gives the police an account that only deepens the mystery.

65238.label: The French Stranger
65238.recap: A French detective joins the hunt, on the trail of a notorious jewel thief.

65238.label: A Midnight Adventure
65238.recap: After the inquest a midnight search of the house turns up more than anyone bargained for.

65238.label: Secret History
65238.recap: The detective lays out the tangled royal history of Herzoslovakia lurking behind it all.

65238.label: The Red Signal
65238.recap: The threads of memoirs, murder and missing jewels begin to draw together.

65238.label: The 13th of October
65238.recap: Everything converges on a single fateful night at Chimneys.

65238.label: King Victor
65238.recap: The identity of the elusive master-thief known as King Victor comes into the open.

65238.label: Further Explanations
65238.recap: With the danger past, the last knots of the affair are patiently untangled.

65238.label: A New Job
65238.recap: One final surprise rewrites just who Anthony Cade has really been all along.

66446.label: The Plymouth express
66446.recap: A young naval officer settles alone into a first-class compartment and cannot place a smell in the air.

66446.label: A summons in the post
66446.recap: Poirot shows Hastings a curt letter and reads out the newspaper report that explains who sent it.

66446.label: Park Lane
66446.recap: An American steel millionaire hires Poirot on the spot and sets out his daughter's travel plans and her jewels.

66446.label: The maid's evidence
66446.recap: The lady's maid describes the sudden change of plan at Bristol and the man she never saw the face of.

66446.label: The withheld letter
66446.recap: Poirot threatens to drop the case, and a paper comes out of a pocket that changes the shape of things.

66446.label: Japp takes the trains
66446.recap: The inspector sets off to walk the line and measure things, teasing Poirot about gray cells as he goes.

66446.label: Nothing at all
66446.recap: Poirot reports that he has done no running about, and argues with Hastings about why a thief would kill.

66446.label: A name from the pawnshops
66446.recap: News that the jewels are being passed gives Poirot an idea he offers to act on at once.

66446.label: Back to Park Lane
