66446.recap: Without explaining anything, Poirot takes a cab across London and asks the footman a quiet question.

66446.label: The small black trunk
66446.recap: In a neat bedroom at the top of the house, Poirot kneels down with a twist of wire in his hand.

66446.label: Lunch afterwards
66446.recap: Over an excellent lunch Poirot retraces the reasoning that began with one small insistence.

67098.label: A buzzing in the oak
67098.recap: Pooh hears a noise in a tall tree, reasons his way to honey, and starts climbing.

67098.label: Calling on Rabbit
67098.recap: Humming a new hum, Pooh finds a hole in a sandy bank and invites himself in for a little something.

67098.label: Tracks in the snow
67098.recap: Piglet finds Pooh circling a patch of snow, following paw-marks that may belong to a Woozle.

67098.label: Something missing
67098.recap: Pooh walks round the gloomy donkey and notices that his tail is not where a tail should be.

67098.label: Talk of Heffalumps
67098.recap: A casual mention of a Heffalump sets Pooh thinking, and by the Six Pine Trees he has made a solemn decision.

67098.label: A gloomy reflection
67098.recap: Eeyore studies himself in the water and finds the view pathetic from both banks, until Pooh comes crackling out of the bracken.

67098.label: Strangers arrive
67098.recap: Kanga and Baby Roo turn up in the Forest, and Rabbit calls a worried meeting about the newcomers.

67098.label: Big Boots
67098.recap: Pooh invents a song on the way to Christopher Robin's house and finds him pulling on boots for an adventure.

67098.label: Water rising
67098.recap: Days of rain turn ditches into rivers, and Piglet, alone and very small, watches the water climb towards his window.

67098.label: A party in the sun
67098.recap: With the streams tinkling again, Christopher Robin whistles for Owl and announces that there is going to be a party.

67160.label: Poirot in bed
67160.recap: Poirot is recovering from influenza and enjoying a paragraph about himself in a gossip paper.

67160.label: The agitated caller
67160.recap: Hastings goes downstairs to meet a well-dressed visitor in a state of obvious distress.

67160.label: North by rail
67160.recap: On the train the visitor explains his household arrangements and hands over the telegram that summoned him.

67160.label: Hunter's Lodge
67160.recap: They reach a grey shooting-box alone on the moors and find Scotland Yard already there.

67160.label: The housekeeper's account
67160.recap: A quiet woman in black describes the stranger who called after dinner and what she heard next.

67160.label: The lady's answers
67160.recap: The mistress of the house comes down and answers Hastings's questions readily and clearly.

67160.label: The gun-room
67160.recap: Hastings searches the scene himself and finds far less than detective novels had led him to expect.

67160.label: Japp's theory
67160.recap: The inspector shows Hastings the body and lays out who he had his eye on, and why it will not do.

67160.label: Wires from London
67160.recap: Hastings posts a full report and gets back terse instructions that strike him as absurd.

67160.label: An empty room
67160.recap: Acting on Poirot's wire, they go to look for someone and discover they have left it too long.

67160.label: Facts in order
67160.recap: Back in the armchair by the fire, Poirot begins numbering the points of the case one by one.

67160.label: Afterward
67160.recap: A short closing note records what became of the case once the talking was done.

67173.label: A businesslike client
67173.recap: A brisk, self-possessed young woman arrives at Poirot's rooms with a problem she says is unusual.

67173.label: The old argument
67173.recap: She describes the long quarrel with her uncle over whether a girl should have book-learning at all.

67173.label: The extraordinary will
67173.recap: Her uncle's will gives her a year in the house and a challenge she must meet to keep anything.

67173.label: Crabtree Manor
67173.recap: Poirot and Hastings begin work in the dead man's tidy study and Poirot notices one thing out of keeping.

67173.label: Questioning the Bakers
67173.recap: The housekeeper and her husband recall signing the will and mention an odd detail about the paperwork.

67173.label: The Plymouth workmen
67173.recap: A trip to town turns up the men who did some very particular carpentry for the old gentleman.

67173.label: What the cavity held
67173.recap: The hiding place opens, and what Poirot draws out is not what he expected.

67173.label: Off the train at Taunton
67173.recap: On the way back to London, Poirot suddenly hauls Hastings onto a dark platform, furious with himself.

67173.label: Held to the flame
67173.recap: Back at the manor before dawn, Poirot puts something small and dirty to the fire and watches.

67979.label: A Wasted Life
67979.recap: On her drab twenty-ninth birthday the timid, unloved Valancy Stirling dreads another year ruled by her cold family.

67979.label: The Doctor
67979.recap: In secret, telling no one, Valancy goes to a heart specialist about the pains she has hidden.

67979.label: The Letter
67979.recap: A letter from the doctor brings grave news, and Valancy resolves to stop merely existing and finally live.

67979.label: Speaking Her Mind
67979.recap: At a stuffy family dinner Valancy astonishes her relatives by saying exactly what she thinks for the first time.

67979.label: Leaving Home
67979.recap: Scandalising the family, Valancy leaves to keep house for rough old Roaring Abel and nurse his dying daughter.

67979.label: Barney Snaith
67979.recap: Valancy grows easy with Barney Snaith, the mysterious outcast the whole town whispers about.

67979.label: Cissy
67979.recap: Gentle Cissy slips quietly away, and Valancy's tender care of her comes to an end.

67979.label: A Married Woman
67979.recap: To everyone's shock Valancy marries Barney and finds an unimagined happiness in his little island house.

67979.label: The Blue Castle
67979.recap: On their island in Mistawis, Valancy lives the free and beautiful life she had only ever dreamed of.

67979.label: A Near Thing
67979.recap: A sudden moment on the road brings a feeling Valancy has long been afraid to face.

67979.label: The Old Letter
67979.recap: Troubled, Valancy goes back to the doctor about the letter that changed her whole life.

67979.label: Turned Upside Down
67979.recap: A few words from the doctor turn Valancy's new life completely upside down.

67979.label: Going Back
67979.recap: Shaken and ashamed, Valancy returns to the family home she had fled.

67979.label: Home at Last
67979.recap: With every shadow lifted, Valancy comes home at last to the life and the love she chose.

68283.label: A merciful ignorance
68283.recap: The narrator opens by arguing that some scattered facts should never be pieced together.

68283.label: The locked box
68283.recap: Sorting his dead granduncle's papers, he opens a box holding an odd clay tablet and a bundle of notes.

68283.label: The sculptor's dream
68283.recap: The manuscript records a young sculptor bringing the professor a tablet he says he made in his sleep.

68283.label: Dreams across the world
68283.recap: The professor's other notes gather reports of strange dreams among artists and poets during the same weeks.

68283.label: A policeman's problem
68283.recap: At an old scholars' meeting a New Orleans inspector produces an ancient statuette that nobody present can place.

68283.label: Into the swamp
68283.recap: Police push miles through cypress country after squatters report drums, screams and disappearances.

68283.label: Old Castro's legend
68283.recap: An immensely aged prisoner recounts a legend of beings who ruled the earth long before people existed.

68283.label: Visiting the sculptor
68283.recap: The narrator calls on the young artist meaning to rebuke him and comes away unsettled instead.

68283.label: A stray newspaper
68283.recap: A chance glance at an old Australian paper links the whole business to something that happened at sea.

68283.label: Chasing the survivor
68283.recap: He travels halfway round the world tracing the rescued sailor, the yacht and the idol it carried.

68283.label: The sailor's manuscript
68283.recap: The mate's own written account retells the voyage that carried his crew far south of any known route.

68283.label: Sealing the record
68283.recap: The narrator files everything away together and reflects on what his knowledge is likely to cost him.

69087.label: Breakfast in King's Abbot
69087.recap: The village doctor comes home from an early call and decides how much of the news to share with his sister over breakfast.

69087.label: The vegetable marrow
69087.recap: Weeding his garden, the doctor is nearly struck by a marrow thrown over the wall by the odd little foreigner next door.

69087.label: Dinner at Fernly
69087.recap: Arriving early for dinner at the big house, the doctor notices a sound in an empty drawing room and a housekeeper who seems short of breath.

69087.label: A confidence in the study
69087.recap: Alone after dinner, his host asks a question about an old patient and then unburdens a secret he cannot carry by himself.

69087.label: A locked door
69087.recap: Summoned back to the house by telephone, the doctor finds the butler baffled and the study door locked from the inside.

69087.label: Who the neighbour is
69087.recap: A frightened young woman calls at the doctor's house and reveals what their eccentric neighbour used to do for a living.

69087.label: The goldfish pond
69087.recap: From a seat above the garden, the doctor and the detective watch an unguarded meeting on the path below.

69087.label: An evening at Mah Jong
69087.recap: Over tiles and sandwiches, four villagers trade theories about the case, each more confident than the last.

69087.label: The train to Liverpool
69087.recap: The detective, the inspector and the doctor travel north to look at a man the police are holding on suspicion.

69087.label: A story told at last
69087.recap: Cornered by a newspaper paragraph, a young woman breaks down and agrees to explain what she has been hiding.

69087.label: Missing an old friend
69087.recap: With the house quiet again, the detective admits how much he misses the companion who used to write his cases down.

69087.label: The last pages
69087.recap: At five in the morning the narrator finishes the manuscript he has been keeping throughout and reflects on how it turned out.

69700.label: The illustrious client
69700.recap: A discreet society go-between asks Holmes to stop a marriage to a charming and very dangerous baron.

69700.label: Holmes takes the pen
69700.recap: Writing for himself, Holmes receives a soldier home from South Africa whose closest friend has been shut away from him.

69700.label: A head in the window
69700.recap: Watson returns to Baker Street to find a wax likeness in the alcove and Holmes calmly expecting to be murdered.

69700.label: An abrupt visitor
69700.recap: A huge, threatening caller bursts in to warn Holmes off a matter out Harrow way.

69700.label: Re: vampires
69700.recap: A solicitors' letter about vampires sends Holmes to his index volume and then to a troubled Sussex household.

69700.label: A very odd name
69700.recap: An American promises a fortune to anyone who can produce two more men sharing a peculiar surname.

69700.label: The gold king's letter
69700.recap: Over breakfast Holmes lays out a case already lost in the police courts, and the letter that brought it to him.

69700.label: The professor's dog
69700.recap: Summoned by a curt telegram, Watson finds Holmes brooding over the changed habits of an elderly scholar.

69700.label: Retirement by the Channel
69700.recap: Retired among his bees, Holmes walks out after a gale and is hailed by a neighbour on the cliff path.

69700.label: The landlady's story
69700.recap: A motherly South Brixton landlady brings word of a tenant who has never once shown her face.

69700.label: Glue under the microscope
69700.recap: Between experiments Holmes turns to a racing baronet's household and the trouble stirring inside it.

69700.label: A pathetic client
69700.recap: A broken retired paint manufacturer wants his runaway wife and his savings found, and Holmes has no time to go himself.

70008.label: Overheard in Soho
70008.recap: Two friends arguing over dinner about a doctor's duty to voice suspicions are interrupted by a stranger with a case in point.

70008.label: Port by the fire
70008.recap: The doctor is carried off to a Piccadilly flat to finish his account of how his elderly patient came to die.

70008.label: A use for spinsters
70008.recap: Parker picks holes in the whole story over breakfast, and Wimsey sets an inquisitive maiden lady to work on the records.

70008.label: Letters from Leahampton
70008.recap: Installed in a gossipy boarding house, the investigator begins collecting the town's own version of the old lady's death.

70008.label: An advertisement is placed
70008.recap: Wimsey baits a trap in the personal columns of the newspapers and settles down to see who reacts to it.

70008.label: The lady in the flat
70008.recap: The two men call on an over-dressed stranger to ask what became of a five-pound note she once spent.

70008.label: An expectant father calls
70008.recap: Under a false name and a nervous manner, Wimsey tries to get a nurse talking about the household where she once worked.

70008.label: Comparing notes
70008.recap: Wimsey brings back a servant's account of the household, and Bunter confesses that he lost the person he was shadowing.

70008.label: A month in the country
70008.recap: Over tea, an adoring young friend cheerfully describes everywhere she and her companion have been in the last month.

70008.label: A lawyer remembers a client
70008.recap: A London solicitor describes the striking young woman who came to him twice with a question about inheritance.

70008.label: Search on the downs
70008.recap: A police party combs the gorse and hollows above a lonely stretch of beach, looking for any trace of a picnic.

70008.label: Cat and mouse
70008.recap: The police make a loud show of searching the wrong districts, hoping their quarry will feel safe enough to come back.

70114.label: Home from the Argentine
70114.recap: Hastings sails back to England meaning to surprise his old friend, and finds Poirot's rooms full of packed luggage.

70114.label: Racing back to London
70114.recap: The two hurry home fearing for the visitor they left behind, and a uniformed man calls to claim him.

70114.label: The man who knows China
70114.recap: Poirot drags Hastings out to a dull southern suburb to consult a retired civil servant with a house full of curios.

70114.label: Inside Granite Bungalow
70114.recap: At a Dartmoor murder scene Poirot reads the footprints and complains that the evidence is far too tidy.

70114.label: A visitor from Washington
70114.recap: Japp brings an American agent whose scrap of a message pulls Poirot into the disappearance of a scientist.

70114.label: Calling at Passy
70114.recap: In Paris the pair question a celebrated woman scientist about an Englishman's last evening before he vanished.

70114.label: An uninvited caller
70114.recap: While Poirot waits for the enemy to move, a stranger in a buttoned overcoat walks into their hotel room.

70114.label: Into the enemy's house
70114.recap: A curt letter from a millionaire convinces Poirot to plant Hastings inside the man's household as a secretary.

70114.label: Death over a chessboard
70114.recap: Over dinner Japp describes a champion who collapsed mid-game, and Poirot turns the puzzle over.

70114.label: Papers from the cellar
70114.recap: Searching the riverside house, they recover notes that coldly assess both their characters and their weaknesses.

70114.label: At the Home Office
70114.recap: Poirot puts on his best suit to lay his warning before the Home Secretary and the visiting French Premier.

70114.label: Inside the mountain
70114.recap: Gagged and carried through the pines, Hastings is brought into a rock chamber and led before a long table.

70175.label: A visitor in Spain
70175.recap: A retired Frenchman welcomes Father Brown to his hillside castle, where an American neighbour begins gently interrogating the priest.

70175.label: A shot in the garden
70175.recap: A police detective and his amateur friend, arguing about detection on a night walk, hear a revolver fired behind a judge's garden wall.

70175.label: After dinner at the club
70175.recap: An argument about whether criminology is a science leads the priest to recall a murderer who fits no category.

70175.label: The goldfish joke
70175.recap: A collector wears out his neighbours by asking every one of them whether they have seen his precious goldfish.

70175.label: Trouble behind the scenes
70175.recap: A harassed theatre manager is summoned through the passages under his stage to settle an awkward practical problem.

70175.label: A man walks out of sight
70175.recap: A country gentleman strolls into a tiny hamlet of four or five shops in plain daylight and is not seen to come out.

70175.label: At the picture gallery
70175.recap: Waiting among modern paintings for his niece, the priest instead meets several people he would rather not have met.

70175.label: A charity bazaar
70175.recap: Three visitors argue their way past a fortune-teller's purple tent and a phrenologist's booth at a country-house fete.

70175.label: Lightning over the picnic
70175.recap: A storm lights up a distant four-towered castle for a picnic party, and one figure stands apart on a rise of ground.

70175.label: Back by the fire
70175.recap: On the Spanish terrace the talk returns to the priest's method, and his host finally speaks for himself.

70652.label: A warning against going
70652.recap: Years afterward, a geologist explains why he must finally publish what his expedition found, hoping to stop the next one.

70652.label: Lake goes northwest
70652.recap: A biologist takes most of the equipment on a detour of his own and wires back word of a range higher than the Himalayas.

70652.label: A cave in the limestone
70652.recap: A blast opens a sealed hollow choked with the bones of animals from tens of millions of years of vanished worlds.

70652.label: Fourteen specimens
70652.recap: Lake wires an exhaustive anatomical description of the barrel-shaped things he has dug out, noting that the dogs cannot be trusted near them.

70652.label: The wireless goes quiet
70652.recap: A savage wind rises, the outlying camp stops answering every call, and a rescue flight is loaded through the night.

70652.label: What was done to them
70652.recap: The narrator sets aside squeamishness to describe the state in which the men and dogs of the camp were found.

70652.label: Crossing the divide
70652.recap: Two men in a lightened plane climb to the lowest pass and prepare to look out over country no one has seen.

70652.label: A labyrinth of stone
70652.recap: Beyond the range lies an immense geometric stone maze, running past the limit of sight in every direction.

70652.label: What the carvings told
70652.recap: The murals lay out a long history of the city's builders, their voyages, their works and the servants they made.

70652.label: Toward the abyss
70652.recap: Learning of tunnels down to a sunless inner world, the two abandon the murals and set off with failing torch batteries.

70652.label: A sound in the dark
70652.recap: Deep beneath the ice they hear a noise so ordinary that it unsettles them more than any monstrous one could.

70652.label: Back to the surface
70652.recap: They climb out into daylight, look west across the plateau at a far violet line of peaks, and make for the plane.

70854.label: Two shepherds on the shore
70854.recap: Two shepherds who share the same lost love stand on the sands remembering her, until something floating draws their eyes to the water.

70854.label: A body from the sea
70854.recap: They drag a half-drowned stranger ashore, revive him against his will, and hire a boat to search the wreck he came from.

70854.label: The steward's tale
70854.recap: A household steward recounts how a rich and stubborn neighbour pressed his suit on a young woman who had already given her heart elsewhere.

70854.label: A crowded household
70854.recap: Installed at the royal lodge in disguise, the newcomer finds every attempt at a private word blocked by the whole family at once.

70854.label: Lion and bear
70854.recap: An idle afternoon in a walled meadow is broken open when two hunted beasts come out of the wood.

70854.label: A queen alone at dawn
70854.recap: Unable to sleep, the queen walks out into the wild places and argues bitterly with herself, then hears a voice singing nearby.

70854.label: A secret told
70854.recap: A long-guarded confession is finally made, and the listener answers with more honesty than she meant to reveal.

70854.label: The armies meet
70854.recap: The besieging force and the defenders of the castle close in a long, minutely described and very bloody engagement.

70854.label: A combat of cowards
70854.recap: A boastful herdsman challenges a man famous for cowardice, and both are trapped by their own bragging into meeting on an island.

70854.label: An empty lodge
70854.recap: A foolish guardian spends a whole day digging for buried gold and comes home to a dark and silent house.

70854.label: A kingdom without a king
70854.recap: With Arcadia sliding toward civil war, a visiting monarch is invited in and asked to take the seat of judgment.

70854.label: The last petitioner
70854.recap: At a wedding celebration one final suppliant throws himself down before a queen, and afterwards the royal company take their leave.

71865.label: Out into the morning
71865.recap: A hostess steps out into a bright June morning to buy flowers for her party and finds the whole of her past waiting in the London air.

71865.label: The car in Bond Street
71865.recap: A backfiring motor car with drawn blinds halts the street, and every passer-by invents a different great personage behind the glass.

71865.label: A man who cannot pass
71865.recap: A young veteran stranded on the pavement feels the crowd's attention close around him, while his Italian wife tries to coax him on.

71865.label: An old friend calls
71865.recap: A man just back from India walks in unannounced on a morning of party preparations, and thirty years of what-might-have-been sit down on the sofa with him.

71865.label: Dozing in the park
71865.recap: Regent's Park in the early afternoon: one man wakes from a dream, a small child runs into a stranger's legs, and a young wife wonders why she must suffer.

71865.label: Back to the appointment
71865.recap: A wife gathers herself to fetch her husband for a doctor's appointment and remembers, step by step, how strange he has become.

71865.label: Harley Street verdict
71865.recap: An eminent nerve specialist prescribes rest and proportion, and the couple leave his grey consulting room with the matter taken out of their hands.

71865.label: Flowers across the park
71865.recap: A husband carries roses home across London rehearsing three plain words he has not said in years.

71865.label: Tea at the Stores
71865.recap: A bitter, devout tutor takes her pupil shopping and to tea, and cannot keep her hunger for the girl out of the afternoon.

71865.label: Trimming a hat
71865.recap: Over an afternoon of hat-making a young couple are briefly, ordinarily happy together, and she remembers the café where they first met.

71865.label: The party begins
71865.recap: Below stairs the kitchen boils over while upstairs the cloaks come off and the guests start climbing towards the drawing room.

71865.label: The little room
71865.recap: Slipping away from her own party, the hostess watches an old woman across the street go quietly to bed, and then goes back to her guests.

72824.label: A parcel changes hands
72824.recap: In a shabby Paris flat a nervous Russian sells a hidden parcel to an American buyer, while two men wait in the street below.

72824.label: The masked caller
72824.recap: A white-haired stroller hears a distant shot, asks a polite question about it, and pays a late call on a dealer in antiques.

72824.label: Heart of Fire
72824.recap: Back at his hotel, an American millionaire opens a shabby velvet case to show his secretary what he has bought for his daughter.

72824.label: Curzon Street counsel
72824.recap: Van Aldin visits his unhappy daughter and urges on her a course she has not the nerve to want.

72824.label: The dancer's flat
72824.recap: Shaken by his interview, Derek carries the news to the dancer Mirelle and finds her practical advice unwelcome.

72824.label: A ticket to Nice
72824.recap: Walking off his anger, Derek books a berth on the Blue Train under a borrowed name, and overhears who books next.

72824.label: Victoria platform
72824.recap: Van Aldin comes to see his daughter off and is puzzled by how badly she jumps at his voice.

72824.label: Arrival at Nice
72824.recap: Katherine's journey ends with a shaken conductor, a polite official, and a question she cannot easily answer.

72824.label: The maid's statement
72824.recap: In the magistrate's room at Nice a small Belgian is introduced, and the maid is asked to account for the journey.

72824.label: An unwelcome caller
72824.recap: Derek returns to his hotel to find a smooth aristocrat waiting with a proposition he cannot simply throw out.

72824.label: The train again
72824.recap: Poirot rides the Blue Train a second time, acting out every part of the night in question, and changes his mind at the barrier.

72824.label: By the sea
72824.recap: On a sunlit terrace Poirot talks the finished affair over with a young woman and offers her some parting comfort.

75201.label: The Front
75201.recap: An American, Lieutenant Frederic Henry, drives ambulances for the Italian army on the quiet Alpine front.

75201.label: Miss Barkley
75201.recap: Frederic strikes up a flirtation with the English nurse Catherine Barkley, at first only a game to pass the time.

75201.label: Wounded
75201.recap: During a night offensive a shell tears through Frederic's dugout, badly wounding his legs.

75201.label: The Milan Hospital
75201.recap: Recovering in Milan, Frederic is overjoyed to find Catherine posted to the same hospital, and their game turns to real love.

75201.label: Back to the Front
75201.recap: Healed, and carrying the secret that Catherine is expecting their child, Frederic returns to a weary, demoralised front.

75201.label: The River
75201.recap: As the retreat from Caporetto collapses into murderous chaos, Frederic breaks from the battle police and plunges into the river to save his life.

75201.label: A Separate Peace
75201.recap: Finished with the war for good, Frederic makes his way back to find Catherine.

75201.label: Switzerland
75201.recap: Safe across the border, the lovers settle into a peaceful mountain winter to wait for the baby.

75201.label: Lausanne
75201.recap: As the baby's arrival draws near, the couple moves down to the town of Lausanne.

75288.label: A late breakfast at Chimneys
75288.recap: A guest ambles down to breakfast at a quarter past eleven while his anxious hostess frets over punctuality and loses an argument with her head gardener.

75288.label: Setting the clocks
75288.recap: With bridge occupying the older guests, the young ones hide eight alarm clocks in a champion sleeper's bedroom.

75288.label: The joke that fails
75288.recap: The clocks have done everything asked of them, noon has come, and the sleeper still has not appeared downstairs.

75288.label: Chimneys handed back
75288.recap: The owner of Chimneys regains his house and complains to his daughter about self-made tenants and about inquests.

75288.label: The man in the road
75288.recap: Driving fast towards London, Bundle nearly runs down a man who reels out of a hedge, and hears the few words he manages to say.

75288.label: A call at Scotland Yard
75288.recap: Bundle takes her questions to a wooden-faced superintendent, trading on an acquaintance made four years earlier.

75288.label: Hunstanton Street
75288.recap: Bundle catches a former footman outside a shabby gambling club and briskly talks her way inside.

75288.label: The masked meeting
75288.recap: After four cramped hours in hiding, Bundle watches a bearded man lock a room and put on a very peculiar mask.

75288.label: House party at the Abbey
75288.recap: Bundle arrives at a political weekend party, feigning a passion for politics, and finds her fellow conspirators already installed.

75288.label: A weekend at Letherbury
75288.recap: Jimmy joins another country house party where increasingly fantastic versions of recent events are being cheerfully invented.

75288.label: Coming round
75288.recap: Bundle wakes with a throbbing head and lies still, listening to a familiar voice say things it would never say to her face.

75288.label: Lord Caterham approves
75288.recap: Bundle finally tells her father the news she has been holding back, and he approves for reasons entirely his own.

75790.label: A night of wind and rain
75790.recap: A small boy and his father flee through soaking woodland to a hut, hunted by someone the father calls Shadow-of-Fear.

75790.label: Years on the road
75790.recap: Easier years of wandering follow, filled with lessons in hiding, tracking, climbing and swimming.

75790.label: Down the secret passage
75790.recap: Having tracked his father to a hidden entrance, the boy is calmly invited down into the tunnel.

75790.label: One word too many
75790.recap: Coming into a kitchen full of rough strangers, the boy blurts out something he was warned never to say.

75790.label: Christmas in the snow
75790.recap: A new pistol, a houseful of boys and, in the evening, one of his father's long fireside tales.

75790.label: School and cells
75790.recap: Sent to school, the half-wild boy meets rules, solitary confinement and a master with a long memory.

75790.label: Caught in the dark
75790.recap: Trespassing where he should not be, he is stopped by a voice behind him asking who he is.

75790.label: Meeting Jenny
75790.recap: He stares at a fierce dark-eyed girl and decides on the spot that he has found a companion.

75790.label: Out of the window
75790.recap: Under a starless sky he climbs down the ivy and sets off on an errand he has sworn to complete.

75790.label: Aboard the brig
75790.recap: Taken aboard ship at last, he throws himself into the seafaring life he has always dreamed of.

75790.label: A greeting goes wrong
75790.recap: A friendly face changes in an instant into something wholly other.

75790.label: Sailing south
75790.recap: The narrator closes his account with a voyage, years of good fortune, and a promise of another story.

76178.label: Leaving Chicago
76178.recap: Laura packs a bag one rainy night and takes a train east rather than face her father again.

76178.label: A job by luck
76178.recap: She talks her way into a temporary secretarial post at a radiologist's office and feels useful for the first time.

76178.label: The penthouse
76178.recap: She climbs to a shabby rooftop apartment to meet the woman advertising for a roommate.

76178.label: Down to the Village
76178.recap: An evening out ends in a basement bar that turns out to be nothing like Laura expected.

76178.label: The girl at the bar
76178.recap: Over drinks Jack points out a regular who has been watching Laura since her first visit.

76178.label: News from home
76178.recap: Laura learns her father is coming to New York for a convention and spends the whole day sick with it.

76178.label: The hotel lobby
76178.recap: Without deciding to, she walks into the hotel where her father is staying and approaches the desk.

76178.label: Three in the morning
76178.recap: Marcie comes home very late with a stranger, and Laura discovers how cold she can make her voice.

76178.label: A quarrel at bedtime
76178.recap: Marcie demands to know where Laura keeps disappearing at night, and Laura tells her something true instead.

76178.label: On the roof
76178.recap: Months of silence give way at last and Laura says out loud what she has been holding in.

76178.label: Face to face
76178.recap: Laura knocks at her father's hotel door and makes herself walk in and stay.

76178.label: Back at The Cellar
76178.recap: Laura waits in the bar she once fled, hoping to be given one more chance.

76261.label: A brilliant wedding
76261.recap: An old surgeon recalls standing best man at the wedding of the finest man he ever knew.

76261.label: Official records
76261.recap: Investigators trace the childhood of a Spanish village girl whose eyes frightened everyone who saw them.

76261.label: A hard-headed man
76261.recap: A physician who has always ridiculed the supernatural explains why he is finally writing his story down.

76261.label: The sailor comes home
76261.recap: A young man returns from three years at sea to the seaside town and the girl his family sent him away from.

76261.label: The ride back to Brinton
76261.recap: After sitting with a dying man until midnight, the doctor is warned by a groom to avoid the old mill road.

76261.label: A berth on the Ariadne
76261.recap: A newly qualified doctor turns down a good appointment and books passage on a ship the sailors avoid.

76261.label: A castle in the forest
76261.recap: A gloomy German stronghold with secret stairs and deep dungeons prepares a great fête for the baron's daughter.

76261.label: An evening in Meerut
76261.recap: A warm Indian night finds British families taking the air on a verandah, unaware of what the week will bring.

76261.label: The silent stranger
76261.recap: A Welsh fishing village comes to treat a mysterious newcomer as healer, prophet and something close to a king.

76261.label: Orchids in Brazil
76261.recap: A consul newly arrived in Rio befriends an orchid exporter and his clever daughter, and is pressed to visit the interior.

76261.label: A merchant's confession
76261.recap: A respectable City merchant explains that fear of ridicule kept him from ever admitting what happened to him.

76261.label: What went in the log-book
76261.recap: Too shaken to argue, the narrator gives the inquiry a plain account and keeps his own experience to himself.

76533.label: Waking in the palace
76533.recap: A stranger wakes in a jewelled hall on an island he cannot place, and a silent guardian waves him back to sleep.

76533.label: Dreams of the old world
76533.recap: Worn out by his first lesson, he sinks into vivid dreams of the crowds and ceremonies of the world he left.

76533.label: Solitude and flight
76533.recap: He learns how the islanders guard their privacy, each in a separate house with a flower signal on the roof.

76533.label: The valley of memories
76533.recap: After years of probation he is judged ready to enter the valley that serves the island as library and graveyard at once.

76533.label: The baths give way
76533.recap: An earthquake splits the great crystal hall of baths while he and his young companion are still inside it.

76533.label: A familiar face
76533.recap: Watching the neighbouring islands through a distance-viewer, he recognises the new emperor of the archipelago.

76533.label: The fleet sets out
76533.recap: An invasion fleet steams toward the island while the islanders go calmly about their ordinary day.

76533.label: No room for death
76533.recap: A burst of new discovery quickens the pace of island life until nobody has a spare thought to waste.

76533.label: An elder grows weary
76533.recap: An aged islander, briefly revived by the new age of invention, feels his old weariness with living return.

76533.label: Another threat outside
76533.recap: The island's attention is jerked back from the far future to the defence of its own shoreline.

76533.label: A shadow over the race
76533.recap: A recurring foreboding settles on the people, and the narrator traces it to the stirrings of their mountain.

76533.label: Storm over the ocean
76533.recap: Far out over open water on a long flight, a tornado catches the narrator and his companion in the air.

76639.label: The tutor's first letter
76639.recap: A young tutor writes to the girl he was hired to teach, saying he cannot stay in her mother's house and asking her to send him away.

76639.label: The confession
76639.recap: Eloisa answers by admitting what she has been hiding, and begs him to defend her against her own heart.

76639.label: A day in the bower
76639.recap: After a day in the country he writes in a fever about the reward she gave him among the trees.

76639.label: Exile among the rocks
76639.recap: Sent away to a bleak shore in winter, he spends his days on a cliff with a borrowed telescope trained on her house.

76639.label: An English friend writes
76639.recap: An English nobleman who has watched the pair closely sets down for Eloisa his frank opinion of them both.

76639.label: A confession of disgrace
76639.recap: Separated and abroad, he writes to Eloisa's cousin to confess a fault he is bitterly ashamed of.

76639.label: A promise to a mother
76639.recap: He writes to Eloisa's mother, swearing to keep away from her daughter for as long as she requires it.

76639.label: A long reckoning
76639.recap: Eloisa writes a long, careful account of her life so far, looking back over the years since she first met him.

76639.label: Two cousins, years later
76639.recap: Settled in a household of her own, Eloisa presses her cousin to give up her separate house and come and live with her.

76639.label: Under the same roof
76639.recap: After years away he arrives at her home and writes in the middle of the night, too happy to sleep.

76639.label: A day on the lake
76639.recap: A boating party is caught by the wind, and the walk that follows takes them to a place he has not seen in ten years.

76639.label: The husband's account
76639.recap: Eloisa's husband sets down for her friend the story of her last days, which he alone witnessed.

76668.label: Sound of the rapids
76668.recap: A bushman listens to the white water he has lived beside for three years, thinking about how dangerous it is.

76668.label: Watching from the stern
76668.recap: From the stern of the canoe he studies his wife, who is looking ahead at the big blond guest in the bow.

76668.label: The invitation he regrets
76668.recap: He remembers inviting his friend up for the hunting season, and how the visit has stretched on too long.

76668.label: Two very different men
76668.recap: The narrator sets the loud, flattering sawyer against the small, dark, silent husband who says nothing of what he feels.

76668.label: Into the current
76668.recap: The canoe is taken by the current as the roar of the rapids fills the air.

76668.label: Running the white water
76668.recap: He kneels and drives the canoe through the torrent, beating a dozen dangers with his spruce blade.

76668.label: A sudden crash
76668.recap: Below the worst of the rapids he swings the bow between two rocks and the canoe strikes a snag.

76668.label: Who she turns to
76668.recap: Surfacing, he looks back and reads pain in which of the two men his wife has turned toward.

76668.label: A blow in the water
76668.recap: His wife grabs at the struggling sawyer, who strikes her away and scrambles for the shore.

76668.label: Pulled from the flood
76668.recap: As she sweeps past him he reaches out, lifts her clear of the water and works his way to the bank.

76668.label: The mark that stays
76668.recap: A small cut on her cheek keeps bleeding, and her husband is content that the mark will not fade.

76728.label: An overheard conversation
76728.recap: Coming downstairs for a book, Helen hears her father's visitor accuse him of a crime and then propose a way out of it.

76728.label: A bargain struck
76728.recap: Helen walks alone to Mr Otway's house that same night and sets her own terms for the arrangement he has offered.

76728.label: The eleventh hour
76728.recap: She hurries home in dread, searches the quiet house for anything out of place, and waits upstairs for her father's key in the door.

76728.label: Walk to the chapel
76728.recap: On the appointed morning Helen leaves a letter on the hall table and takes the long way round the town to keep her appointment.

76728.label: After the blow
76728.recap: Alone with a grief she cannot think past, Helen faces Mr Otway and tells him plainly what she now intends to do.

76728.label: Consulting the doctor
76728.recap: Helen lays her whole story before a calm medico-legal expert and asks whether the law offers her any way out.

76728.label: Wellclose Square
76728.recap: A four-wheeled cab carries her east through greyer and greyer streets to the lodging house where she means to begin again.

76728.label: A walk through Soho
76728.recap: Walking home beside a new acquaintance, Helen weighs how much of her situation she is prepared to admit aloud.

76728.label: The Zodiac spoons
76728.recap: Helen finishes the silver set she has been months over and carries it to a Wardour Street dealer to hear what it is worth.

76728.label: The day of days
76728.recap: Morning light scatters the previous night's fears, and Helen spends the hours packing for the meeting she has been counting toward.

76728.label: A coroner's summons
76728.recap: A constable calls at Wellclose Square with a subpoena, and Helen discovers how much she would rather not say under oath.

76728.label: The verdict
76728.recap: As the coroner sums the evidence up for his jury, Helen watches the one man in the room whose knowledge she most fears.

76737.label: A miserable night watch
76737.recap: A heartbroken young reporter hides in the darkest corner of an old churchyard to nurse his misery alone.

76737.label: A pipe for a stranger
76737.recap: He offers his tobacco and flask to a talkative skeleton who has just risen from a nearby grave.

76737.label: A tour of the cherubs
76737.recap: The ghost walks him past rows of carved cherubs and weathered epitaphs, mocking each one in turn.

76737.label: Down into the vault
76737.recap: The assembled dead file into an opened tomb and descend into an enormous lighted hall below the churchyard.

76737.label: The card room
76737.recap: In a room full of ghosts betting pebbles at whist and poker, one very large player draws unwelcome attention.

76737.label: The mended ghost
76737.recap: An enormous limping ghost explains how careless workmen left him in his present condition when his vault was cleared.

76737.label: What dying felt like
76737.recap: The reporter asks the company what their last moments were like, and several answer him plainly.

76737.label: The guest of honour
76737.recap: An Egyptian lady five thousand years dead is seated at the head of the banquet table with great ceremony.

76737.label: The Egyptian's grievance
76737.recap: The princess pours out her fury at the men who carried her from her homeland, and the reporter squirms.

76737.label: The lame stranger
76737.recap: A gloomy ghost at the edge of the ball explains how being shifted from graveyard to graveyard left him ill-assembled.

76737.label: The convention opens
76737.recap: Chairs and a platform appear, the women take a gallery, and the ghosts begin squabbling over who should chair the meeting.

76737.label: Scouring the stones
76737.recap: Back above ground, every ghost kneels to rub away the flattering lies carved over its own grave.

76812.label: A boyish choice
76812.recap: A seventeen-year-old walks out of a law office having chosen his own future, and stops a bully beating a stranger by the wharf.

76812.label: An errand of trust
76812.recap: His former employer hands him a wallet of money and papers to carry to the city, and a watching enemy overhears enough to be dangerous.

76812.label: The stagecoach upset
76812.recap: A reckless driver and an excitable old sailor put the coach over in the road, and the passengers pick themselves out of the wreck.

76812.label: Listening through the wall
76812.recap: Two young schemers take adjoining staterooms on the packet and learn exactly what the boy is carrying.

76812.label: A meeting after midnight
76812.recap: Two conspirators keep a late appointment in a basement saloon to collect what someone else has obtained by deception.

76812.label: A telephone call
76812.recap: A call to the city and then to the bank shows that the money never went where everyone believed it had.

76812.label: The race in the fog
76812.recap: An old packet is driven at full steam through lifting fog to stay ahead of a faster new steamer.

76812.label: Bound in a wagon
76812.recap: He wakes tied under a wagon seat with two strangers driving, and no idea where he is or why.

76812.label: A plan in the tool shed
76812.recap: A fellow inmate reveals a dried-up well in the yard and a scheme to dig out under the wall.

76812.label: Across the rocky waste
76812.recap: The two boys cross open country away from the obvious route, arguing over whether friends would even take them back.

76812.label: A stranger on the cliff
76812.recap: A woman the countryside calls mad carries both boys up a ledge, cuts their bonds, and offers to lead them out through the hills.

76812.label: The reckoning
76812.recap: The newspapers carry the whole story, the courts sort out who did what, and the lake finally gets the service it needed.

76857.label: The birthday call
76857.recap: On his eightieth birthday a long-silent telephone rings, and the voice on the line claims to be him.

76857.label: Remembering the wiring
76857.recap: He recalls the cheerful early years when he built talking machines to keep himself company.

76857.label: The sealed phones
76857.recap: Long ago he silenced the network and set it to wake only if he was still alive at eighty.

76857.label: A younger voice
76857.recap: He answers again and hears himself at twenty-one describing the illusions he built to fill an empty town.

76857.label: The dark canal
76857.recap: He walks out through the unlit town to the water where the machines he once made now lie rusting.

76857.label: Chased through town
76857.recap: Telephones ring house by house as he walks, until he answers one and quarrels with the voice.

76857.label: Guns and dynamite
76857.recap: He drives into another town armed, trying to remember where the voices were hidden, and fires on a tower.

76857.label: Why the lines must stay open
76857.recap: He realizes he cannot pull down the towers, because a rescue might one day try to reach him through them.

76857.label: A stranger on the line
76857.recap: A voice calling itself a rocket captain says it has landed across the planet and asks him to come.

76857.label: The long drive
76857.recap: Exhausted and doubting, he drives all night toward the landing field, imagining the party ahead.

76857.label: The last connection
76857.recap: In the quiet office two surviving telephones ring and find only each other.

76927.label: The bored ensign
76927.recap: A handsome young officer sulks through a scorching afternoon at a Tasmanian convict station while his valet cheerfully polishes his boots.

76927.label: The valet's evening
76927.recap: Left alone, the Cornishman tidies the cottage, smokes in the garden and lets his thoughts go home to a girl in a farmhouse doorway.

76927.label: News in an old newspaper
76927.recap: The ensign comes back from dinner with a borrowed paper carrying an advertisement with his servant's name in it.

76927.label: Waiting for the mail
76927.recap: Months of idle waiting end when the English post finally reaches the cottage with letters for both men.

76927.label: Home to Cornwall
76927.recap: A traveller steps down from the coach in a small Cornish town where the innkeeper half recognises his face.

76927.label: The Cedars at Twickenham
76927.recap: The scene shifts to a rich merchant's riverside garden and the celebrated daughter around whom everyone revolves.

76927.label: A landlady's long story
76927.recap: A sighing seaside lodging-house keeper is coaxed into telling what she knows about a young governess who once worked for her.

76927.label: A model engagement
76927.recap: The household moves to Brighton, where an apparently faultless courtship is admired by everyone except the bride-to-be.

76927.label: Croquet and a tired face
76927.recap: A faithful visitor spends an afternoon noticing the trouble behind his hostess's smile and cannot guess its cause.

76927.label: Wedding preparations
76927.recap: As October nears, an old acquaintance makes himself indispensable to the bridegroom and to the furnishing of the new house.

76927.label: A letter read too late
76927.recap: A young wife reads a farewell letter through and understands for the first time what she has been carelessly given.

76927.label: The journey west
76927.recap: She travels alone to the far end of Cornwall to learn whether her one remaining hope has any ground at all.

76950.label: A publisher's bad conscience
76950.recap: A comfortably married London publisher broods over an old acquaintance he has been careful to keep from his wife.

76950.label: A bargain in the country
76950.recap: An overworked London doctor answers an advertisement for a large riverside house let at a suspiciously low rent.

76950.label: The lady's companion
76950.recap: Elizabeth Lacy, drudging for an elderly employer, looks out at the fog and remembers the lover who left her without explanation.

76950.label: Christmas in Bengal
76950.recap: A narrator promises an unbelievable but true story and introduces a colonel's wife stifling in an up-country Indian station.

76950.label: A visit to Durham Hall
76950.recap: An old bachelor general spends Christmas with his niece and her much-admired husband at their handsome Derbyshire estate.

76950.label: A season in Utrera
76950.recap: A traveller settles into an Andalusian town and reports on its houses, servants, water-carriers and small daily comedies.

76950.label: Marrying on little
76950.recap: A brisk essay weighs whether a couple can honestly live on a modest income, and who is really to blame for extravagance.

76950.label: The boy with no mother
76950.recap: A schoolboy dreads the holidays, having no mother he can remember and a father who frightens him.

76950.label: Winter in the Ardennes
76950.recap: Fleeing fever in Brussels, the narrator talks friends into a February retreat to a remote and reputedly dull Belgian town.

76950.label: The amateur detective
76950.recap: A hard-up press writer takes a paid errand to Norwich, hoping to finish a commissioned book while he hunts a runaway heir.

76960.label: A meeting under the sea
76960.recap: Sea spirits hold a public meeting about a pirate who has made the ocean unsafe, and a young fairy asks for one month to reform him instead.

76960.label: Shore leave in Stamboul
76960.recap: The crew takes a day ashore while their captain broods that nothing in the world interests him.

76960.label: The lieutenant's grudge
76960.recap: The second in command decides his sentimental captain has led the band long enough.

76960.label: The slave bazaar
76960.recap: A pasha shops the market for a new favourite, and a merchant offers up his own dancing niece.

76960.label: A rescue in the market
76960.recap: A stranger draws his sword against the pasha's guards and scatters them by naming himself.

76960.label: Storm at sea
76960.recap: A tempest catches the pirate's vessel with the girl aboard, and the ship goes down.

76960.label: A sleeping draught
76960.recap: Two conspirators drug the captain's wine and carry the girl off while he sleeps.

76960.label: Daggers over a sleeper
76960.recap: The lieutenant talks the crew into mutiny, and they close in on their sleeping chief.

76960.label: Rivals in the harem
76960.recap: Two of the pasha's women trade increasingly personal insults over which of them he will marry.

76960.label: A stranger at the palace
76960.recap: A travelling dervish is admitted to the palace where the girl is held, and calls for his followers.

76960.label: A veil and a swap
76960.recap: A veiled substitution at the wedding leaves the pasha married and the prisoner free to run for a barred window.

76960.label: Lost in the wood
76960.recap: The pair blunder through a wood on foot and walk straight into their old shipmates.

76983.label: Three bottles of pop
76983.recap: A very tall stranger nurses warm soda in a saloon and asks a bartender for news of a valley he left years ago.

76983.label: What happened to Hooty
76983.recap: The bartender lays out the night the bank was robbed and how the case against Skeeter's old friend was built.

76983.label: Back in Yellow Butte
76983.recap: Skeeter rides into the shipping town and finds old acquaintances at the bar, some warmer than others.

76983.label: A dropped tray
76983.recap: At the chop house, the woman waiting tables drops everything at the sight of him.

76983.label: On the Edwards porch
76983.recap: Over a quiet talk Skeeter hears her side of the story, and asks her son what he wants for his birthday.

76983.label: An old friend arrives
76983.recap: A tiny, furious rancher named Fuzzy rides in with a grievance about a fence and a water hole.

76983.label: Something in the brush
76983.recap: Riding the wrecked fence line, Skeeter picks up a small object and quietly pockets it.

76983.label: A night by the spring
76983.recap: He builds something out of fence posts and old clothes in the dark, then rolls out his blankets in the brush.

76983.label: After the shots
76983.recap: At first light he studies the damage, backtracks the rifleman's boot prints, and collects what was left behind.

76983.label: Out of work
76983.recap: Margie has lost her job for no reason she can name, and Skeeter goes back to press the man who fired her.

76983.label: Ambush in the dark
76983.recap: A rope comes out of the blackness at his face, and shots are exchanged before anyone can be seen.

76983.label: The inquest
76983.recap: The whole valley packs the courthouse for the coroner's inquest, and Skeeter takes the witness stand with his gun on.

76995.label: The preacher plays the wheel
76995.recap: A minister wins big at roulette to settle a public wager, and a lean stranger in the crowd introduces himself.

76995.label: Why he rode out
76995.recap: Seven years earlier a misunderstanding, a crooked card game and a brawl drove young Irish Delaney out of town.

76995.label: The Flying M welcome
76995.recap: Two old friends take Irish in and tell him how his uncle died and what the masked Night Hawks have been doing since.

76995.label: Back at the old place
76995.recap: Irish visits the man who now holds his uncle's ranch and states plainly what he came back to do.

76995.label: At the general store
76995.recap: Irish meets the girl he once loved, now married, and her jealous husband picks a quarrel he refuses to take up.

76995.label: A midnight knock
76995.recap: The sheriff rides out after dark with news of a killing and a robbery in town, and questions where Irish spent the evening.

76995.label: A letter with a scent
76995.recap: A warning arrives from the Night Hawks, and something about the paper itself catches Irish's attention.

76995.label: Chopping wood
76995.recap: A rifle cracks from the hills while Irish is at the woodpile, and the old cook's answering firepower proves less than advertised.

76995.label: At the picket gate
76995.recap: Answering a note that asked him to call after dark, Irish reaches the gate and never gets to the door.

76995.label: An empty ranchhouse
76995.recap: The sheriff and his deputy walk into the darkened Flying M looking for Irish and find someone waiting for them instead.

76995.label: Up at the Lost Goose
76995.recap: Tied across a saddle and hauled into the hills, Irish takes one desperate chance in the dark.

76995.label: Light in the window
76995.recap: Irish leads the others quietly up to a lit ranchhouse where two men are arguing about him.

77016.label: Out of luck in the city
77016.recap: A jobless bookkeeper loses his room and his best suit, then opens a newspaper and reads his own name.

77016.label: The stage to Pinnacle City
77016.recap: Waiting for the stage, he meets a young woman coming home to Arizona after a loss.

77016.label: Meeting the lawyer
77016.recap: In town he presents himself to Ed McLean, who hands over money and a story to memorize.

77016.label: The reading of the will
77016.recap: A rancher's will is read aloud and the name of the heir startles everyone in the room.

77016.label: A late-night visit
77016.recap: Three loyal and thoroughly lubricated friends decide to run the newcomer out of town.

77016.label: Arriving at the ranch
77016.recap: He moves out to the Lazy H, where the crew makes its opinion of him perfectly plain.

77016.label: Trouble in the hills
77016.recap: A borrowed horse takes a shortcut and carries him straight into two strangers who would rather not be seen.

77016.label: A cowboy calls on the lawyer
77016.recap: The quiet new Lazy H hand walks into McLean's office and calmly asks for a share.

77016.label: A crowded robbery
77016.recap: The lawyer opens his safe late at night and gets considerably more visitors than he expected.

77016.label: A letter arrives
77016.recap: Left alone at the ranch, Jim opens a note that changes what he is willing to do.

77016.label: The canyon rim
77016.recap: Trailing a stranger by moonlight, Jim finds a rope hanging over the edge of a very deep canyon.

77016.label: The day in court
77016.recap: The will finally comes before the judge, and everyone with a stake in it crowds through the door.

77092.label: Racing the storm
77092.recap: A young New Yorker drives home ahead of a thunderstorm on mountain roads he only half remembers.

77092.label: Waking in a white room
77092.recap: He comes round in a hospital bed and begins trying to work out how he got there.

77092.label: The shuttered house
77092.recap: Once he is fit again he goes back on foot to find the exact spot where he crashed.

77092.label: A visitor in the library
77092.recap: Coming home late, he finds his father deep in conversation with a striking stranger.

77092.label: The papyrus explained
77092.recap: The stranger sets out, slowly and carefully, what his ancient document is supposed to say.

77092.label: Camp in the wadi
77092.recap: The party settles into a hidden desert camp within sight of the diggings.

77092.label: Watching a caller leave
77092.recap: From a crag they watch an unwelcome visitor ride off, then hear how far the excavation has got.

77092.label: Inside the tomb
77092.recap: They step at last into the burial chamber and take stock of what has been left there.

77092.label: After the digging
77092.recap: Each man in the party struggles in his own way with what the excavation has produced.

77092.label: A cry in the house
77092.recap: Low in spirits and back in New York, Barry hears something from behind the closed library door.

77092.label: The trail goes cold
77092.recap: Weeks of searching yield nothing, and the city at large begins to lose interest.

77092.label: Rain outside Paris
77092.recap: Still hunting abroad, he takes shelter from a sudden downpour beside a row of quiet villas.

77109.label: A penniless graduate
77109.recap: Home from university with honours and no money, he rambles Norway climbing rocks and crawling into caverns.

77109.label: Down the sighing cave
77109.recap: Hired men lower him on a rope into a mountain cavern, and the rope breaks.

77109.label: Among walking trees
77109.recap: He wakes on a new planet, flees a bull up the nearest tree, and gives immediate and serious offence.

77109.label: The city of Keba
77109.recap: His host walks him round a grave, orderly city that nonetheless delights in comedies and staged debates.

77109.label: The court of Potu
77109.recap: In the capital he learns what happens to anyone who proposes changing an old law, and is presented at court.

77109.label: A philosopher on the throne
77109.recap: Their chronicles record the single time they set birth aside and elected the wisest subject to rule.

77109.label: An ambitious scheme
77109.recap: Tired of carrying royal letters, he studies the country's laws hoping to make his name as a reformer.

77109.label: Banishment by bird
77109.recap: He explains the strangest punishment these people have, carried out twice a year by enormous migrating birds.

77109.label: A warning to sceptics
77109.recap: He begs the reader's credit in advance for the still stranger countries he is about to describe.

77109.label: Arrival at Quama
77109.recap: He lands among a plain people whose language he must learn from nothing, and finds himself admired.

77109.label: Drilling an army
77109.recap: He reshapes the government, trains cavalry, and marches out to meet an invading neighbour.

77109.label: Back among the mountains
77109.recap: He comes to his senses on a Norwegian hillside and reckons up everything he has lost.

78017.label: The seventh day of storm
78017.recap: A father steadies his wife and four sons as their ship strikes rock and the crew abandons them.

78017.label: Ashore in tubs
78017.recap: They load a boat made of sawn tubs, cross to land with the animals, and pitch a first tent.

78017.label: Back to the wreck
78017.recap: Weighing shelter against salvage, the father resolves to return to the broken ship with his eldest son.

78017.label: Building a bridge
78017.recap: Planning a move inland, he decides a bridge over the river is unavoidable and goes hunting timber.

78017.label: Moving house
78017.recap: The whole family, laden animals and all, marches away from the shore toward a new home.

78017.label: Naming the country
78017.recap: Over dinner the boys argue happily about what to call the bays, marshes and islands they now know.

78017.label: A young eagle
78017.recap: While he was away the boys felled an enormous palm, and one returns with a bird he means to train.

78017.label: Carving a rock house
78017.recap: Work on the rock dwelling advances, and a run of great fish at the river mouth starts a fishery.

78017.label: Oil and a new boat
78017.recap: They render oil at a distance from home and fit the canoe with a paddle machine of his devising.

78017.label: Green Valley
78017.recap: On a pleasant route home through a desert oasis, a cry ahead brings the guns up fast.

78017.label: Sons roam farther
78017.recap: The boys now vanish for whole days, and one returns from the open sea with news he whispers first.

78017.label: A ship at anchor
78017.recap: A visiting captain hears their story, and the family must decide who stays and who sails.

78060.label: A summer by the sea
78060.recap: The narrator recalls drifting into an engagement during idle seaside days at a quiet coastal village.

78060.label: City life
78060.recap: He takes a clerkship in town, hates the work, and grows sour and discontented with everything including himself.

78060.label: A chill between them
78060.recap: Returning in December he finds the old warmth gone, and his gloom seems to wither the girl he loves.

78060.label: The garden path
78060.recap: An irritable remark on a walk through fallen leaves brings the engagement to a cold and sudden end.

78060.label: A tedious journey
78060.recap: Sent by his firm to find a possible new partner, he boards a slow train down the south coast on a sultry afternoon.

78060.label: A face on the platform
78060.recap: As the train crawls into a familiar little station he sees someone he never expected on the platform, and jumps out.

78060.label: The shuttered cottage
78060.recap: He rings the bell at a remembered door and finds the windows dark and no one answering.

78060.label: News at the station
78060.recap: Seeing him off in the morning, the station-master mentions something that happened on the line the night before.

78060.label: The villa at Richmond
78060.recap: He hires a fly and drives out to a house full of small reminders of the past, dreading what he will be told.

78060.label: A sister's account
78060.recap: The sister steadies herself and describes what happened in that quiet room at five o'clock the previous afternoon.

78060.label: Told between the lights
78060.recap: The narrator closes his fireside story and invites his listeners to come and stay.

78083.label: A crab's bargain
78083.recap: A childless queen follows a talking crab down a secret path to a palace of diamonds and is promised a daughter.

78083.label: The fairies' gifts
78083.recap: The promised child is born and the fairies come to bless her, but one visitor has been forgotten and arrives angry.

78083.label: A portrait travels
78083.recap: The princess's picture is sent to every court, and one prince falls so deeply in love with it that he nearly loses his reason.

78083.label: The sealed coach
78083.recap: A windowless coach is built to carry the princess to her prince, with two ladies-in-waiting shut inside beside her.

78083.label: Thunder on the road
78083.recap: A terrible storm scatters the escort, and the party that finally reaches the city is not received as it hoped.

78083.label: A cottage in the woods
78083.recap: A kind old woman gives two weary travellers an inner room with two little beds.

78083.label: An arrow in the wood
78083.recap: Wandering the forest, the prince falls asleep under a tree and wakes to a sound close by.

78083.label: A hole in the wall
78083.recap: A small hole made in the cottage wall shows the prince who is really lodging on the other side of it.

78083.label: A double wedding
78083.recap: The tale closes by explaining who the old woman was, and with two marriages celebrated at once.

78102.label: Apples and a waiting goat
78102.recap: A sixteen-year-old gathers windfall apples in the orchard while watching for the pet goat that is due to kid.

78102.label: Braiding lavender wands
78102.recap: Three girls braid lavender to trade at the store and argue about the husbands and futures they imagine for themselves.

78102.label: Waiting at the fence
78102.recap: Autumn rain sets in, the young man stops coming to the rail fence, and Ellen turns her fear into anger while a private worry grows.

78102.label: The uncle from Chicago
78102.recap: Anton's prosperous city brother arrives for a visit with bootleg whisky and easy talk that unsettles the household.

78102.label: Arrival in the city
78102.recap: Ellen reaches Chicago alone at night and is taken to her uncle's big, echoing, oddly run house.

78102.label: A friend's small house
78102.recap: She turns up at the door of her father's former hired girl, now married on ten clay acres and expecting another child.

78102.label: The road home
78102.recap: On a bright July morning Ellen sets out for home, deliberately turning her mind from what she is leaving behind.

78102.label: Fever in the house
78102.recap: A ten-day downpour brings fever to the family, and Ellen nurses her mother and sister while her father insists on bark tea instead of a doctor.

78102.label: A hard birth
78102.recap: Ellen walks over to a neighbour's cabin and finds her friend has been in labour since noon the day before.

78102.label: A dream and a wheel
78102.recap: A vivid nightmare stirs an old attachment Ellen had put away, while her father begins to soften toward the small boy in the house.

78102.label: A false spring
78102.recap: In the city Anton hurries to the flat of the woman he has been visiting for a year, jealous and unsure of his hold on her.

78102.label: The wheel comes round
78102.recap: Ellen bakes in her own kitchen while the orchard blooms outside, and feels the season turn again.

78106.label: The road to Caerleon
78106.recap: He remembers the little white town of his birth, seen from a hillside road above the river.

78106.label: A pound a week
78106.recap: Living on odd cataloguing jobs, dry bread and green tea, he starts writing without knowing what he wants to say.

78106.label: On cricket and cold mutton
78106.recap: A long digression on why people fill life with games, sport and other strong sauces.

78106.label: A count of lodgings
78106.recap: He tallies every London room he ever rented, and one Soho floor turns into a private campaign.

78106.label: Coming into money
78106.recap: Small legacies arrive in bits and parcels, and he decides to spend rather than invest them.

78106.label: The productive decade
78106.recap: He lists the books written in his best years and remembers cataloguing in a windowless basement.

78106.label: A year of hard translation
78106.recap: An impossible French book costs him twelve months, after which he drifts into literary journalism.

78106.label: Rewriting a tale
78106.recap: He scraps a story he dislikes and builds a new one out of fairy lore and a fashionable theory.

78106.label: The world at a new angle
78106.recap: He tries to describe a change in how things looked to him, and argues that seeing is not believing.

78106.label: The stranger and the bulldog
78106.recap: A polite stranger asks him to show his dog to a lady upstairs, and then simply vanishes.

78106.label: On the stage at thirty-nine
78106.recap: After a lifetime of quiet reading he joins a Shakespearean touring company and finds the life enchanting.

78106.label: A letter arrives
78106.recap: He closes the record of his stage year and touches lightly on the end of his newspaper life.

78109.label: A storm on the streets
78109.recap: On the last night of the year a boy selling baked potatoes shelters from a blizzard, hoarse and unable to find customers.

78109.label: How Peter came to the cellar
78109.recap: The narrator explains how the orphaned boy came to live in a cellar with the old woman who cares for him.

78109.label: The white-haired stranger
78109.recap: A kindly gentleman stops the boy from selling on a Sunday, gives him sixpence, and writes down his name and address.

78109.label: Outside the party
78109.recap: Lingering by the railings, the boy listens to a children's party inside a warm house and wishes he were among them.

78109.label: The crossing
78109.recap: Hurrying across a street in the snow, the boy is struck down and left senseless in the road.

78109.label: The hospital ward
78109.recap: Waking in a strange clean bed, he frets less about his own pain than about the friend waiting up for him at home.

78109.label: An errand kept
78109.recap: The man from the cab collects a small present the boy had been saving for, and carries the news to the court.

78109.label: Watching for her boy
78109.recap: The old woman keeps an anxious vigil at the mouth of the court, and the whole street speculates when a visitor arrives.

78109.label: A face remembered
78109.recap: The doctor making rounds turns out to be someone the boy already knows, and an old disappointment is explained.

78109.label: The little reader
78109.recap: A nine-year-old visitor sits by the bed and reads aloud a story the boy has never heard before.

78109.label: Country air
78109.recap: Sent to a convalescent home, the boy sees fields and trees for the first time and marvels at everything.

78109.label: A letter on New Year's Eve
78109.recap: Decades later, a prosperous man sits writing a letter while his own children drum at the door.

78116.label: The man to beat
78116.recap: A trick rider is introduced whose habit of unveiling impossible stunts keeps his rivals sleepless.

78116.label: Cowtown in the spring
78116.recap: The season's first contest draws lean, hungry cowhands from every direction.

78116.label: Three mysterious words
78116.recap: The rival riders get hold of the next day's program and find a stunt none of them has ever heard of.

78116.label: The stakeout is planned
78116.recap: They shed their pale hats and bright shirts and slip out to spy on a night practice.

78116.label: Following in the dark
78116.recap: The pursuit leaves the road and the runners lose all sense of where they are.

78116.label: Contest day
78116.recap: The final day's fancy riding begins with every competitor keeping one eye on the same man.

78116.label: The bar revealed
78116.recap: The wrapped object is finally uncovered in front of a full grandstand.

78116.label: Counting the money
78116.recap: Battered but cheerful, the riders settle up and the judges' reasoning is explained.
